**Position:** Café Manager  
**Department:** Operations  
**Location:** Starbrews Coffee Shop, TCI Chowk, Rourkela  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Owners / Management

About Starbrews

Starbrews is a modern café built around **good coffee, good food and a welcoming café experience**. We are looking for a responsible and energetic **Café Manager** who can take ownership of the day\-to\-day outlet operations and ensure smooth service.

Job Summary

The Café Manager will be responsible for the **overall operation of the outlet**, including customer service, staff management, inventory, billing, cleanliness, order management and daily reporting.

The Manager should be capable of running the café efficiently even when the owners are not present.

Key Responsibilities1\. Outlet Operations

* Take complete responsibility for the **day\-to\-day functioning of Starbrews**.
* Ensure the café opens and closes on time.
* Conduct opening and closing checks every day.
* Ensure all departments are ready before service begins.
* Monitor the café throughout the shift and resolve operational issues immediately.
* Ensure all Starbrews SOPs and operational standards are followed.

2\. Customer Experience

* Personally ensure that every customer receives **quick, polite and professional service**.
* Ensure staff attends customers promptly after they are seated.
* Monitor table service, order accuracy and serving time.
* Handle customer complaints professionally and resolve issues whenever possible.
* Take regular customer feedback and communicate important feedback to management.
* Encourage staff to suggest suitable **add\-ons and upsells** such as desserts, fries, beverages and combos.

3\. Staff Management

* Manage the daily attendance and shifts of all café employees.
* Allocate duties before every shift.
* Ensure staff are properly groomed and dressed before starting work.
* Conduct daily briefings before service.
* Monitor staff performance, discipline and behaviour.
* Ensure proper communication between the kitchen, bar and service team.
* Train new employees on Starbrews' service standards and SOPs.
* Report repeated performance or discipline issues to management.

4\. Order \& Service Management

* Monitor **dine\-in, takeaway and online orders**.
* Ensure orders are accepted only after confirming product availability.
* Coordinate between the kitchen and barista team.
* Monitor order preparation time.
* Ensure the correct items are packed and served.
* Prevent delays, missing items and incorrect orders.

5\. Inventory \& Stock Control

* Maintain daily stock levels of food, beverages, packaging and other consumables.
* Check incoming stock and verify quantities.
* Follow **FIFO (First In, First Out)**.
* Monitor wastage, spoilage and unnecessary consumption.
* Prepare purchase requirements and inform management on time.
* Ensure stock records are updated accurately.
* Conduct regular physical stock checks.

6\. Billing \& Cash Management

* Monitor all billing and payment transactions.
* Ensure every sale is properly billed through the POS system.
* Verify cash, UPI and other payment collections.
* Maintain the daily sales report.
* Report any billing discrepancy immediately.
* Ensure discounts and offers are applied only as authorized by management.

7\. Hygiene \& Café Standards

* Ensure the café, tables, service area and washroom are clean throughout the day.
* Monitor kitchen and bar hygiene.
* Ensure garbage is cleared regularly.
* Conduct regular checks for **flies, mosquitoes, spills, food contamination and cleanliness issues**.
* Ensure all staff follow proper hygiene and grooming standards.

8\. Daily Reporting

The Manager will be responsible for maintaining and submitting:

* Daily Sales Report
* Daily Expense Report
* Attendance Report
* Stock/Inventory Report
* Wastage Report
* Customer Complaint/Feedback Report
* Online Order Report
* Any operational incident report

9\. Sales \& Business Growth

* Actively look for opportunities to increase the café's average bill value.
* Train staff in **upselling and cross\-selling**.
* Monitor best\-selling and slow\-moving products.
* Suggest promotions, combos and menu improvements to management.
* Help maintain strong relationships with regular customers.

10\. Maintenance \& Problem Solving

* Immediately report equipment breakdowns or maintenance issues.
* Coordinate with vendors/service providers when authorized.
* Ensure the café never runs out of essential operational items.
* Handle day\-to\-day problems independently wherever possible.
* Escalate major financial, staff, customer or safety issues to management.

Candidate Requirements

* **2–4\+ years of experience** in café, restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail operations.
* Previous experience as a **Café Manager / Restaurant Manager / Shift Manager / Outlet Manager** preferred.
* Strong communication and leadership skills.
* Good knowledge of customer service and outlet operations.
* Comfortable handling POS, billing and basic reports.
* Basic understanding of inventory and stock management.
* Ability to manage staff and resolve conflicts.
* Good computer and documentation skills.
* Must be **punctual, disciplined, responsible and proactive**.
* Should be comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

Most Important Qualities

We are looking for someone who:

**Sees a problem → Takes ownership → Finds a solution → Informs management → Makes sure it doesn't happen again.**

The Manager should be able to operate Starbrews smoothly for several days **without the owners needing to supervise every small task.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer satisfaction
* Order accuracy
* Service speed
* Average bill value
* Staff discipline and attendance
* Inventory accuracy
* Food/product wastage
* Daily sales performance
* Cleanliness \& hygiene
* Customer complaints
* Compliance with Starbrews SOPs
* Overall smooth functioning of the outlet

Salary

**₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month**, depending on experience, skills and performance.

**Location:** Starbrews Coffee Shop, TCI Chowk, Rourkela

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Reporting:** Directly to Starbrews Management

title: Robotics Trainer
description:
Job Summary

A Robotics Trainer is responsible for teaching robotics, electronics, coding, AI, IoT, and STEM concepts to school students through hands\-on learning. The trainer will conduct practical sessions, guide students in projects and competitions, maintain laboratory equipment, and foster innovation and problem\-solving skills among students.

Key Roles \& ResponsibilitiesTraining \& Teaching

* Conduct Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, IoT, and STEM classes for students.
* Deliver engaging practical sessions using robotics kits, microcontrollers, and sensors.
* Explain technical concepts in a student\-friendly manner.
* Develop lesson plans and training materials aligned with school requirements.

Project Development

* Guide students in building robotics and STEM projects.
* Mentor students for science exhibitions, competitions, and innovation challenges.
* Support students in project design, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Encourage creativity, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

STEM Lab Management

* Maintain robotics kits, tools, components, and laboratory equipment.
* Ensure proper inventory management of STEM lab materials.
* Report damaged or missing equipment and coordinate replacements.
* Maintain safety standards within the laboratory.

Technical Support

* Assist students in coding using Arduino, Scratch, Python, and other relevant platforms.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues during training sessions.
* Support installation and configuration of robotics hardware and software.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain attendance and training records.
* Prepare progress reports for students and schools.
* Document student projects and achievements.
* Capture photos and videos of activities for reporting and promotional purposes.

Competition \& Event Coordination

* Train students for robotics competitions and hackathons.
* Organize STEM workshops, innovation camps, and demonstrations.
* Support school\-level and inter\-school robotics events.

Continuous Learning

* Stay updated with emerging technologies in Robotics, AI, IoT, and STEM education.
* Participate in internal training and skill development programs.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Physics (B.Sc.), Mathematics (B.Sc.), Electronics (B.Sc.), or any other relevant STEM discipline.
* Freshers with strong technical skills are encouraged to apply.
* Prior teaching or training experience is an added advantage.

Required Technical Skills

* Arduino Programming
* Electronics and Circuit Design
* Robotics Systems
* Embedded Systems
* Python Programming (Basic to Intermediate)
* IoT Concepts
* Sensor and Actuator Integration
* Basic AI and Machine Learning Concepts
* Troubleshooting and Debugging

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to handle school students of different age groups.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities.
* Passion for teaching and technology.
* Good teamwork and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in STEM education.
* Participation in robotics competitions or technical projects.
* Knowledge of 3D Printing, CAD Design, Drones, or AI applications.
* Certification in Robotics, Embedded Systems, or STEM Training.

title: Campus Growth & Partnerships Intern
description:
Campus Growth \& Partnerships InternHackingly Innovators

**Location:** Jaipur \+ Travel  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹10,000–₹15,000 per month \+ performance incentives  
**Opportunity:** Pre\-placement / Full\-time opportunity after the internship

This is not a typical internship.

At **Hackingly**, we are building a large ecosystem connecting students, developers, professionals, founders, companies, colleges, universities and institutions.

As a **Campus Growth \& Partnerships Intern**, you will not simply be sending emails or making calls.

You will be **building relationships, pitching ideas, developing partnerships, identifying revenue opportunities and helping execute the programs you bring to Hackingly.**

One day, you could be speaking with a college Director. The next, you could be pitching a program to a university, coordinating an event, meeting a community leader or figuring out how an existing institutional relationship can become a larger business opportunity.

If you are someone who enjoys meeting people, dislikes repetitive work and wants to learn business by actually doing it, this internship is for you.

What will you do?

Your journey will broadly be:

**Research → Connect → Pitch → Negotiate → Close → Execute → Grow**

You will:

* Identify colleges, universities, institutes, schools and communities that could work with Hackingly.
* Reach out to decision\-makers and initiate meaningful conversations.
* Understand institutional requirements and identify potential Hackingly solutions.
* Pitch Hackingly's programs, partnerships and offerings.
* Follow up, negotiate and work towards closing paid partnerships.
* Identify opportunities for recurring or larger institutional engagements.
* Coordinate with the internal team to execute the partnerships you help close.
* Support student registrations, institutional outreach and event/program deliverables.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with institutional decision\-makers.
* Track conversations, opportunities and revenue pipelines.
* Explore new ways to convert institutional relationships into sustainable business opportunities.

Revenue mindset is important.

We are not looking for someone who thinks a partnership simply means signing an MoU.

We want someone who can look at an institution and think:

“What problem are they trying to solve, and how can Hackingly solve it as a meaningful business opportunity?”

A workshop could become a hackathon.

A hackathon could become a student chapter.

A student chapter could become an annual institutional partnership.

A single conversation could become a long\-term client.

You should constantly be looking for the next opportunity.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular degree or years of experience.

We care much more about **personality, communication, curiosity, ownership and hunger to learn.**

You should be:

* Extremely comfortable talking to new people.
* Confident communicating with senior decision\-makers.
* Highly energetic and outgoing.
* Curious and commercially minded.
* Comfortable with rejection and persistent follow\-ups.
* Comfortable travelling and meeting people.
* Good at negotiation and persuasion.
* Comfortable working independently.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Interested in sales, business development, partnerships and entrepreneurship.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where every day can look different.

Most importantly:

**You should want to build something, not just complete an internship.**

Why join Hackingly?

This will not be a conventional internship where your work is limited to lead generation.

You will learn how a real business works:

**Lead Generation**  
↓  
**Sales \& Pitching**  
↓  
**Negotiation**  
↓  
**Revenue Closure**  
↓  
**Event Execution**  
↓  
**Relationship Management**  
↓  
**Account Growth**

You will get the opportunity to interact with **Deans, Directors, Placement Heads, Founders, HR leaders, community leaders and other decision\-makers.**

You will also gain exposure to **technology, entrepreneurship, startups, campus ecosystems, events and corporate partnerships.**

What happens after six months?

We want this internship to have a clear growth path.

If you are currently in your final semester:

You can be considered for a **full\-time opportunity after completing six months**, subject to your performance and graduation requirements.

If you are already graduating / have recently graduated:

After six months, based on your performance, your **stipend can be revised**, followed by transition into a **full\-time role once you graduate**.

The objective is simple:

**Intern → Prove yourself → Grow with us → Full\-time opportunity**

Exceptional performance can accelerate this journey.

How will we measure you?

Not simply by how many calls you make.

We will look at:

* Quality of conversations
* Qualified opportunities generated
* Meetings converted
* Partnerships closed
* Revenue generated
* Institutional relationships built
* Repeat and expanded opportunities
* Execution quality
* Ownership and initiative

**Activity is good. Impact is better.**

This role is for you if...

You would rather meet interesting people than sit behind a spreadsheet all day.

You would rather pitch an idea than prepare another presentation.

You would rather work towards closing a real partnership than simply complete a target number of calls.

You would rather travel to a new city and meet a new institution than repeat the same day every day.

And if your mindset is:

“Give me a target, give me the opportunity, and I will figure out how to make it happen.”

Then we want to meet you.

Campus Growth \& Partnerships Intern

**Hackingly Innovators**

**Build relationships. Create opportunities. Drive growth.**

title: Human Resource (HR) Fresher
description:
We are hiring an Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but should also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Core Job Responsibilities**
* HR Data Analysis \& Reporting Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
* Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
* Recruitment Analytics Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
* Workforce Analytics Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
* AI\-Assisted Workflows Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
* Data Interpretation \& Business Insights Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
* HR Operations Support Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
* Automation \& Process Improvement Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
* Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
* Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning.
* Familiarity with Power BI or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language.
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks.
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration.
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data.
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods.


**Preferred Skills**

title: Human Resources Administrator
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **HR Executive / HR Manager** to manage recruitment, candidate screening and first\-round interviews, onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, payroll coordination, employee relations, performance management, HR administration, and applicable HR compliance.

The HR professional will work closely with management, employees, recruiters, and the payroll team to ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR operations.

Candidate Screening \& First\-Round Interviews

* Review and screen resumes before forwarding candidates to management.
* Match candidate skills, qualifications, experience, and background against job requirements.
* Conduct the **first\-round HR interview** for shortlisted candidates.
* Evaluate communication skills, professionalism, experience, attitude, and overall suitability.
* Verify current salary, expected salary, notice period, availability, and preferred work location.
* Ask position\-specific screening questions before scheduling candidates with management or technical teams.
* Review employment history and identify unexplained employment gaps, frequent job changes, or inconsistencies requiring clarification.
* Maintain interview notes and prepare clear candidate summaries for management.
* Forward only qualified and properly screened candidates for technical or management interviews.
* Schedule and coordinate second\-round, technical, and final interviews.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Maintain records of shortlisted, interviewed, selected, rejected, and pending candidates.

Recruitment \& Hiring

* Manage the complete recruitment process from job posting through employee joining.
* Prepare and publish job descriptions on appropriate hiring platforms.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment agencies, referrals, and other recruiting channels.
* Maintain an active candidate pipeline for open positions.
* Coordinate technical and management interviews.
* Conduct reference and background verification when required.
* Discuss compensation and salary expectations within management\-approved ranges.
* Prepare and issue offer letters and appointment letters.
* Coordinate joining dates and pre\-employment requirements.
* Maintain complete recruitment and hiring records.

Employee Onboarding \& Documentation

* Collect and verify required employee documents.
* Prepare employment agreements, NDAs, company policies, and required HR forms.
* Complete employee joining formalities.
* Conduct new\-employee HR orientation.
* Explain working hours, attendance requirements, leave policies, holidays, workplace rules, and company expectations.
* Create and maintain employee personnel files.
* Coordinate allocation and documentation of company laptops, equipment, and other company assets.
* Ensure required employment documents are properly completed and signed.

Attendance \& Leave Management

* Maintain employee attendance, working\-hour, and leave records.
* Monitor employee absences, late arrivals, and unauthorized leave.
* Maintain employee leave balances.
* Process and document leave requests.
* Follow up with employees regarding attendance issues.
* Provide accurate monthly attendance information for payroll processing.
* Maintain holiday and weekly\-off records.

Payroll Coordination

* **Coordinate directly with the payroll team for monthly employee payroll processing.**
* Prepare and provide accurate attendance, leave, salary, bonus, deduction, and other required payroll information.
* Review payroll information for discrepancies before processing.
* **Make sure employee salaries are processed accurately and paid on time.**
* **Verify after each payroll cycle that salary payments have been successfully processed.**
* Follow up with the payroll team regarding any delayed, missing, rejected, or incorrect salary payments.
* Coordinate correction of payroll discrepancies.
* Maintain records of salary revisions, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, and other compensation changes.
* Respond to employee payroll questions and coordinate with the payroll team to resolve issues.
* Maintain appropriate payroll documentation and confidentiality.
* Coordinate **Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)** with the payroll team for departing employees.
* Confirm completion of final payments and applicable settlement documentation.

Employee Relations

* Serve as the primary HR contact for employees.
* Handle employee questions, concerns, and workplace grievances professionally.
* Maintain professional communication between employees and management.
* Help management resolve employee conflicts and workplace issues.
* Communicate company policies and management decisions to employees.
* Address workplace conduct and disciplinary concerns.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding employee and company matters.

Performance Management

* Track employee probation periods.
* Coordinate probation\-period performance reviews with managers.
* Coordinate regular employee performance evaluations.
* Maintain performance\-review documentation.
* Assist management in documenting performance concerns.
* Coordinate Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) when required.
* Track employee progress against performance expectations.
* Maintain records of employee warnings and disciplinary actions.
* Coordinate salary revisions and promotions approved by management.

Employee Termination \& Separation

* Manage employee resignation and termination documentation.
* Coordinate notice periods and last working dates.
* Prepare warning, resignation acceptance, termination, relieving, and experience documentation as applicable.
* Ensure company laptops, equipment, documents, ID cards, and other company property are returned.
* Coordinate removal of company system and account access with the appropriate department.
* Coordinate Full \& Final Settlement with the payroll/accounts team.
* Verify completion of final salary and settlement processing.
* Conduct exit interviews when required.
* Maintain complete employee separation records.

HR Compliance – India

* Maintain HR policies, procedures, and employee records according to applicable Indian employment requirements.
* Coordinate applicable statutory requirements relating to **EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, gratuity, statutory bonus, maternity benefits, leave, and other employment obligations**, where applicable.
* Maintain required employee and statutory documentation.
* Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants, consultants, or legal professionals when necessary.
* Monitor applicable HR and labour requirements and recommend policy updates when necessary.
* Maintain confidentiality and appropriate access controls for employee records.

HR Administration \& Reporting

* Maintain an accurate and updated employee database.
* Maintain employee files and HR documentation.
* Prepare regular HR reports for management.
* Track employee headcount, vacancies, hiring status, attendance, turnover, and employee exits.
* Maintain recruitment and interview reports.
* Track offer acceptance and employee joining status.
* Maintain payroll coordination records.
* Assist management with workforce planning.
* Provide management with regular updates regarding recruitment and employee\-related matters.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field**.
* **3\+ years of HR/recruitment experience preferred.**
* Strong experience in **resume screening and conducting first\-round interviews**.
* Ability to evaluate technical and non\-technical candidates.
* Strong recruitment and candidate\-assessment skills.
* Experience coordinating payroll and employee salary processing.
* Working knowledge of Indian HR practices and applicable employment requirements.
* Experience with onboarding, attendance, leave, performance management, employee relations, and employee separation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, email, job portals, and HR/attendance systems.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to handle confidential employee and payroll information professionally.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with management and other departments.

**About HA\&Co. \& Aegis Ecosystem:**

HA\&Co. is a multi\-segment legal and corporate group focused on building a modern, globally aligned professional ecosystem operating across legal, corporate, strategic, investigation, compliance, research, and emerging technology sectors. With operational presence and expansion initiatives across India, UAE, and the UK, the group is structured to deliver integrated solutions through specialized verticals.

Alongside HA\&Co., the group operates through the developing Aegis ecosystem — a specialized network of focused verticals handling areas such as corporate structuring, investigations, taxation, strategic advisory, research, branding, cyber, AI, digital assets, and cross\-border business support. The organization is built on a high\-performance, execution\-driven model emphasizing professionalism, discipline, innovation, confidentiality, and long\-term institutional growth.

**Role Overview:**

The Talent \& Growth Executive (Legal \& Corporate) will function as a key operational and workforce management pillar across all segments of the HA\&Co. Group, including both Legal and Aegis verticals.

This is not a conventional HR role. The position is designed for individuals capable of executing high\-responsibility operational, recruitment, coordination, and productivity management functions within a fast\-growing legal and corporate ecosystem.

**The role primarily focuses on:**

* Talent acquisition \& strategic hiring
* Workforce productivity monitoring
* Internal coordination \& reporting systems
* Performance discipline \& operational efficiency
* Staff management \& organizational structuring
* Team alignment with the vision, standards, and culture of the firm

The position demands strong execution capability, leadership presence, confidentiality, communication skills, and the ability to maintain a structured and performance\-oriented environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment***

* Handling end\-to\-end recruitment processes across all divisions
* Managing job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination, and onboarding

* Managing hiring platforms such as LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, etc.

***Workforce Management \& Productivity***

* Monitoring staff productivity, responsiveness, and work discipline
* Assisting management in maintaining operational efficiency across teams
* Identifying employee performance gaps and coordinating corrective follow\-ups
* Supporting internal reporting and workflow tracking systems

***HR Operations \& Internal Coordination***

* Maintaining employee records, attendance, leave tracking, and HR documentation
* Coordinating between departments for smooth operational functioning
* Assisting in maintaining internal discipline, reporting structure, and communication flow
* Supporting employee engagement and workplace coordination initiatives

***Growth \& Organizational Support***

* Assisting leadership in workforce expansion and structural planning
* Supporting operational scaling initiatives of the firm in India and international markets
* Contributing towards building a high\-performance organizational culture

**Essential Skills \& Requirements**

***Core Skills***

* Strong communication and coordination abilities
* High organizational discipline and accountability
* Multi\-tasking and execution capability
* Strong follow\-up and management skills
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional ethics
* Leadership presence and workforce handling capability
* Internal coordination and reporting skills
* Ability to identify employee weaknesses and ensure productivity improvement

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Degree in HR / Management / Law / Commerce or related fields
* Experience in HR, recruitment, operations, or administration
* Prior law firm or corporate office experience is an added advantage
* Familiarity with hiring tools and HR systems

***Work Style Expectations***

* Highly execution\-driven and result\-oriented
* Fast response and follow\-up culture
* Ability to work under pressure and deadlines
* Comfortable working in a structured, high\-performance environment
* Strong ownership mindset and operational discipline

**Growth Exposure**

***This role offers direct exposure to:***

* Law firm scaling and organizational structuring
* Cross\-border business operations.
* Leadership\-level operational management
* Multi\-segment legal and corporate ecosystem management
* High\-level recruitment and workforce strategy

**Final Note**

This is a high\-responsibility opportunity intended for serious and growth\-oriented professionals seeking long\-term career development within a rapidly expanding legal and corporate group. The role is ideal for individuals capable of taking ownership, managing people efficiently, and contributing towards the growth vision of the HA\&Co. Group.

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **Talent Acquisition Executive** to join our HR team. The ideal candidate should have **2–4 years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment** and be capable of independently managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening candidates to offer rollout and joining formalities.

The candidate should possess strong communication, coordination, follow\-up, and stakeholder management skills, along with the ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously.

title: Placement Manager
description:
Placement Manager

**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Department:** Career Development \& Placements  
**Reports To:** Managing Director

About the Role

Lakhotia College of Design is looking for a proactive and target\-driven **Placement \& Career Development Manager** to build and manage our placement and internship ecosystem across Fashion Design, Interior Design, Photography, Graphic Design, Event Design and other creative disciplines.

This is not a desk\-based placement coordination role. The person will be responsible for **building relationships with companies, generating internship and job opportunities, coordinating recruitment, preparing students for the industry, and driving measurable placement outcomes.**

Key Responsibilities

**Employer \& Industry Relations**

* Build and maintain relationships with companies, studios, agencies, brands, production houses and other industry employers.
* Identify and approach new employers for internships, jobs, live projects and industry collaborations.
* Conduct regular employer outreach through calls, emails, LinkedIn and professional networks.
* Maintain and continuously expand the LCOD Employer Database.

**Internship Management**

* Identify relevant internship opportunities across all departments.
* Match students with suitable internship opportunities.
* Coordinate applications, interviews, joining and completion.
* Track internship progress and collect employer/student feedback.

**Placement Management**

* Source relevant job openings for LCOD students and graduates.
* Screen and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Coordinate CV/portfolio submissions and interviews.
* Track the complete recruitment pipeline from application to joining.
* Maintain accurate records of offers and actual joining.

**Student Career Development**

* Assess students' career readiness and identify gaps.
* Support students with CVs, portfolios, LinkedIn profiles and interview preparation.
* Conduct mock interviews, portfolio reviews and career guidance sessions.
* Work closely with HODs/faculty to identify suitable candidates for opportunities.

**Data \& Performance Management**

* Maintain the LCOD Placement \& Career Development tracker on a daily basis.
* Record employer contacts, meetings, opportunities, interviews, internships, offers and placements.
* Submit weekly placement reports to management.
* Achieve defined monthly employer, opportunity, interview, internship and placement KPIs.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured on outcomes, including:

* New relevant employer relationships
* Employer meetings and industry interactions
* Job opportunities generated
* Internship opportunities generated
* Student interviews
* Internships secured
* Placement offers
* Student joining conversions
* Employer follow\-up completion
* Accuracy and regularity of placement data

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Excellent at communication and relationship building
* Confident speaking with HR managers, business owners and industry professionals
* Target\-oriented and comfortable with measurable KPIs
* Proactive and capable of generating opportunities independently
* Strong in follow\-up and negotiation
* Organised and comfortable working with Google Sheets/CRM systems
* Comfortable interacting with students as well as industry professionals
* Interested in creative industries such as fashion, interiors, media, photography, design, advertising and events

Experience

**Preferred:** 2–5 years of experience in placements, recruitment, business development, corporate relations, campus hiring, HR recruitment or a similar role.

Candidates with strong **sales/business development or recruitment experience** and excellent communication skills may also be considered.

Important

This role requires significant **outbound employer outreach and relationship building.** Candidates who are comfortable only with administrative placement coordination may not be suitable.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to build the Career \& Placement function of a reputed design institution
* Direct interaction with leading creative\-industry employers
* High ownership and autonomy
* Opportunity to build a strong professional industry network
* Performance\-driven growth

**Job Type:** Full\-time / part time  
**Location:** Hyderabad

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

EHS Officer (Environment, Health \& Safety Officer)

**Department**

Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS)

Hyderabad

Project Manager

**Job Summary**

The EHS Officer is responsible for implementing and monitoring Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) practices across project sites to ensure compliance with company policies, client requirements, and statutory regulations. The role focuses on preventing workplace accidents, promoting a strong safety culture, conducting safety inspections, and ensuring environmental compliance. The EHS Officer works closely with project teams, subcontractors, and clients to maintain a safe and healthy work environment while supporting successful project execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and monitor EHS policies, procedures, and statutory compliance across project sites.
* Conduct daily site safety inspections and identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions.
* Perform risk assessments, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and ensure Permit to Work (PTW) compliance for high\-risk activities.
* Conduct safety inductions, toolbox talks, and awareness training for employees, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and enforce safety standards on site.
* Investigate accidents, incidents, and near misses, prepare reports, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor work at height, hot work, lifting operations, confined space entry, excavation, and electrical safety activities.
* Maintain EHS documentation, statutory records, inspection reports, incident registers, and compliance reports.
* Coordinate emergency response plans, fire safety inspections, first aid arrangements, and mock drills.
* Ensure proper environmental practices, including waste management, pollution control, and housekeeping.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities on EHS\-related matters.

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

title: Head of HR - Compliance & Enforcement
description:
About RVM Beyond

RVM Beyond Private Limited (brands: RVM CAD, RVM Build, RVM Automation) is India's largest company\-owned (non\-franchise) industrial skilling organization. Four operational branches: Faridabad (HQ), Pune, Ahmedabad, Lucknow. Fundraised, profitable since inception, scaling to 8\-10 mega\-campus cities over the next 5 years. Founded and led by a BITS Pilani engineer.

The Role

Own the HR function end\-to\-end for RVM Beyond. This is a compliance and enforcement seat — the HR Bible exists, policies exist, the frameworks are in place. What is missing is disciplined execution. You will run payroll, statutory compliance, warnings, terminations, POSH, grievances, appraisals, and the annual loyalty bonus cycle across four branches. You will be the second decision\-maker on people matters after the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll, Attendance \& Statutory Compliance

Monthly payroll processing across all 4 branches (100\+ employees) with zero disbursement delays.

Attendance and LOP reconciliation.

Statutory payments — PF, ESI, PT, Gratuity — filed on time, every month, no exceptions.

Maintain statutory registers under Shops \& Establishments Act across 4 states.

Handle labour officer visits, inspections, and notices with the CEO informed but not involved.

Constitute and maintain POSH Internal Committees at each branch.

Policy Enforcement \& Discipline

Enforce the RVM HR Bible (74 pages, v4\.2\) as the operating rulebook across all branches.

Draft and issue warning letters, show\-cause notices, termination letters.

Execute terminations end\-to\-end — including full and final settlement, experience letter, NOC.

Handle POSH complaints per the constituted IC process.

Run bond enforcement and recovery for early leavers.

Grievance handling — investigate, document, close within defined timelines.

Performance, Retention \& Loyalty

Annual increment cycle within the 15% org cap and salary bands set by CEO.

Execute the Loyalty Bonus Policy — half\-yearly reviews, milestone tracking, timely payouts.

Career ladder implementation once published — tag every eligible employee, run promotion reviews.

Recruitment Oversight

Oversee HR\-round interviews for all mid\-level and senior hires — the last filter before offer.

Coordinate with Ashutosh (Recruiter) on shortlisting standards and interview logistics.

Own the joining experience — documentation, Day\-1 induction on the HR Bible.

Reporting \& CEO Interface

Weekly HR dashboard to CEO — open cases, headcount changes, statutory calendar, Bible compliance %.

Monthly attrition breakdown by branch and cause.

Quarterly people\-plan review with CEO.

Must\-Have Qualifications

8\-12 years of HR experience with at least 5 years in a compliance/enforcement/operations HR role.

MBA / PGDM in HR from any recognized institute (tier of college is not a filter).

Prior sector: manufacturing, training/skilling, industrial services, engineering firm, plant, or multi\-branch operating company.

Prior company size: 80\-500 employees per role. Not larger, not smaller.

At least one job of 4\+ years tenure in the last 10 years.

Strong labour law knowledge: PF Act, ESI Act, POSH Act, S\&E Act (multi\-state), Payment of Wages, Bonus, Gratuity.

Hands\-on payroll processing experience (any tool — Salary Box, Zoho People, GreytHR, manual).

Multi\-site HR handled — minimum 2 locations in a previous role.

Fluent verbal Hindi and written English.

Named enforcement wins — must be able to walk through at least 2 real terminations executed end\-to\-end.

Nice\-to\-Have

Diploma or certification in labour law (NALSAR, ILI, XLRI open\-course).

Prior experience in a founder\-led or fast\-growing company.

Experience constituting POSH ICs from scratch.

Experience handling labour officer notices or inspection responses.

What We Offer

•

Direct CEO access. Real decision\-making authority — you are the second signature on all people matters.

•

A fully documented HR Bible (v4\.2, 74 pages), Loyalty Bonus Policy, and RACI in place. You will not be building from a blank page.

•

Genuine ownership of the function. Not one player among many.

•

Career growth aligned with company growth (100 → 150 → 300 employees over next 24 months).

•

Above\-market CTC for the Faridabad market at this experience band.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
HR Strategy \& Business Partnership
   

  

* Partner with the General Manager and Heads of Department on all people\-related matters.
* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives.
* Provide HR advice and support to management on employee\-related matters.
* Develop programmes and initiatives that foster a positive, inclusive and high\-performing work environment.
* Support the hotel leadership team in building a strong people and service culture.
* Monitor manpower productivity, staffing levels and organisational requirements.


 Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Planning
   

  

* Work with department heads to identify manpower requirements.
* Manage recruitment and selection processes in line with approved manning and budgets.
* Prepare and maintain manpower plans and recruitment trackers.
* Ensure timely hiring of quality candidates across all departments.
* Coordinate interviews, selection, reference checks and background verification.
* Ensure appropriate offer, joining and onboarding documentation.
* Maintain effective relationships with recruitment agencies, institutions and other talent sources.
* Support internal mobility, transfers and career opportunities within IHG.


 New Joiner Experience \& Onboarding
   

  

* Welcome and orient new colleagues to the hotel and IHG.
* Conduct HR induction and ensure completion of joining formalities.
* Ensure colleagues understand hotel policies, procedures, benefits, code of conduct and IHG values.
* Coordinate departmental induction and job\-specific orientation.
* Ensure all employee documentation is complete and maintained accurately.
* Create a positive first\-day and onboarding experience for new colleagues.


 Employee Engagement \& Culture
   

  

* Develop creative initiatives to engage, inspire and motivate colleagues.
* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations and recognition programmes.
* Support and administer the annual Team Member Satisfaction Survey and develop action plans based on results.
* Monitor employee feedback and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular employee interactions and engagement forums.
* Promote a culture of trust, respect, inclusion and collaboration.
* Recognise and celebrate employee achievements and contributions.
* Support IHG wellbeing initiatives and promote colleague wellbeing.


 Employee Relations
   

  

* Act as a trusted point of contact for colleagues on HR\-related matters.
* Address employee concerns, grievances and workplace issues professionally and confidentially.
* Support management in disciplinary and performance\-related matters.
* Ensure fair, consistent and transparent application of HR policies.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyse employee feedback and reasons for separation.
* Monitor employee turnover and develop retention initiatives.
* Maintain positive employee relations and a healthy workplace environment.


 Learning \& Development
   

  

* Identify training needs in consultation with department heads.
* Prepare and monitor the annual training calendar.
* Coordinate induction, mandatory and operational training programmes.
* Promote IHG learning platforms and development programmes.
* Support leadership development and succession planning.
* Encourage cross\-training and career development opportunities.
* Monitor training completion and maintain appropriate records.
* Support the development of colleagues through the IHG Room to Grow philosophy.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Coordinate the hotel's performance management process.
* Ensure timely completion of probation reviews and performance evaluations.
* Support managers in setting clear performance objectives.
* Coach managers on performance improvement and employee development.
* Monitor Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Support succession planning and talent identification.
* Encourage continuous feedback and development conversations.


 Payroll \& HR Administration
   

  

* Coordinate monthly payroll activities with Finance and ensure accurate employee data.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
* Ensure timely processing of salary, deductions and statutory contributions.
* Monitor attendance, overtime, leave and payroll\-related discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate employee files and HR documentation.
* Ensure HR reports and dashboards are updated and submitted on time.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and payroll information.


 Local Law \& Statutory Compliance
   

  

 Ensure compliance with all applicable
 **Central Government, Goa State and local employment laws and statutory requirements** 
 , including, as applicable:
   

  

* Applicable wage and employment requirements
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employees' State Insurance (ESI)
* Professional Tax, where applicable
* Labour Welfare Fund, where applicable
* Gratuity requirements
* Bonus requirements
* Maternity Benefit requirements
* POSH / Prevention of Sexual Harassment requirements
* Shops \& Establishments / applicable establishment regulations
* Working hours, weekly off and leave requirements
* Contract Labour requirements
* Child labour and employment eligibility requirements
* Applicable Goa\-specific labour and employment regulations


 Additional responsibilities include:
   

  

* Maintain statutory registers, records and returns as required.
* Ensure timely payment and filing of statutory dues and returns.
* Coordinate labour inspections and statutory audits.
* Work with external consultants and authorities when required.
* Ensure employment documentation and HR practices remain compliant with applicable laws.
* Keep management updated on significant changes in employment legislation.


 HR Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

 Prepare and analyse regular HR reports including:
   

  

* Headcount and manpower status, Recruitment status, Attrition, Absenteeism, Payroll cost, Overtime, Employee turnover, Training hours and completion, Employee engagement, Diversity and inclusion, Leave utilisation, Pending HR actions
* Provide meaningful HR insights and recommendations to the General Manager and leadership team.


 Employee Welfare \& Wellbeing
   

  

* Promote colleague wellbeing and work\-life balance.
* Coordinate employee welfare initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate employee facilities and welfare provisions are available.
* Support IHG wellbeing programmes.
* Monitor employee accommodation, meals, uniforms, lockers and other welfare facilities, where applicable.
* Organise health, safety and wellbeing awareness initiatives.
* Encourage a workplace culture where colleagues feel supported and valued.


 Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion
   

  

* Promote an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect.
* Support IHG's commitment to equal employment opportunities.
* Encourage diversity across recruitment, development and career progression.
* Ensure employment decisions are based on merit, capability and business requirements.
* Promote a culture where colleagues feel they belong and are encouraged to contribute.


 HR Audit \& Risk Management
   

  

* Conduct regular HR audits and compliance reviews.
* Ensure employee files and statutory documentation are complete and accurate.
* Identify HR risks and implement corrective actions.
* Support IHG, internal, statutory and external audits.
* Track and close audit observations within agreed timelines.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for employee data and confidential information.


 HR Responsibilities
   

  

 For the opening of
 **Holiday Inn Express Goa Morjim** 
 , the HR Manager will additionally be responsible for:
   

  

* Developing the manpower plan.
* Coordinating recruitment against approved manning.
* Preparing the recruitment and joining calendar.
* Supporting sourcing and selection of the opening team.
* Coordinating joining documentation and background verification.
* Developing the opening HR action plan.
* Establishing HR policies, SOPs and administrative processes.
* Coordinating uniforms, ID cards, lockers and employee facilities.
* Setting up employee files and HR records.
* Coordinating payroll and HR system setup.
* Planning hotel opening induction and training.
* Coordinating culture\-building and team engagement activities.
* Ensuring statutory registrations and HR compliance requirements are completed before opening.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

* Manpower budget and productivity
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Employee retention and attrition
* Employee engagement / Team Member Satisfaction Survey
* Training completion
* Performance management compliance
* Payroll accuracy and timeliness
* Statutory compliance
* HR audit performance
* Employee relations and grievance resolution
* Absenteeism and overtime control
* Succession planning and internal promotions
* Employee wellbeing and engagement


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree / higher education qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hotel Management or a related field.
* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources / MBA HR will be an advantage.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.


**Experience**
* Minimum 4–6 years of relevant Human Resources experience, preferably in the hospitality industry.
* Previous experience in a supervisory HR role is preferred.
* Experience in a branded hotel environment will be an advantage.
* Pre\-opening hotel experience will be highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of hotel HR operations, employee relations, recruitment and statutory compliance.


**Language**
* Fluent spoken and written English is required.
* Hindi and knowledge of local language(s) will be an advantage.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* People leadership
* Business partnering
* Employee relations
* Communication and interpersonal skills
* Recruitment and talent management
* Coaching and development
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Planning and organisation
* Confidentiality and integrity
* Labour\-law awareness
* Employee engagement
* Commercial and business understanding
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced hotel environment


 IHG True Hospitality
   

  

 We genuinely care about people and demonstrate this through our commitment to
 **True Hospitality** 
 every day.
   

  

 The HR Manager is expected to demonstrate:
   

  

**True Attitude** 
 – Be caring, approachable and committed to making a positive difference to colleagues.
   

  

**True Confidence** 
 – Have the knowledge and skills to provide clear and professional HR guidance.
   

  

**True Listening** 
 – Listen carefully to colleagues, understand their concerns and respond appropriately.
   

  

**True Responsiveness** 
 – Take timely and effective action to support colleagues and the business.
   

  

 The role is about creating a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported and empowered to deliver exceptional experiences to our guests.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits
* IHG colleague room discounts
* Uniform as per hotel standards
* Learning and development opportunities
* Career growth within IHG Hotels \& Resorts
* Employee wellbeing initiatives
* Inclusive and collaborative working environment
* Opportunity to be part of the upcoming and growth journey of Holiday Inn Express Goa Morjim


 Our Commitment
   

  

 IHG Hotels \& Resorts is committed to creating inclusive teams where we celebrate differences and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

 We provide equal employment opportunities and promote a culture of trust, support, acceptance and respect, welcoming different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
   

  

 Every colleague should have the
 **room to belong, grow and make a difference** 
 .
   

  

 Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

description:
**Description**
 The Music Catalog Quality team is seeking a passionate and talented Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) to join us. The Music Catalog Quality team is on a mission to enable accurate, complete, and enriched music metadata and content across the Amazon Music catalog. Our team is responsible for detecting, correcting, and enriching catalog metadata in real\-time, leveraging technologies such as large language models (LLMs), computer vision, natural language processing, deep learning classifiers, and related methods.
   

  

 Our mission is to provide high\-quality, dynamically validated and enriched catalog metadata with low latencies across the Amazon Music experience. We automate the detection and correction of metadata anomalies, including misattributed tracks, duplicate content, incorrect artist information, and incomplete album details, while providing internal teams with the tools and flexibility to continuously improve catalog integrity at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, build, and operate scalable machine learning pipelines and online serving systems
* Work closely with applied scientists to optimize ML model performance and implement end\-to\-end solutions from experimentation through production
* Drive technology choices and continuous innovation for ML infrastructure across the sponsored products organization
* Collaborate with product managers, scientists, and engineers to deliver the right product for customers
* Build and maintain strong relationships across partner disciplines (Product, Science and Engg) to ensure customer\-focused delivery
* Contribute to operational excellence \- monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting high\-volume, low\-latency systems


**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.

* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

Tech Guru IT Solutions is building an inside sales desk at its Nehru Place office and is hiring two Inside Sales Executives to run it.

title: Customer Success & Support Executive
description:
**Company Description:**

IndustryPrime is a SaaS platform built for manufacturing companies to manage their procurement and inventory in one place.

We help factories move away from Excel, Registers, and WhatsApp\-based workflows to a simple, transparent, and automated system that improves control, reduces costs, and saves time.

Today, 70\+ companies across India trust IndustryPrime to run their plant operations smoothly.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Most of our clients use only a small part of what IndustryPrime can do, and many don't use it the right way.

Explaining things over a phone call rarely leads to real change.

The biggest impact comes from visiting clients in person: understanding how they work, showing them what they're missing, and helping them use IndustryPrime more effectively.

The goal of this role is simple: make sure every client gets the maximum value from IndustryPrime.

You'll work closely with client teams, meet their management, identify gaps in adoption, and help them fix those gaps.

**Role Overview:**

This is a high\-ownership, client\-facing, travel\-heavy role where you will be responsible for:

● Proactively visiting clients to review their actual usage against the full capability of the platform, and closing that gap

● Onboarding new companies onto IndustryPrime, end to end

● Handling day\-to\-day client support, since deep adoption work requires deep product knowledge anyway

● Building the kind of relationship with client management and teams that turns into renewals and referrals

You will act as a consultant, trainer, and relationship owner for our clients, not simply someone who closes tickets.

(Open to freshers and experienced candidates alike; what matters more here is energy and ownership than years on a resume)

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Adoption \& Client Experience Enhancement (Core Focus)***

● Travel to client sites, including outstation manufacturing plants, proactively and on short notice

● Review each client's actual usage of the platform and identify features they aren't using, or are using incorrectly

● Sit with the client's team and management to demonstrate the value of full adoption in terms they care about (time saved, control gained, cost avoided)

● Pitch and push under\-used features directly to decision\-makers, not just end\-users

***Client Onboarding (New Companies)***

● Understand the client's current purchase \& inventory workflow

● Set up their system on IndustryPrime (items, users, permissions, etc.)

● Conduct onboarding sessions and product training, in person where needed

● Ensure a smooth transition from manual systems (Excel / Registers) to the software

● Take ownership until the client is fully live, comfortable, and actually using the product well

***Customer Support (Existing Clients)***

● Handle client queries via call/WhatsApp/email

● Resolve day\-to\-day operational issues on the platform

● Guide users on best practices within the software

● Ensure timely follow\-ups and issue closure

***Internal Coordination***

● Work closely with the product/tech team to report bugs or improvements

● Share real client feedback, especially patterns in what clients don't adopt and why, to improve the product

● Help refine onboarding, training, and adoption\-tracking processes

**What We're Looking For:**

***Attitude \& Energy***

● Someone who takes it personally when a client is not using the software properly, and acts with urgency rather than waiting for it to become a bigger problem

● High energy, and genuinely comfortable with outstation travel (sometimes on short notice)

● An "adjusting," no\-excuses attitude toward travel and changing plans. Delayed trains, last\-minute reschedules, and remote locations should not upset you

***Skills***

● A naturally assertive person who can push a client toward what's good for them, respectfully but firmly, rather than just agreeing with whatever they say

● Strong communication skills (Hindi \+ English required), and specifically the confidence to present to factory owners and senior management, not just operators

● Ability to explain in a simple, practical way

● You actively use AI tools (beyond just chatbots) to work smarter (we will be keen on seeing it during interview)

***Ways of Working***

● Quick learner, able to understand the product deeply enough to spot what a client should be using and isn't

● Being the one who follows up before the client even realizes there's a gap

**What You'll Learn**

● Deep understanding of how manufacturing businesses operate

● Real\-world purchase \& inventory workflows

● How to drive product adoption and manage client relationships at the management level

● SaaS implementation \& client management

● Problem\-solving skills

**Why Join IndustryPrime:**

● Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 (depending on experience) (flexible with salary if you have good experience) (Travel days are compensated separately)

● Work directly with founders and the core team

● High ownership from Day 1

● Real impact: you will directly improve how factories operate

● Fast learning curve in both business \& SaaS

● Frequent travel across India, including to plant locations most people never get to see

**If you're someone who's energized by getting in front of a client rather than staying on the phone and who sees a client relationship as something to actively grow rather than just maintain, we want to meet you.**

title: 3D Designer – Exhibition & Space Design
description:
**Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly capable and technically proficient 3D Artist specializing in Exhibition Stall and Space Design to join our design team. The ideal candidate should possess a strong combination of creative visualization, technical understanding, spatial awareness, and practical knowledge of exhibition fabrication and execution.
 



 We follow an established space design pipeline and workflow, and the selected candidate will be expected to work seamlessly within this system while taking ownership of the complete 3D requirements for exhibition projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Develop sophisticated and visually compelling 3D exhibition stall and spatial designs based on project briefs, brand guidelines, site dimensions, and functional requirements.
 



 • Take complete ownership of the 3D design process, from initial interpretation of the brief through design development, visualization, revisions, and final presentation.
 



 • Adhere to the existing design pipeline, production workflow, and quality standards followed by the organization.
 



 • Translate conceptual ideas into technically sound, dimensionally accurate, and practically executable 3D environments.
 



 • Demonstrate a strong understanding of exhibition structures, fabrication techniques, construction methodologies, materials, finishes, and spatial limitations.
 



 • Evaluate the technical feasibility of proposed designs, identifying potential structural, fabrication, or execution\-related limitations at the design stage itself.
 



 • Ensure that proposed designs can be realistically fabricated, assembled, and executed on\-site without compromising the intended creative vision.
 



 • Develop accurate 3D models with appropriate proportions, dimensions, clearances, structural logic, material specifications, and detailing.
 



 • Produce high\-quality, photorealistic renders suitable for client presentations, internal reviews, and project approvals.
 



 • Handle design iterations and modifications efficiently based on client feedback, technical requirements, site constraints, and execution considerations.
 



 • Coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, production teams, fabricators, and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 • Maintain clear and consistent communication to ensure there are no gaps in understanding, execution, or project requirements.
 



 • Proactively identify design or technical challenges and provide practical, solution\-oriented alternatives.
 



 • Manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining consistency in design quality and accuracy.
 



  





**Software Proficiency** 




 Blender is our primary 3D software and forms an integral part of our existing production pipeline.
 



 The candidate must have strong working knowledge of Blender, particularly in:
 



 • Advanced 3D modelling
 



 • Exhibition stall and spatial modelling
 



 • Material creation and texturing
 



 • Lighting and scene development
 



 • Camera composition
 



 • High\-quality rendering
 



 • Realistic visualization
 



 • Design iterations and modifications
 



 Familiarity with additional 3D, rendering, or visualization software will be considered an advantage.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 




 • Minimum 1\+ year of professional experience in Exhibition Stall Design, Space Design, Interior Visualization, or a closely related field.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in designing and visualizing exhibition stalls or commercial spaces.
 



 • Strong understanding of structural systems, fabrication processes, materials, and on\-site execution.
 



 • Ability to interpret technical drawings, spatial dimensions, and project requirements accurately.
 



 • Practical understanding of what is structurally and technically feasible within an exhibition environment.
 



 • Strong portfolio demonstrating relevant exhibition, spatial, architectural, or commercial design work.
 



  





**Core Competencies** 




 Technical \& Structural Understanding\-
 



 The candidate should possess a practical understanding of how exhibition structures are designed, fabricated, assembled, and executed. The ability to distinguish between a visually impressive concept and a genuinely buildable solution is essential.
 



 High\-Quality Visualization\-
 



 A strong command of lighting, materials, textures, composition, camera perspective, and rendering techniques is expected. The candidate should be capable of producing polished, realistic, and presentation\-ready visualizations.
 



 Multitasking \& Project Management\-
 



 The role requires the ability to handle multiple stall requirements and parallel assignments without losing attention to detail. The candidate should be capable of prioritizing tasks, managing revisions, and consistently meeting project deadlines.
 



 Communication \& Collaboration\-
 



 Clear and effective communication is a critical requirement. The candidate must be able to understand briefs accurately, communicate technical limitations, raise concerns proactively, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and execution partners.
 



 Problem\-Solving Ability\-
 



 The candidate should approach design challenges with a solution\-oriented mindset and be capable of independently identifying technical issues and proposing viable alternatives.
 



 Attention to Detail\-
 



 Precision in dimensions, proportions, structural elements, materials, finishes, lighting, and overall presentation is essential.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 We are not looking for a general\-purpose 3D artist.
 



 We are specifically looking for a professional who understands the unique requirements of Exhibition Stall and Space Design and can bridge the gap between creative visualization and real\-world execution.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to look at a design and immediately consider:
 



 “Is this technically feasible? Can this structure actually be fabricated and executed?”
 



 The selected candidate will be responsible for handling diverse exhibition stall requirements while working within our established design pipeline. They should be technically sound, creatively capable, comfortable with Blender, proficient in high\-quality rendering, capable of managing multiple assignments, and highly reliable in communication and execution.
 


* Ultimately, we are looking for an individual who can conceptualize, model, visualize, technically evaluate, communicate, and deliver exhibition spaces that are both visually compelling and practically executable.
