title: AI Product Builder
description:
**The Short Version**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 An AI Product Builder who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage — and is excited to use AI to turn ideas into working solutions. You’re someone who likes getting your hands dirty, experimenting with new tools, and building and testing solutions quickly, with a strong bias toward action and real\-world validation.
 



  





**What the role is about:** 
 At Kraftshala, you’ll work on problems across student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. You’ll identify opportunities, figure out what to build, and use AI, automation, and modern tools to turn ideas into working products, workflows, and systems. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions from prototype to production.
 



  





**What makes this role meaningful:** 
 Rather than spending most of your time writing requirements or waiting for development cycles, you’ll be expected to experiment, prototype, ship, and learn quickly.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 




  




* ***Build things that actually get used —***
 products, tools, workflows, and automations that solve real problems for students and teams at Kraftshala.
* ***Go from idea to working solution fast —***
 use AI and modern development tools to prototype, test, and ship instead of waiting around for long development cycles.
* ***Own problems, not just tasks —***
 take an idea from identifying the problem to building the solution and seeing what impact it creates.
* ***Work on problems that matter —***
 across student experience, revenue, and internal operations, alongside product, engineering, and business teams.
* ***Get to build across the stack —***
 from understanding users and business problems to prototyping, testing, and shipping solutions with AI and modern technology.



  





 If you’re someone who sees a problem and immediately wants to figure out how to build a better way, this role is for you.
 



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India’s largest higher\-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The Detailed Version**




  





 As an AI Product Builder at Kraftshala, you’ll be at the intersection of product, technology, and business. You’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to understand how they work, spot opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that make a meaningful difference.
 



 You’ll be expected to move quickly from understanding to experimentation — using AI and modern tools to explore different approaches, build prototypes, and learn what works. As solutions take shape, you’ll work with the right teams to refine, scale, and improve them.
 



  





 A core expectation in this role is the ability to build quickly and learn through experimentation — using AI\-assisted development, LLMs, APIs, integrations, automation, and modular systems to turn ideas into usable solutions, validate them in real contexts, and iterate based on what you learn.
 



  





**What you’ll own:** 




  




* Find \& Understand Problems: Work with users and teams to identify meaningful problems, understand what’s causing them, and figure out what is worth solving.
* Build \& Prototype: Turn ideas into working prototypes, tools, workflows, and automations using AI and modern development tools.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments shipped
* Test \& Iterate: Put what you build in front of real users, learn from feedback and data, and improve the solution based on what you learn.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Adoption, iteration velocity, solution effectiveness
* Ship \& Improve: Work with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions into production and continuously improve them based on usage and impact.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Delivery speed, adoption, business impact



  





**How you’ll operate:** 




  




* You move fluidly between understanding the problem and building the solution
* You use AI as a force multiplier across research, prototyping, development, and execution
* You default to building and testing, rather than spending too long planning
* You’re comfortable trying things that may not work and iterating quickly
* You prioritize speed to insight and usable output over perfect upfront planning
* You think in systems, not just features
* You care about what happens after something is built — adoption, impact, and outcomes



  





**Monthly Outcomes**




  





**Month 1:** 



* Build a strong understanding of Kraftshala’s users, systems, and business priorities
* Identify and validate meaningful problems worth solving
* Build and ship at least one small prototype, automation, or workflow improvement



  





**Month 2:** 



* Own a problem from understanding to solution
* Build, test, and iterate on prototypes using AI and modern tools
* Ship at least one meaningful product, workflow, or automation improvement



  





**Month 3\+:** 



* Take on increasingly complex problems and build solutions with greater autonomy
* Run faster build\-test\-learn cycles and improve what you ship based on real\-world feedback
* Deliver solutions that create measurable improvements in user experience, revenue, or operational efficiency



  





**Must Haves:**




  




* 1–2 years of experience in Product, a builder, technical, or closely related role — startup experience is a plus. (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Have built and shipped something — a digital product, tool, prototype, workflow, automation, or similar.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development, APIs, automation, no\-code/low\-code, or modern development tools.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a bias for action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast\-moving contexts.
* Strong user empathy, product intuition, and communication skills.



  





**Selection Process:**




  





 As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes.
 



  





**Setting Expectations:** 
 This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
 



**Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
 



**Conversation 1:** 
 This will be a detailed assessment review conversation to go over your submission for the technical exercise along with other competencies required for the role.
 



**Conversation 2:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.
 



**Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.
 



  





**Location:**




 Delhi
 



  





 Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Product Manager** 
 to lead the development and evolution of an AI\-native B2B product designed for complex engineering, tendering and document\-intensive business workflows.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine product\-management capability with practical domain understanding. You will work directly with enterprise users, product designers, business analysts, AI engineers and software\-development teams to identify customer problems, define the roadmap and convert domain workflows into scalable product capabilities.
 



  





**Professional experience in at least one of the following sectors is mandatory:** 



* Water and wastewater infrastructure
* Electrical or modular infrastructure
* Data centres
* Industrial manufacturing



  





 Relevant experience may come from working within these industries, supporting EPC or engineering projects, managing bids and proposals, or developing technology products for these sectors.
 



 This is a product\-ownership role—not solely a project\-coordination position. You will be accountable for what the product should solve, what gets prioritised and the outcomes delivered to customers.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Develop a deep understanding of users, industry workflows and operational challenges within the target sectors.
* Conduct discovery sessions with bid, proposal, estimating, engineering, commercial, contracts and management teams.
* Map complex workflows involving tender review, qualification, compliance, risk, estimating, proposals, approvals and contract handover.
* Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities and release objectives.
* Translate customer and domain problems into clearly defined product opportunities and use cases.
* Prioritise features based on customer value, domain relevance, market opportunity, technical effort and scalability.
* Distinguish between customer\-specific requests and capabilities that should become part of the core product.
* Work with the Product Business Analyst to define requirements, business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Product Designers to create intuitive workflows, prototypes and enterprise\-product experiences.
* Partner with AI and engineering teams to assess feasibility, define expected behaviour and make product trade\-offs.
* Define how AI should assist users while maintaining accuracy, transparency, reviewability and human control.
* Manage the product backlog and ensure requirements and priorities are clearly understood by the development team.
* Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, product demonstrations and release\-readiness reviews.
* Engage directly with customers during product demonstrations and pilots.
* Capture structured feedback from pilots and convert validated learning into product improvements.
* Define and track product metrics such as adoption, feature usage, workflow completion, time saved and customer outcomes.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to strengthen product differentiation.
* Support Product Marketing and Sales with positioning, use cases, demonstrations, launches and sales\-enablement material.
* Ensure product decisions consider enterprise requirements such as security, permissions, auditability, integrations and deployment.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* **Mandatory** 
 professional experience in at least one of these sectors: water and wastewater infrastructure, electrical or modular infrastructure, data centres, or industrial manufacturing.
* 2–5 years of experience in Product Management, preferably involving B2B SaaS, enterprise software or workflow platforms.
* Demonstrated experience taking a software product or major feature from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Understanding of engineering, EPC, tendering, proposal, estimating, commercial or contract\-related workflows.
* Strong capability in customer discovery, problem definition, roadmap planning and feature prioritisation.
* Experience managing complex business workflows and document\-intensive enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate industry problems into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working with product designers, business analysts, engineering, AI and QA teams.
* Strong understanding of agile product\-development practices, backlog management and release planning.
* Experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases and product\-success metrics.
* Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts, enterprise customers, senior stakeholders and technical teams.
* Ability to challenge customer requests constructively and protect the long\-term scalability of the product.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* A track record of ownership, independent decision\-making and cross\-functional leadership.



  





 Experience with AI/LLM\-enabled products, document intelligence, knowledge systems or workflow automation would be highly valuable.

description:
**Job Title:** 
 UI/UX Designer
 



**Experience:** 
 0–3 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (India)
 



**Company:** 
 Goodspace (Noida)
 



**CTC:** 
 ₹8–12 LPA
 



  





**About Goodspace** 




 Goodspace is building AI\-powered products that help professionals discover better career opportunities and help companies hire faster. We're looking for designers who care deeply about user experience and want to build products used by real users at scale.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design intuitive and engaging experiences for web and mobile products.
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs.
* Translate product requirements into simple and effective user experiences.

* 0–3 years of experience; freshers with strong portfolios are welcome.

* Experience designing SaaS, consumer, or AI products.

* **₹8–12 LPA CTC**

description:
**Company Description** 
 Real Jobs Consulting Services is a Gurgaon\-based placement firm known for dependable and high\-quality recruitment solutions. The organization offers a wide range of services including HR consultancy, placement consultancy, manpower recruitment, domestic placement, career consultancy, and work\-from\-home opportunities. A team of experienced consultants focuses on helping client organizations unlock their business potential through strategic HR and talent solutions. The consultants are well\-versed in placement operations and have supported numerous companies and professionals across Gurgaon. Applicants joining Real Jobs Consulting Services can expect a professional environment focused on client success and meaningful career growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Content Creator will be responsible for developing clear, engaging, and relevant content that supports Real Jobs Consulting Services’ brand, services, and client communication. In this full\-time on\-site role based in Delhi, India, the Content Creator will produce content for websites, social media, blogs, marketing campaigns, and internal communication. Daily tasks include researching industry trends, drafting and editing written materials, creating visual or multimedia content in collaboration with designers, and optimizing content for digital platforms. The role also involves maintaining a consistent tone of voice, updating existing content to reflect current offerings, and coordinating with the HR and consulting teams to translate service information into accessible and appealing messaging. The Content Creator will track content performance and suggest improvements to enhance audience engagement and lead generation.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in web content writing, blog writing, and social media content creation.
* Ability to develop content strategies aligned with marketing and business objectives.
* Proficiency in researching industry topics and translating complex information into clear, user\-friendly content.
* Solid writing, editing, and proofreading skills with attention to grammar, structure, and tone.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing principles, including SEO, content distribution, and audience engagement.
* Familiarity with creating or coordinating visual and multimedia content (graphics, short videos, presentations) is an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Hindi or other regional languages is a plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, English, or a related field preferred; relevant experience may substitute.
* Prior experience in recruitment, HR services, or consultancy environments is beneficial but not mandatory.

title: UI/UX Engineer
description:
**About Uplevyl** 




 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women. Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women). We work with mission\-driven partners to turn complex, high\-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact.
 



  





 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent. AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train.
 



  





 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper. That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Our website is our front door. Almost everyone who meets our founder goes there next, and over the coming months that traffic arrives on the back of a Forbes piece, an industry award, and a Financial Times feature. What those visitors find cannot merely be tidy. It has to look like it was made by someone with taste, and it has to carry a story no one else is telling.
 



  





 You own that, and more than that. You are the design function at Uplevyl: the website, the interfaces inside UpGenie, WeHub, and UpSocial, the brand itself, and the investor and partnership material that goes into rooms we are not in.
 



  





 What makes this role unusual is that you build what you design. We are not looking for someone who produces a file and hands it to engineering; the gap between those two people is where quality has died for us before. You work in Framer today, and you will move into the codebase as the site grows. The interactive pieces are yours end to end: a chart a reader clicks into rather than watches, a hero that answers a cursor, a section that assembles as you scroll. Being able to build something like that quickly, and build it well, is not a bonus skill in this role. It is the job, and it is the first thing we look for.
 
  
 




  





 It helps to know what we are trying to make. Uplevyl’s work is recovering knowledge about women that was never collected, or was collected and then lost. Our site is meant to be the first small instance of that idea: more than twenty works by historical women artists woven through it and properly attributed, because when we went looking for a site that already did this, there wasn’t one. The whole thing should read like a good technology magazine — feminine without being decorative, art and engineering in the same frame, closer to something etched in glass than printed on paper. That is a real design problem, and it is the interesting part of this job.
 
  
 




  





**What you’ll own** 



* **The website, end\-to\-end.** 
 Structure, layout, typography, motion, and the copy when the copy is the thing that is wrong. You publish it, you test it on desktop and mobile, and you test it in Safari, because most of the people we build for are on Safari.
* **Interactive work that feels alive.** 
 The magazine version of our site: case data rendered as colored stripes a mathematically\-minded reader understands on sight, a panel that opens onto one woman’s story and closes back into the page, visualizations a reader moves through rather than watches. You build these in days, not quarters.
* **Product interfaces and the system underneath them.** 
 UpGenie, WeHub, and UpSocial are live products with real users and recurring design bugs. Own the design system and component library that end them, and set the standard for what our product looks like when someone who does this for a living opens it.
* **The brand and the assets that carry it.** 
 Logo, type, palette, and the investor decks, capability statements, brochures, and campaign creative that represent us when we are not in the room. Keep them recognizably Uplevyl even when three of them are due the same day.
* **The quality bar itself.** 
 Whether things line up, whether a card breaks the pattern, whether the text sits right — these are calls only a sharp, trained eye can make. Nothing leaves you that a founder has to catch. You are the last person who looks, and you look properly.
* **A cadence the team can rely on.** 
 Changes compiled Monday, pushed Wednesday, tested Thursday, live Friday. Page owners across the company come to you, and you make the result read as one thing.



  





**Who we’re looking for** 




 We are not looking for a UI/UX designer, and we are not looking for a front\-end developer who executes a mock. We want the rarer person who is honestly both: understands art, understands engineering, and would be bored doing only one of them. We hire across levels. The portfolio decides, not the years.
 



  




* **You build high\-end interactive and animated work, fast.** 
 This is the gate. Show us a piece that would normally take a team much longer than it took you — an interactive visualization, a generative or motion piece, a scroll experience — and be able to walk us through how you pulled it off. If you cannot do this, nothing else in the application will make up for it.
* **An eye that is almost uncomfortable.** 
 You notice the four\-pixel gap, the card that breaks the grid, the clipped descender, the animation that stutters on someone else’s machine. You notice it first, because the alternative is that our CEO notices it first.
* **You ship code.** 
 Framer now; React, CSS, and whatever the motion asks for — GSAP, Three.js, WebGL, SVG — as the site moves into the repository. You are at home in a codebase and in a browser’s dev tools.
* **You read the content, not just the layout.** 
 Hand you a dense page about jurisdictional employment law or wealth advisory and you work out what it is trying to say, then design something that says it better. When the words are the problem, you say so and offer a fix.
* **Taste with an argument behind it.** 
 You can hold “feminine” and “serious technology” in one design without collapsing into either. You have references, opinions about those references, and reasons for a choice beyond liking it.
* **High agency.** 
 There is no design team below you and no brief waiting on your desk. You take a surface, own it, finish it, and tell us it is done.
* **Outcomes over hours.** 
 We care about what shipped and how good it was.



  





**Even better if** 



* You came to design sideways — through finance, engineering, marketing, growth, or something else entirely. Some of the strongest people we have looked at did.
* You have a real practice in generative art, WebGL or Three.js, motion design, or data visualization.
* You have built and maintained a design system or component library in production.
* You have worked in Framer, Webflow, Replit, Lovable, or similar, and you know where each one stops.
* You have built a brand from nothing: identity, logo, type system, the lot.
* You have worked in mission\-driven, social\-impact, women\-focused, or nonprofit ecosystems.
* You have founder, startup operator, or early\-employee experience.



  





**Before you apply** 




 We want to be direct about what this is. You would be the only designer here, working closely with our founders, whose feedback is immediate, specific, and not softened. Careless work is the one thing that does not survive at Uplevyl, and if you would find that exhausting rather than clarifying, this is not the right fit, and that is fine. It is also a role with unusual room: nobody is going to tell you which typeface, which motion, or which idea. That part is yours.
 



  





 Send us a portfolio. With it, send two things: one piece where you used AI to make something you could not have made otherwise, with a short note on how you did it; and your answer to a question we ask everyone — if budget were no object, what tool would you buy tomorrow, and what would you do with it?
 



  





 The work is demanding, the expectations are real, and the rewards, in compensation, in ownership, and in what you will learn, match them. Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation.
 



  





**How we work at Uplevyl** 



* **We finish what we start, and we do it well.** 
 We follow through on what we say we’ll do, and we care about the difference our work makes.
* **We listen before we decide.** 
 Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way, by consistently showing up for people.
* **We move with ownership and urgency.** 
 We don’t wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality.
* **We’re better together than alone.** 
 We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed. Leadership here is measured by the impact you create.
* **We stay curious and keep learning, including how to use AI well.** 
 We hold ourselves to the bar we’re building toward: questioning our own assumptions and using AI to think better and move faster.

 We are seeking an experienced Front\-End Developer to lead the development of Duruper.com. This role focuses on creating a responsive and user\-friendly interface for a global audience, particularly targeting users in India. The ideal candidate will have expertise in modern front\-end technologies and a strong ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality, scalable web applications.

* Lead and manage the front\-end development of Duruper.com, ensuring a responsive and user\-friendly interface.

* Solid understanding of business logic and efficient development methods aligned with business goals.

 Do you shop on Amazon? Have you ever browsed a product detail page, scrolled through images, compared prices, checked delivery dates, and then clicked "Add to Cart"? That entire experience? Our team builds it.
   

  

 The Product \& Offers Experience organization is responsible for building the world's best product evaluation and discovery experiences for Amazon shoppers. We own the experiences that help hundreds of millions of customers worldwide make confident purchase decisions, from the moment they land on a product page to the moment they add to cart. Our work spans offer selection, offer display, pricing presentation, and the rich product information that surrounds the buy box. As the worldwide product showroom for the "everything store," we directly drive the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon across all surfaces: mobile, desktop, and voice.
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will own the design and delivery of significant features and services end to end. You will make architectural decisions that shape how hundreds of millions of customers discover, evaluate, and purchase products on Amazon. title: HR Analytics Trainee (B.Tech + MBA)
description:
A great entry\-level opportunity for
 **B.E./B. Tech \+ MBA** 
 graduates passionate about HR, data, and AI.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria**
* B.E./B.Tech \+ MBA — both degrees required
* Freshers are eligible to apply
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred


**Core Job Responsibilities**
**HR Data Analysis \& Reporting** 
 — Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
   

  

**Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting** 
 — Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
   

  

**Recruitment Analytics** 
 — Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
   

  

**Workforce Analytics** 
 — Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
   

  

**AI\-Assisted Workflows** 
 — Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
   

  

**Data Interpretation \& Business Insights** 
 — Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
   

  

**HR Operations Support** 
 — Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
   

  

**Automation \& Process Improvement** 
 — Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
   

  

**Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks** 
 — Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use** 
 — Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.
   

  

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning
* Familiarity with Power BI, or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes

title: HR Manager (HR & Administration)
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Pirgal Consulting Private Limited is a multidisciplinary consulting company based in Bangalore. We provide allied and support services across accounting and finance, direct and indirect taxation, GST and tax litigation support, legal and regulatory compliance, construction and real estate. We work alongside Chartered Accountants, Advocates and other practising professionals, supporting them and their clients on live matters — which means our teams build technical depth across several disciplines rather than within a single vertical.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for one person to own HR and administration end to end for the Company and its group entities — hiring, onboarding, records, payroll inputs, policy, statutory compliance and office administration. You will not be inheriting a large team or a mature system; you will be building and running it, with direct access to the management. This suits an HR generalist who is tired of owning one slice of the function and wants the whole of it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the full recruitment cycle — requisition, job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer roll\-out and joining — across professional, support and intern roles.
* Manage and grow our sourcing channels: LinkedIn, WorkIndia, Indeed, Internshala, consultants, referrals, and campus relationships with law, engineering, commerce and management institutions in Bangalore.
* Run campus outreach and internship drives — placement\-cell relationships, drive scheduling, intern selection and conversion to full\-time roles.
* Handle onboarding and induction end to end: documentation, background verification, offer and appointment letters, asset handover, and orientation on firm policy.
* Maintain employee records and the HR MIS, and keep the salary register and attendance and leave data accurate and current.
* Administer GreytHR — attendance, leave, employee master, payroll inputs — and drive its adoption across the group.
* Prepare monthly payroll inputs, coordinate with the accounts team on salary processing, and support statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT and related filings) with our consultants.
* Draft, implement and maintain HR policy and SOPs — code of conduct, leave policy, POSH, appraisal framework, offboarding — and enforce them consistently.
* Run the performance and appraisal cycle, coordinate training programmes, and handle employee relations, grievances and disciplinary matters with discretion.
* Manage offboarding: resignation processing, exit interviews, full and final settlement coordination, relieving and experience letters.
* Own office administration — vendors, AMCs, assets, facilities, travel, housekeeping and general upkeep of the premises.
* Report to the Directors on headcount, hiring pipeline, attrition, payroll cost and HR MIS every month.

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* Proven experience running HR end to end single\-handedly — hiring, records, payroll inputs, compliance and admin.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labour and statutory requirements: PF, ESI, PT, gratuity, POSH.
* Hands\-on recruitment ability. You will be sourcing and screening yourself, not delegating it.
* Strong MS Excel and reporting skills; experience with GreytHR or a comparable HRMS is a strong advantage.
* Excellent communication and the maturity to hold confidential information and to have difficult conversations.
* Fluency in Kannada and English required; Hindi is an advantage.
* Prior experience in a consulting or professional services environment is preferred.
* Comfortable being the sole HR presence for a growing multi\-entity group.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Complete ownership of the function, reporting directly to the Directors.
* The opportunity to build systems and policy from the ground up rather than administer someone else's.
* Exposure across multiple group entities in consulting, construction and real estate.
* Scope to build a team under you as the group grows.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV to **hr@pirgal.com**, with a copy to **sahana@pirgal.com**, using the subject line **“Application – HR Manager (HR \& Administration)”**.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**Talent Acquisition Intern**

Company: Emversity

Location: Bengaluru, India

Work Mode: On\-site / Hybrid

Department: People \& Talent

Duration: 3–6 Months

Opportunity: Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance

**About Emversity**

Emversity is an employability\-focused education platform working to bridge India's skilled workforce gap across sectors such as healthcare, hospitality, and allied health sciences. We work with universities and industry leaders to provide job\-ready, skill\-based education through hands\-on learning, internships, and placement support.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Intern to join our People \& Talent team and gain hands\-on experience in the recruitment process. You will work closely with the Talent Acquisition and HR teams to support hiring for corporate and field\-based roles across multiple locations.

This role is ideal for someone who is interested in building a career in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources and wants to gain practical experience in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

\- Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and campus hiring channels.

\- Review and shortlist resumes based on job requirements.

\- Conduct initial candidate outreach and telephonic screening.

\- Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and hiring managers.

\- Maintain accurate candidate records and update recruitment trackers/ATS.

\- Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

\- Support offer rollout and joining formalities.

\- Assist in tracking recruitment metrics and hiring progress.

\- Support job postings and employer branding activities.

\- Assist with campus hiring drives, job fairs, and recruitment events.

\- Provide general support to the Talent Acquisition team.

**Who Can Apply?**

\- Students pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

\- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

\- Good organizational and time\-management abilities.

\- Ability to manage multiple candidates and tasks simultaneously.

\- Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.

\- Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.

\- Basic knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.

\- Familiarity with ATS or LinkedIn Recruiter is an advantage but not mandatory.

\- Genuine interest in pursuing a career in HR or Talent Acquisition.

**What You Will Gain**

\- Hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.

\- Exposure to hiring in a fast\-growing startup environment.

\- Mentorship and guidance from experienced HR and Talent Acquisition professionals.

\- Experience with sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and candidate management.

\- Opportunity to participate in campus hiring and recruitment events.

\- Stipend as per company policy.

\- Potential Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance.

\- Certificate of completion and a strong foundation for a career in HR and Talent Acquisition.

**Why Join Us?**

If you're passionate about people, enjoy connecting with candidates, and want to build a career in Talent Acquisition, this internship will give you the opportunity to learn recruitment practically while contributing to a fast\-growing, mission\-driven organization.

Apply now and start your journey in Talent Acquisition with Emversity!

Pay: ₹13,500\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Finance Data Analyst (MIS & Reporting)
description:
##### **About Headphone Zone**


We don’t run Headphone Zone like a company. We run it like a community — of people who care deeply about helping others rediscover music. We’re proud to be a 100% independent, Indian\-owned business, committed to bringing the world’s finest headphones and audio gear to discerning listeners across the country.


We choose to be the best, not the biggest. We serve our customers with the same level of care, respect, and attention we’d want for ourselves — guided by a simple ethos: **we’re ladies and gentlemen, serving ladies and gentlemen**. And above all, while we are not a music company, music is at the core of everything we do.

##### **About the Role**


As a Finance Data Analyst at Headphone Zone, you’ll turn financial data into insights — helping us run a healthy, profitable, and sustainable business.


You’ll work closely with our Finance and Operations teams — building reports, automating dashboards, analysing trends, and supporting better decision\-making across the company.

##### **Why This Role Matters**


We take pride in being an independent, self\-funded business. But staying that way requires sharp financial discipline and data\-driven decisions.


Your work will help us manage cash flow, optimise margins, control costs, and guide how we grow — so we can serve more music lovers, while staying true to our values.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* Collect, analyse, and interpret financial data to generate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports
* Build dashboards and financial models to support leadership decision\-making
* Maintain and update financial databases, ensuring data accuracy and consistency
* Automate financial reporting processes using Excel, Power BI, or SQL
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes
* Identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights to drive business performance
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, and other teams to streamline reporting and data flow
* Monitor key financial metrics — revenue, margins, costs, profitability, working capital, and cash flow health

##### **What We’re Looking For**

* **Freshers are welcome** — we love hiring proactive freshers! Or even better, 1–2 years of experience in finance, MIS, or data analysis
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to turn financial data into clear, actionable insights — and communicate them well
* Proficiency in **MS Excel** (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros)
* Familiarity with tools like SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar (nice to have)
* A mindset aligned with our values: doing it the right way, not the easy way; always learning and improving; taking ownership and responsibility; understanding that growth lies in discomfort; serving with grace and respect
* Curiosity about how finance drives business performance
* Based in Mumbai — this is a **full\-time, in\-office** role at our HQ in **Andheri West**

##### **Cultural Fit**


Headphone Zone is a place for people who want to do great work — the right way, not the easy way. We believe in showing up every day with curiosity, ownership, and a commitment to getting better. Titles and ladders don’t matter here; how you think, learn, and contribute does.


You’ll fit right in if you care about craft, take responsibility for your own growth, and thrive in an environment that’s fast, unstructured, and a little chaotic (in the best way). Most of all, we’re here to help people rediscover music — and everything we do comes from that purpose.

##### **Why Join Us?**


At Headphone Zone, you’ll be part of a small, passionate team that takes pride in doing things differently. We believe in craft, community, and curiosity — and we’re here to serve, not to sell. You’ll have the freedom to own your work, learn constantly, and contribute to a team that values quality over scale.


If you believe in treating customers with grace and respect, care about helping people experience music more deeply, and thrive in a culture built on trust and hustle — you’ll love it here.

##### **How to Apply**


If this sounds like your kind of role, hit 'Apply' — we’d love to hear from you.

title: SEO & AI-Powered Market Research Analyst
description:
SEO \& AI Market Research Analyst

**TechSmew Innovations Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Chennai \| Work From Office \| Full\-Time \| 0–3 Years**

About the Role

TechSmew Innovations is building **agentic\-AI products and platforms**. We are looking for a **highly curious, proactive and research\-driven SEO \& Market Research Analyst** who enjoys discovering opportunities through **research, search, data, competitors, AI and experimentation**.

This is **not a routine SEO execution or data\-entry role**.

We want someone who naturally asks questions, investigates deeply, discovers things others may miss and converts discoveries into **insights, leads and business value**.

What You'll Do

* Continuously **research and discover** new opportunities across SEO, markets, competitors, customers and growth.
* Conduct **keyword, SEO, market and competitor research** across Google, Bing, AI search and other platforms.
* Discover high\-value, emerging, untapped and commercially relevant keywords.
* Analyze competitor rankings, content, positioning, strategies, gaps and opportunities.
* Monitor competitor **high\-budget advertising and paid campaigns** to understand their messaging, offers, keywords, market focus and commercial intent.
* Research and discover **potential companies, prospects, decision\-makers and leads**.
* Validate, enrich and organize lead information using research and prospecting tools.
* Maintain research findings, lead information, activities and follow\-ups in **CRM systems**.
* Use **AI tools and AI agents** for research, competitor intelligence, lead discovery, analysis, monitoring and automation.
* Experiment with new AI\-powered workflows and continuously find better ways to perform research.
* Convert research into **numbers, insights, recommendations, leads and actionable opportunities**.
* Proactively identify what should be investigated next rather than waiting for instructions.

The Mindset We Want

**Discovery is the most important part of this role.**

We want someone who naturally thinks:

* **Why is this happening?**
* **How did they achieve this?**
* **What are competitors doing?**
* **What are they missing?**
* **What are we missing?**
* **What else can I discover?**
* **What is the opportunity?**
* **What evidence do we have?**
* **What is the potential value?**
* **Can AI help me investigate this at scale?**
* **What should we do next?**

You should be comfortable going **beyond the original task** and bringing back useful discoveries that nobody specifically asked you to find.

What We Look For

* Excellent **research and internet\-searching ability**.
* Strong **curiosity, questioning and investigative mindset**.
* Strong **discovery\-oriented personality**.
* Numbers\- and evidence\-driven thinking.
* Ability to identify patterns, connect information and form useful insights.
* Thinks about **value, impact and business outcomes**, not just activity.
* Highly proactive and self\-driven.
* Good written and verbal **communication skills**.
* Basic understanding of SEO, search engines and digital marketing.
* Interested in **AI, AI agents and agentic systems**.
* Willing and excited to **learn new tools, technologies and methods continuously**.
* Comfortable learning and working with **lead\-generation and CRM tools**.
* Fast learner who adapts quickly to changing technology.

AI, Tools \& Learning

You do **not** need to already know every tool.

We care more about your **ability and willingness to learn**.

You may work with tools across:

**SEO \& Search:** Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Google Trends  
**Analytics \& Data:** Google Analytics, Excel, Google Sheets  
**Lead Research:** LinkedIn, prospecting and enrichment platforms  
**CRM:** HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce and similar platforms  
**AI:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and AI agents  
**Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier and similar platforms

**If you don't know a tool today, that's completely fine. We expect you to learn it when the work requires it.**

Agentic\-AI Environment

TechSmew is working towards **agentic products and platforms**.

You will work in an environment where we continuously explore:

**AI Agents → Research → Discovery → Analysis → Lead Generation → CRM → Monitoring → Automation → Insights**

You don't need to be an AI engineer.

You need to be **AI\-curious, adaptable and excited to experiment and learn**.

What Success Looks Like

We don't want someone who simply says:

“Competitor X is running ads.”

We want someone who says:

“I investigated Competitor X, found what they are investing in, identified the market and keyword patterns, compared their positioning with ours, discovered an opportunity, quantified what I could, and recommend what we should investigate or do next.”

The ideal person regularly comes back with:

**“I found something interesting.”**

Selection Process

Candidates will complete a practical **research \& discovery exercise** to evaluate:

**Research \| Questioning \| Discovery \| SEO \| Competitor Intelligence \| Paid Ads \| Lead Discovery \| CRM Thinking \| Numbers \| AI Usage \| Communication**

Experience

**0–3 Years**

Freshers are welcome if they demonstrate exceptional **research ability, curiosity, questioning, communication and willingness to learn**.

Core Principle

**Don't just execute tasks.**

**Research deeply. Ask better questions. Discover opportunities. Use AI. Find leads. Create insights. Add measurable value.**

title: AI Business Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Crowe's AI Y\-Hire practice moves from foundational skills — requirements support, artifact creation, learning the craft — toward independent ownership of complex engagements. The AI Business Analyst operates at an experienced level, applying established business analysis skills across complex engagements while leveraging AI\-enabled ways of working.
   

  

 At the entry level, a BA supports elicitation, assists with testing, and follows established standards. At this level, you lead elicitation, own testing programs, and extend standards to account for what AI\-augmented delivery requires. This role expands traditional business analysis responsibilities by incorporating AI\-enabled analysis, documentation, and delivery practices. In this role, you will facilitate workshops, synthesize information using AI\-enabled tools, and translate insights into actionable deliverables that support project outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The AI Business Analyst at Crowe translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements for AI solutions, automation platforms, and development teams. This means applying business analysis fundamentals — elicitation, documentation, testing — through an AI\-first operating model.
   

  

 You will use Gen AI tools including Claude Code as active instruments of analysis: interrogating process mining output to draft automation opportunity backlogs, generating first\-pass test plans from acceptance criteria, and using LLM analysis to surface requirement gaps before they reach development. You will be responsible for delivering high\-quality work products from discovery through user acceptance testing and implementation readiness.
   

  

 Operating from India, you will work in close partnership with US\-based teams across client engagements in process optimization, Hyperautomation, and Gen AI solution delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Discovery \& Analysis**
* Lead structured discovery workshops with client stakeholders — using AI tools in session to capture, synthesize, and reflect back current\-state processes, pain points, and desired outcomes in real time; produce structured outputs before the debrief.
* Conduct process and task mining analysis using Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, or equivalent platforms to surface high\-ROI automation opportunities; translate event\-log insights into prioritized opportunity backlogs with quantified business impact.
* Analyze UX feedback, job aids, procedures, and existing process maps to identify candidates for further optimization; summarize findings and present recommendations with supporting data.
* Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve requirement risks, gaps, and ambiguities — using LLM\-assisted cross\-reference of documentation to catch inconsistencies before they reach development; partner with stakeholders to resolve issues and appropriately escalate matters when additional guidance or decisions are required.


**Requirements \& Solution Design**
* Elicit and document business, user, functional, and non\-functional requirements with sufficient detail to support effective implementation of AI\-enabled and traditional technology solutions — including decision logic, tool invocations, exception handling, and appropriate human review and oversight checkpoints.
* Translate requirements into the full artifact set: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, wireframes, data models, swimlane diagrams, and state diagrams — using AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate first\-draft creation and human judgment to validate and refine.
* Design Target Operating Models that show how people, AI agents, and automated processes interact in the future state — including role evolution, governance guardrails, and escalation paths that keep humans accountable for outcomes.
* Use AI coding and analysis assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot Cowork) as a productivity layer: generate first drafts of plans, criteria, models, and documentation; ensure all deliverables meet quality, accuracy, and business requirements.


**Delivery \& Backlog Management**
* Own requirements traceability end\-to\-end and maintain alignment between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and expected business outcomes; maintain documentation throughout the project lifecycle to reflect evolving business needs and decisions.
* Lead backlog organization, refinement, and work item maintenance using Crowe\-standard Agile tooling (Azure DevOps or equivalent) — ensuring stories are sprint\-ready, acceptance criteria are complete, and the backlog reflects current business priorities at all times.
* Build and execute structured testing programs — functional, integration, regression, performance, and usability — for Gen AI solutions from first prototype through production handoff; prepare test plans and scripts with enough specificity that a QA engineer can execute them without clarification.
* Facilitate and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT): coordinate test cycles with client teams, manage defect triage, and own sign\-off on solution readiness.


**Communication, Standards \& Practice Development**
* Build audience\-calibrated presentation materials and present findings, recommendations, and ROI narratives to executives, operational leads, and end users — adjusting depth and framing without losing substance or precision.
* Apply and uphold Crowe BA standards, templates, and best practices; identify where AI\-augmented delivery requires those standards to evolve and contribute to their improvement.
* Actively develop your own practice — through emerging AI tooling, peer feedback, and client exposure — and share what you learn with the broader BA community at Crowe.


**Qualifications:**
**Required:**
* 1 \- 3 years in business analysis, process optimization, or hyperautomation delivery with direct exposure to AI/ML or Gen AI solution delivery (process automation, workflow design, API integration, agentic AI)
* Demonstrated daily use of Gen AI tools — Claude Code, Codex, Copilot Cowork, or equivalent; demonstrated experience applying these tools to support business analysis, documentation, process improvement, or solution delivery (portfolio examples, project references, or other examples welcome)
* Full requirements artifact ownership — proven track record producing the complete artifact set: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, wireframes, data models, and traceability matrices for software or AI\-powered solution delivery
* Agile delivery fluency — user story authoring, sprint facilitation, backlog refinement, and acceptance criteria definition in Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent
* Risk and gap analysis — ability to identify and address requirement inconsistencies, dependencies, risks, and scope considerations throughout the delivery lifecycle
* English communication at full professional proficiency\*\* — written precision and spoken clarity enabling peer\-level dialogue with US\-based executives and technical leads across time zones, within a global delivery environment.


**Foundational**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered
* Analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems into structured, actionable components
* Willingness to maintain a core overlap window of approximately 6:30 PM – 12:30 AM IST for US Central/Eastern collaboration


**Preferred**
* 1 \- 3 years with process or task mining platforms (Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, Minit, Apromore)
* CBAP, CCBA, PMI\-PBA, or Agile\-related certification (CSPO, IIBA\-AAC)
* Prior experience in professional services, consulting, or client\-facing delivery where your work is directly visible to the client
* Familiarity with BPMN, swimlane diagrams, data flow diagrams, use case modeling, and AI\-assisted diagramming tools (Lucidchart, Miro, Visio)
* Exposure to testing methodologies across the full spectrum: unit, integration, regression, performance, and usability


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* Strong candidates will have practical experience incorporating Gen AI tools into their analytical workflows. They demonstrate strong ownership of requirements, support testing and validation activities, and can facilitate discovery sessions that result in timely, structured documentation and actionable outcomes. Experience in a client\-facing or professional services environment is a meaningful advantage.


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
   

  

 We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Data Analyst (Python + SQL / Power BI)
description:
**About us** 




 At Awesome Analytics, we are not just a company; we are a community of data enthusiasts, problem solvers and innovators. Our mission is to empower organizations with data\-driven insights that transform how they make decisions. As a remote\-first data analytics company based in India, we have redefined the way we work to make data analytics accessible and enjoyable for the people who build it.
 



  





 Our mission: automate your work, and elevate your life.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We build reporting, dashboarding, and AI\-driven automation solutions for enterprise clients across top industries including FMCG, finance, and retail: MIS reports, Power BI dashboards, data models, and process automation built with Excel, Python and ETL tools. A typical engagement means taking a client’s raw, messy data, building the model and the pipeline behind it, and shipping a dashboard or an automated report they rely on every week. You will own this end to end: the extraction, the model, the automation, the validation and the final report or dashboard. This is a build\-and\-think role.
 



  





**How we work, and what we are really hiring for** 




 Our delivery is AI\-assisted. Your effort concentrates on the data model, on reviewing what the tools produce, on edge cases, on data quality, and on getting a report or a dashboard genuinely production\-ready for a client.
 



  





 We want someone who is genuinely fast with AI\-assisted tools \- Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Copilot in Power BI and Fabric \- for writing SQL, DAX, and Python, and equally rigorous about checking what they produce before it reaches a client. If that is already how you work, you will fit right in.
 



  





 One line worth saying plainly, because it is the part of AI\-assisted work that goes wrong quietly: we use AI on the logic, not on client data. Schemas, structures, and sample shapes go into a tool; client rows and personal data do not. You will be expected to know the difference and to hold that line without being asked.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Translate client requirements into specific reports, dashboards or automation specs.
* Independently develop reports, dashboards and automation using Power BI, Excel and Python.
* Design data models and build the pipeline behind a dashboard: extraction and ETL, transformation, modeling and the visual layer.
* Source data from client systems \- ERP and accounting exports, SharePoint and Excel drops, REST APIs, databases and flat files \- and handle schema changes and bad data without silent failures.
* Automate processes and reports using Python, macros, VBA and ETL tools.
* Use AI tools as a standard part of building reports, dashboards and automation, and own the review, testing and validation of everything they produce before it reaches a client.
* Publish and operate what you ship: scheduled refresh, gateway connections, workspace and access setup, refresh\-failure handling, and documentation good enough to hand over.
* Test and validate outputs before anything reaches a client: numbers tie out to source, control totals reconcile, edge cases handled.
* Client\-facing time: requirement calls, demos, and walkthroughs.
* Maintain and troubleshoot existing dashboards and reports as client data or requirements change.
* Identify gaps and raise the right queries throughout the project lifecycle, from planning to delivery.
* Scale and extend projects based on client feedback, and record and report on work done.
* Participate in developing case studies: scope, record, and report on work done.
* Stay current on relevant tools and techniques to modernize how clients report and automate.



  





**Technical skills** 




  





**Must have** 



* **Python** 
 \- used to independently build reports and automation; comfortable with pandas and with scripting against client data.
* **SQL** 
 \- writing and tuning queries against relational databases for reporting and analysis.
* **Power BI** 
 \- dashboard design, plus Power BI Service \& Power BI Gateway.
* **Power Pivot / DAX** 
 (or MSBI more broadly) \- modelling and calculated measures.
* **Data modelling** 
 \- star schemas, fact and dimension tables, grain, and relationships you set up yourself rather than inherit.
* **Advanced Excel** 
 \- formulas, features, and VBA for Excel (optional) or MS Office automation.
* **Testing and validation** 
 \- reconciling to source, control totals, row\-count and edge\-case checks, and a regression check after a model change. Numbers that tie out are the deliverable; the dashboard is how they get seen.
* **Data handling and access control** 
 \- Power BI row\-level security, workspace and app permissions, gateway credentials, and judgement about what client data may leave the client environment.
* **AI\-assisted delivery** 
 \- fluent and critical use of AI tools for SQL, DAX, and Python.
* **Technical architecture** 
 \- able to read and assess a technical architecture and a project scope, and to say what will and will not work.
* **Git / GitHub** 
 \- branching, pull requests, and review for the Python, SQL and DAX you write. If you have not used it, say so: we will get you there, but you will be working in it.
* **A portfolio** 
 of reports, dashboards or automation to your name, with a github link we can open.
* **Strong analytical and problem\-solving** 
 skills, and a critical mindset.



  





**Good to have** 




 Everything below is welcome, and none of it is a gate. Tell us which of these you have rather than ruling yourself out for the ones you do not.
 



  




* SSIS, or Power Query (Advanced).
* Non\-Excel automation \- UiPath, Power Automate or similar.
* Cloud data warehouses \- Snowflake, BigQuery or Azure Synapse.
* Scheduled ETL and pipeline tools, and orchestration with Task Scheduler, cron or Airflow.
* LLM API integration (Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI) \- retrieval, prompt design, and token and cost control.
* Microsoft Fabric, Power BI dataflows, and deployment pipelines across dev, test and production workspaces.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience handling datasets or preparing automated reports, with at least 1 year of real client project work in Python and Power BI.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in data analytics, data science or a related field. A strong portfolio of delivered dashboards, reports or automation will be considered in place of a formal degree.
* Professional working English \- you will be on client requirement calls, demos and walkthroughs.
* Your own laptop and a reliable broadband connection. This is a remote role, and you will connect to a cloud remote system.
* Legally authorized to work in India.



  





**How we work** 



* **Remote\-first, anywhere in India** 
 . You design your workday around doing your best work, not around a commute.
* **An Awesome Analytics\-provisioned VM** 
 inside our network, with an in\-domain company account.
* **Direct client exposure from early on** 
 \- requirement calls, demos and walkthroughs.
* **GitHub** 
 for code and query work; Google \+ Microsoft Workspace, Slack and Notion for everything else.



  





**Why work with us** 



* **Work that ships** 
 . Your dashboards and reports go into production inside real enterprises. You will see the results of your work in someone’s actual workflow, not in a backlog.
* **A stack worth learning on** 
 . Python, SQL, Power BI and AI\-assisted delivery, on live client builds. This is the toolchain the next ten years of this work is being built on, and you will be using it every day rather than reading about it.
* **Range, then depth** 
 . You will touch the data, the model, the automation, the validation and the client conversation. We would rather you were competent across the whole path and excellent at a deliberate few things than boxed into one layer.
* **Real investment in your growth** 
 . Mentorship, training, and a clear path forward, whether you are a few years in or well established. We back people who are learning faster than their job description.
* **An inclusive team** 
 . We value different perspectives and backgrounds, and we are committed to an environment where everyone’s voice is heard. Analytics is a mindset, not just a degree.



  





**To apply** 




 Complete the application form below. Bring a dashboard, report or portfolio link, and be ready to walk us through one project you built in depth: the data model, the automation, the checks you ran, and the decisions you would now make differently.

title: Associate QA Engineer
description:
At Lemon Yellow, great design deserves great engineering.
   

  

 We bring the design, you bring the tech magic, and together we create UI and UX experiences that make users smile.
   

  

 We are looking for an Associate QA Engineer.
   

  

**Overview:** 
 We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong knowledge of manual testing and a basic understanding of automation and API testing. The role involves testing web and mobile applications, creating test cases, identifying defects, and ensuring a consistent UI/UX across platforms. The ideal candidate should be familiar with Jira, Figma, Excel, Java \+ Selenium/Katalon, and be eager to use AI tools to improve QA efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Quality Assurance \& Testing
+ Perform Manual, Functional, Regression, Smoke, Sanity, and Integration Testing for web and mobile applications.
+ Understand application requirements and ensure functionality meets expected business and user requirements.
+ Identify, document, and validate defects throughout the testing lifecycle.

* Test Case \& Scenario Management
+ Understand business requirements and create, review, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios.
+ Maintain test execution reports and ensure adequate test coverage across application features.
+ Perform retesting and regression testing to ensure issues are properly resolved.

* UI/UX \& Cross\-Platform Testing
+ Perform UI/UX testing and identify design inconsistencies using Figma and other relevant tools.
+ Validate applications across different browsers, devices, screen sizes, and responsive layouts.
+ Ensure the application provides a consistent and user\-friendly experience.

* API \& Automation Testing
+ Perform basic API testing and validate request/response data.
+ Gain exposure to automation testing using Java with Selenium or Katalon Studio.
+ Understand, write, and execute individual automation test scripts to support testing activities.


* Defect Management \& Documentation
+ Log, track, prioritize, and follow up on defects using Jira, Zoho, or similar test and defect management platforms.
+ Maintain test cases, test execution reports, defect reports, and other QA documentation using Excel and test management tools.
+ Collaborate with development teams to ensure defects are resolved and validated within expected timelines.

* Collaboration \& Requirement Analysis
+ Collaborate effectively with Developers, UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, Clients, and other stakeholders.
+ Participate in requirement discussions and provide a QA perspective to identify potential issues and improve product quality.
+ Contribute to a collaborative and quality\-focused development environment.

* AI\-Assisted QA \& Continuous Improvement
+ Use AI tools responsibly and effectively to improve productivity in test case creation, test data preparation, documentation, and automation support.
+ Explore new QA tools, techniques, and methodologies to improve testing efficiency and product quality.
+ Continuously learn and contribute to improving QA processes and practices.


**Required Skills**
* BE/B.Tech/BSc/BCA or equivalent degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 0–1 year of experience or strong knowledge in Software Testing / Quality Assurance.
* BFSI / Fintech domain experience or exposure is preferred.
* Good understanding of STLC and SDLC.
* Strong knowledge of Manual and Functional Testing.
* Basic understanding of API Testing.
* Exposure to Java \+ Selenium and/or Katalon Studio.
* Ability to create and maintain basic automation scripts independently.
* Good understanding of UI/UX testing and Figma designs.
* Knowledge of Jira, Zoho, Excel, or similar test and defect management tools.
* Basic understanding of the BFSI/Fintech domain will be an added advantage.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and client\-facing environment.
* A passionate QA professional who is eager to learn, comfortable working across multiple teams, and interested in both manual and automation testing.


**What are we offering?**
**Experience**
* A chance to work on meaningful brands and digital products across industries. Every project brings new learning and opportunities to strengthen your development skills. You grow and you help the team grow.


**Exposure**
* If you believe in your work, we believe in you. You get to work directly with clients, understand real\-world problems, and build solutions that create impact.


**Empathy**
* A thoughtfully nurtured culture that values fun and fulfillment.
* Your well\-being, personal, professional, mental, and physical, becomes our priority.
* From Fitness Thursdays to learning sessions, we make sure you laugh, learn, and feel supported.


**Who are we?**
* Lemon Yellow LLP is a user\-centered UI and UX design agency based out of Thane, Maharashtra. With global experience, strong mentorship, and a passionate team, we aim to design digital happiness.
* You should apply if you believe in building experiences that people enjoy using.


**How do you reach us?**
* Well, after you send in your application, it takes us 2\-3 weeks to review it. Sometimes, not often, we might delay just a bit beyond that. This happens when our mailbox is flooded with applications.
* We promise we won’t ghost you; you’ll definitely hear from us. In the meantime, feel free to explore our official website.
