title: SAP Associate
company: Abusiness -> SAP BTP, Integration Suite Developers
description:
**Company Overview** 




 ABusiness is a technology consulting company specializing in SAP consulting, enterprise integration, cloud solutions, digital transformation, and technology services.
 



 We work on SAP implementation, integration, application development, and enterprise transformation initiatives. As we continue to expand our SAP practice, we are looking for motivated professionals who want to build their careers in the SAP ecosystem and work alongside experienced SAP consultants and technical leaders.
 



  





**Role Overview** 



* We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically driven SAP Associate – SAP Integration with 0–3 years of experience to join our SAP team in Gurugram.
* The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of SAP integration concepts and hands\-on exposure to technologies such as SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP API Management (APIM).
* This position is suitable for candidates who want to develop their careers in SAP integration while gaining exposure to real\-world enterprise projects, client environments, development activities, and account management.
* You will work closely with senior SAP consultants, architects, developers, and account stakeholders on implementation, integration, support, and customer engagement activities.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with senior SAP team members on SAP integration development, implementation, testing, and support activities.
* Develop, configure, test, and troubleshoot integration flows using SAP Cloud Integration (CPI).
* Assist in designing and implementing APIs using SAP API Management (APIM).
* Support integration between SAP and non\-SAP applications using APIs and standard integration technologies.
* Work with REST APIs, SOAP APIs, OData, JSON, XML, HTTPS, and related integration protocols and formats.
* Assist senior consultants and architects with technical analysis, solution development, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Participate in requirement discussions and convert business requirements into technical integration tasks.
* Perform testing, debugging, monitoring, and issue resolution for integration scenarios.
* Support API policies, authentication, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation for integrations, APIs, configurations, and development activities.
* Collaborate with internal development teams and customer stakeholders.
* Assist senior team members in handling assigned customer accounts, including technical coordination, issue tracking, follow\-ups, and delivery support.
* Participate in customer calls and provide technical updates where required.
* Follow development standards, code\-review processes, documentation standards, and project timelines.
* Continuously develop knowledge across the SAP BTP and SAP Integration ecosystem.



  





**Required Skills \& Knowledge** 



* Candidates should have good knowledge or practical exposure in the following areas:
* SAP Integration Suite
* SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
* SAP API Management (APIM)
* SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP)
* REST APIs and SOAP Web Services
* OData Services
* JSON and XML
* API authentication and authorization concepts
* Integration monitoring and troubleshooting
* Understanding of cloud and enterprise application integration concepts
* Knowledge of technologies such as Groovy scripting, OAuth 2\.0, certificates, destinations, Cloud Connector, event\-driven integration, or SAP systems such as S/4HANA will be an added advantage.



  





**Experience** 



* 0–3 years of relevant experience.
* Freshers with strong SAP Integration training, certification, internship experience, or hands\-on project exposure may also be considered.
* Candidates with hands\-on exposure to SAP CPI/Cloud Integration and SAP APIM will be preferred.
* Educational Qualification
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Applications, or a related technical discipline.
* Relevant SAP training and certifications will be an added advantage.



  





**Working Hours** 



* This position requires candidates to work in the US shift aligned with the CST (Central Standard Time) time zone.
* Candidates should be comfortable collaborating with customers and team members operating during US business hours.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* We are looking for someone who is:
* Technically curious and interested in building a long\-term career in SAP.
* Comfortable working in a collaborative development environment.
* Willing to learn from senior SAP consultants and architects.
* Capable of taking ownership of assigned technical tasks.
* Strong in problem\-solving and troubleshooting.
* Professional in written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable interacting with customers and supporting account\-related activities.
* Able to work effectively in a fast\-paced consulting and development environment.



  





**Opportunity** 



* This role offers hands\-on exposure to SAP Integration Suite, CPI, APIM, BTP, enterprise integrations, APIs, customer projects, and account management, while working closely with experienced SAP professionals.
* The selected candidate will have the opportunity to grow from an Associate position into broader SAP Integration Consultant / Developer responsibilities based on performance and technical capabilities.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 Sarvam’s Work Agents team builds the harness for developing, evaluating, and serving autonomous agents at scale. The harness is the backbone behind how agents are run, tested, orchestrated, and deployed and it needs infrastructure that is as reliable and fast\-moving as the agents themselves.
   

  

 This role sits across both sides of infrastructure. You will build the tooling, pipelines, and automation that make the harness self\-service and reproducible, and you will operate the day\-to\-day keeping CI/CD healthy, environments consistent, networks and tunnels up, and deployments running smoothly. It is a mix of engineering and operations, not pure SRE\-on\-call and not pure platform\-product work.
   

  

 You should be a hands\-on DevOps engineer fluent in Kubernetes, comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS primarily, Azure secondarily), and literate in the networking and CI/CD concerns that keep a multi\-cluster, multi\-tenant environment running. You will work closely with the engineers building the harness; your job is to make their work shippable, observable, and operable at scale.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Kubernetes platform operations. Run and maintain multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments — upgrades, node lifecycle, RBAC, namespace hygiene, policy enforcement, and troubleshooting across environments.
* CI/CD and release engineering. Own the pipelines that take the harness from commit to production \- build, test, scan, sign, and deploy across environments, with rollout patterns (canary, blue\-green, rollback) wired into the platform.
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS primary, Azure secondary). Provision and maintain cloud resources via infrastructure\-as\-code \- VPCs, subnets, IAM, compute, storage, and managed services \- with reproducibility and cost awareness built in.
* Networking and connectivity. Manage platform\-level network plumbing — CNI configuration, ingress and service routing, network policies, and secure cross\-cluster and on\-prem connectivity via VPN tunnels, peering, and transit paths.
* Automation and tooling. Build the glue that makes the harness self\-service — CLIs, scripts, operators, and internal tooling that reduce toil and let engineers get work done without filing tickets.
* Observability and reliability. Maintain the metrics, logging, and tracing pipeline; set and tune alerts; and participate in incident response and postmortems so the platform keeps getting better.
* Provisioning and infrastructure\-as\-code. Keep environments standing reproducibly — Terraform / Crossplane, image management, and multi\-vendor cluster bring\-up alongside the team.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3\+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform / infrastructure engineering, with hands\-on ownership of systems you ran and improved \- not just scripts that worked once.
* Kubernetes fluency \- you can operate clusters day\-to\-day, understand the scheduler and API machinery well enough to debug failures, and have written or maintained operators, Helm charts, or controllers.
* Cloud proficiency \- solid AWS (VPC, EC2, EKS, IAM, storage, networking) with working knowledge of Azure equivalents; comfort provisioning via Terraform or similar IaC.
* Networking depth \- practical understanding of CNI, ingress, service routing, network policies, and VPN / tunneling (IPsec, WireGuard, site\-to\-site) for secure multi\-cluster and hybrid connectivity.
* CI/CD experience \- you have built and maintained pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Flux, or similar) and understand release engineering at a level beyond “it deploys on push.”
* DevOps tooling chops \- comfort across the toolchain: container runtimes, Helm / Kustomize, Prometheus / Grafana, ELK or Loki, and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals \- Python or Go preferred; you write maintainable automation, not throwaway scripts.
* A product mindset toward internal users \- you measure success by adoption and reduced toil, not by tickets closed.


**Bonus Points**
* Experience with on\-premise infrastructure and deployments.
* Experience operating in air\-gapped or restricted\-network environments \- offline package management, image registries, and disconnected cluster bring\-up.
* Multi\-cluster or multi\-tenant Kubernetes in production, including RBAC and isolation as self\-service.
* Open\-source contributions to Kubernetes, CI/CD, or infrastructure tooling.

 Lilly Cyber is seeking a skilled Cloud Security Analyst with a strong understanding of cloud security technologies, cloud security posture management (CSPM), and vulnerability management best practices. The ideal candidate will join the Threat Mitigations team and play a pivotal role in supporting threat mitigation activities across Lilly's cloud environments, including infrastructure, cloud\-native applications, containers, and back\-end pipeline management. This is an exciting position that will be dedicated to helping address cloud security risks. As part of a cross\-functional team, this analyst will collaborate closely with a broad set of teams to ensure effective threat reduction. This is an excellent opportunity to grow and experience a wide array of different aspects of cloud cybersecurity while performing a meaningful and impactful role.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist Cyber Threat Mitigation Leads in identifying, assessing, and developing solutions to reduce security threats.

* Support tracking and reporting of security mitigation metrics to provide visibility into risk remediation efforts.
* DevSecOps Management
* Integrate security tooling into CI/CD pipelines to enable shift\-left practices and automated security checks during build process.
* Support pull request gating, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) scanning across engineering teams.

* Hands\-on experience with security automation tools.

title: Security Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 





 Nanoprecise
 
  Sci Corp is building the security spine of a next\-generation IoT \+ AI platform used across industrial and enterprise environments. We are looking for a seasoned Security Engineer who combines deep technical offensive and defensive expertise with the ability to architect, automate, and scale security programs across firmware, cloud, AI systems, and wireless infrastructure. 
 



 You will own the security posture of our embedded hardware, CI/CD pipelines, AI implementations, and network perimeter — with a mandate to shift security left, operationalize threat intelligence, and mentor a growing team. 
 



  
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**AI Security** 

  
 



* Design and enforce security controls for all internal and external AI/LLM deployments
* Conduct threat modeling on AI pipelines using MITRE ATLAS and STRIDE frameworks
* Implement prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and AI audit logging
* Lead shadow AI discovery programs and define acceptable use policies
* Perform red teaming exercises against AI models and RAG systems



  
 



  





**DevSecOps** 

  
 



* Own the end\-to\-end security of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
* Integrate SAST (Semgrep, CodeQL), DAST (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite), SCA (Snyk, Dependabot), and secrets scanning (TruffleHog, Gitleaks)
* Implement policy\-as\-code using OPA/Gatekeeper for Kubernetes and IaC environments
* Establish container security standards: image signing (Cosign/Notary), runtime policy (Falco), RBAC hardening
* Drive developer security training and threat modeling in sprint planning



  
 



  





**Firmware Reverse Engineering \& Embedded Security** 

  
 



* Lead firmware security assessments on IoT and edge devices using Ghidra, IDA Pro, Binwalk, Radare2
* Design and enforce secure firmware development lifecycle: signed OTA, secure boot, encrypted comms
* Develop and maintain UART/JTAG/SPI flash extraction capabilities
* Perform vulnerability research on embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare\-metal firmware
* Produce actionable firmware security findings with CVSS\-scored remediation roadmaps



  
 



  





**Wireless \& Network Security** 

  
 



* Conduct WiFi penetration tests across enterprise WPA2/WPA3, 802\.1X, and guest network segments
* Assess IoT wireless protocols: BLE, Zigbee, LoRa, Z\-Wave for security weaknesses
* Deploy and tune Wireless Intrusion Detection Systems (WIDS)
* Develop wireless hardening standards and migration roadmaps (e.g., PSK → 802\.1X)
* Investigate rogue AP incidents, PMKID captures, and deauthentication attacks



  
 



  





**Security Architecture \& Operations** 

  
 



* Design Zero Trust network architecture with microsegmentation and identity\-aware access
* Own SIEM integration (Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel) and threat intelligence operationalization
* Lead incident response for security events across firmware, cloud, AI, and wireless layers
* Produce executive\-level risk reports translating technical findings into business impact



  
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Domain Expertise** 



* 3\+ years in security engineering, with demonstrable expertise across at least 3 of the 4 core domains (AI security, DevSecOps, firmware RE, wireless pentesting)
* Deep hands\-on experience with firmware analysis toolchains: Ghidra, IDA Pro, Binwalk, Firmwalker, QEMU/Firmadyne
* Proven WiFi/wireless pentesting skills: Aircrack\-ng, Kismet, Bettercap, Hostapd, Wireshark, HCXTOOLS
* Strong DevSecOps pipeline experience: SAST/DAST/SCA integration, secrets management, IaC security
* Experience securing AI/ML systems and LLM\-powered applications in production environments
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF
* Strong scripting skills: Python, Bash; familiarity with Go or Rust is a plus
* Relevant certifications preferred: OSCP, OSWP, GREM, GWAPT, CKS, or equivalent



  
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 This role will define how our organization secures AI\-powered products from chip to cloud. You will directly influence the security architecture of devices deployed in critical industrial environments, protect AI systems used by thousands of enterprise users, and build the DevSecOps culture that enables us to ship secure software fast. 
 



 Your work will prevent breaches, protect customer data, and ensure our AI implementations remain trustworthy, auditable, and resilient against emerging threats. 
 



  
 



  





**KPIs for the Role** 




**DevSecOps \& Pipeline Security (35%)** 

  
 



* 100% of production pipelines with full security gate coverage within 6 months
* MTTR for critical pipeline vulnerabilities \< 48 hours
* Zero high\-severity secrets leak incidents per quarter



  
 



  





**AI Security (35%)** 

  
 



* AI security assessment coverage: 100% of production AI systems assessed within first 90 days
* Shadow AI discovery: \< 5 unmanaged AI tools in use at any time
* Prompt injection detection rate: \> 95% of known attack patterns blocked



  
 



  





**Firmware \& Hardware Security (20%)** 

  
 



* 100% of new device firmware reviewed before production deployment
* Mean time to patch firmware CVEs: \< 30 days for critical, \< 90 days for high
* Secure boot and OTA signing coverage: \> 95% of deployed device fleet



  
 



  





**Wireless Security (10%)** 

  
 



* 100% of enterprise WiFi migrated to WPA3/802\.1X within 12 months
* Rogue AP mean time to detection and containment: \< 4 hours
* Wireless security assessment: 100% of new sites assessed before go\-live

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Facility Management Services (FMS) Engineer** 
 to provide on\-site support for enterprise network and security infrastructure.
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for monitoring, maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting LAN/WAN networks, network security devices, Check Point firewalls, and Zscaler cloud security solutions.
   

  

* Monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and network security infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, latency, packet loss, DNS, DHCP, routing, and switching issues.
* Configure and support routers, switches, VLANs, trunking, access ports, and routing protocols.
* Perform first\- and second\-level troubleshooting for network and security incidents.


**Administer And Monitor Check Point Firewalls**
 Security policy management, NAT rules, Network objects, VPN connectivity, Access control and threat\-prevention policies, Firewall logs and incident analysis
   

  

**Support Zscaler Solutions**
 Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), URL filtering and cloud firewall policies, User authentication and access policies, Zscaler Client Connector troubleshooting, Application access and connector\-related issues
   

  

**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of Check Point firewall administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting Zscaler ZIA and/or ZPA environments.
* Ability to analyze firewall, proxy, authentication, and network logs.
* Familiarity with ticketing and IT service management processes.
* Good communication, documentation, and customer\-support skills.
* Ability to work independently in an on\-site customer environment.


**Certification Requirements**
* CCNA certification is required or strongly preferred.
* Check Point certification, such as CCSA or CCSE, is preferred.
* Zscaler certifications, such as ZIA Administrator or ZPA Administrator, are an advantage.

title: Social Media Associate
description:
We are looking for a sincere, creative, and detail\-oriented Social Media Associate who can support our LinkedIn\-focused content and social media activities.

This role is mainly suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates. However, a minimum of **1 year of experience in social media, content writing, LinkedIn content, digital marketing, or a similar field** will be preferred.

The ideal candidate should have strong English writing skills, a working understanding of LinkedIn, and the ability to use AI tools effectively for content ideation, drafting, proofreading, research, and content improvement.

This role requires someone who can think smartly, write clearly, follow instructions carefully, and help maintain a professional and consistent online presence.

**Key Eligibility Criteria**

* Minimum **80% in Class 10**.
* Minimum **80% in Class 12**.
* Minimum **60% in Graduation**.
* Education from an **English\-medium school is mandatory**.
* Freshers may apply; however, **minimum 1 year of relevant experience is preferred**.
* Candidate must have a **working LinkedIn profile of their own**.
* Strong written English with good grammar, sentence structure, clarity, and flow.
* Good spoken English for internal communication and coordination.
* Basic understanding of LinkedIn content, professional branding, social media posting, and audience engagement.
* Practical knowledge of using **AI tools such as ChatGPT or similar platforms** for content ideas, drafting, editing, proofreading, summarizing, and improving content.
* Ability to use AI intelligently while reviewing, refining, and correcting the output instead of blindly copying it.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality and consistency.
* Good time management and ability to complete tasks within deadlines.
* Disciplined, responsible, and willing to learn.
* Comfortable working in a structured, quality\-focused, and performance\-oriented environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

The selected candidate may be expected to:

* Assist in creating LinkedIn\-focused content for professional branding and company visibility.
* Draft, edit, proofread, and organize social media content in clear and professional English.
* Support content planning, post ideas, captions, hooks, and basic content structuring.
* Use AI tools for content ideation, drafting, proofreading, research, and refinement.
* Review AI\-generated content carefully and improve it for tone, grammar, clarity, relevance, and originality.
* Help maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, and content quality.
* Research industry trends, professional topics, and content ideas relevant to the company’s audience.
* Support LinkedIn profile and page activities, including content preparation and basic engagement tracking.
* Coordinate internally for content inputs, approvals, and posting requirements.
* Organize content drafts, calendars, references, and social media material properly.
* Support other content and documentation\-related tasks as required.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is not only interested in social media, but also understands the importance of professional communication.

The ideal candidate should be able to write well, use LinkedIn actively, understand basic content presentation, and use AI tools smartly to improve the quality and speed of work.

We value:

* Strong English writing ability.
* Interest in LinkedIn and professional content.
* AI familiarity and smart tool usage.
* Creativity with structure.
* Attention to detail.
* Discipline and time management.
* Willingness to learn.
* Accountability in assigned work.
* Consistency in output quality.

**Work Schedule**

* **Role Type:** Full\-time
* **Working Hours:** 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM
* **Work Duration:** 9 hours per day

**Who Should Apply**

This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who have strong English communication skills, interest in LinkedIn\-based content, and the ability to use AI tools productively.

Candidates who take pride in writing, enjoy social media content, understand professional communication, and want to grow in a structured work environment will be a good fit for this role.

**Application Requirement**

Applicants may be asked to share:

* Updated resume.
* Class 10, Class 12, and Graduation percentages.
* Confirmation of English\-medium schooling.
* Link to their LinkedIn profile.
* Writing samples, social media posts, captions, blogs, or any previous content work.
* Brief note on AI tools they have used and how they use them for content or social media work.

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. This is a multipurpose, hands\-on role covering building inspections, repair and maintenance supervision, and day\-to\-day facility management across our office and group properties in and around Bangalore. description:
**HR \& ADMINISTRATION EXECUTIVE – MUMBAI OPERATIONS**

**Location:** Tardeo, Mumbai  
**Department:** Human Resources \& Administration  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time \| Office\-based  
**Experience:** Minimum 1 year in a similar HR \& Administration role – Mandatory  
**Industry Preference:** Engineering / Elevators / Service / Projects / Manufacturing / Construction / Field Operations

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Gilco Global is looking for a **hands\-on, responsible and ownership\-driven HR \& Administration Executive** to independently manage the day\-to\-day people and administrative requirements of our Mumbai operations.

This is not a purely desk\-based HR or recruitment role.

We are looking for someone who remains closely connected with employees and field teams, understands day\-to\-day people matters, maintains discipline and documentation, follows up until matters are closed, and takes ownership rather than waiting for repeated instructions.

The right person should be approachable with employees, firm on processes, organised in execution and capable of identifying issues before they become problems.

Simply put, we need someone who can **take ownership of HR \& Administration for our Mumbai operations and make sure things get done.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**People Management \& Employee Relations**

* Act as the primary HR coordination point for employees and field teams in Mumbai.
* Maintain regular interaction with employees and stay aware of day\-to\-day workplace and people\-related concerns.
* Handle routine employee queries, grievances and concerns with maturity, confidentiality and sensitivity.
* Maintain a healthy balance between employee support and organisational discipline.
* Reinforce company policies, professional conduct and workplace expectations.
* Coordinate with reporting managers on employee performance, attendance, conduct and other people\-related matters.
* Identify recurring employee concerns and escalate matters requiring management intervention.
* Follow up on employee commitments and pending actions through to closure.

**Attendance, Leave \& HR Operations**

* Monitor daily attendance, punctuality, absenteeism, leave and attendance compliance.
* Ensure leave applications and attendance records are properly maintained and approved.
* Follow up on attendance discrepancies and missing records.
* Prepare and share accurate monthly attendance and payroll inputs with the concerned team.
* Maintain employee records, personal files and HR documentation.
* Track probation, confirmation, increments and other employment milestones.
* Issue or coordinate routine HR letters and documentation as required.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

**Recruitment \& Manpower Coordination**

* Coordinate recruitment requirements for Mumbai operations, including technical, field, service and support positions.
* Source and screen candidates against defined job requirements.
* Conduct preliminary HR discussions and coordinate subsequent interview rounds.
* Schedule interviews with concerned managers and ensure timely candidate communication.
* Follow up with selected candidates regarding documentation, compensation discussions and joining.
* Maintain updated recruitment trackers and candidate records.
* Support manpower planning by highlighting open positions, expected joiners and recruitment bottlenecks.

**Joining, Induction \& Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage joining formalities and ensure complete employee documentation.
* Coordinate induction and orientation for new employees.
* Familiarise new joiners with company policies, attendance processes, reporting structures and workplace expectations.
* Follow up with new employees during their initial period and identify any concerns requiring attention.
* Maintain employee lifecycle records from joining through confirmation and eventual separation.
* Coordinate resignations, handovers, clearances, exit documentation and Full \& Final inputs.

**Office \& Administration Management**

* Take ownership of routine office administration for the Mumbai office.
* Ensure the office remains organised, functional and adequately supported.
* Coordinate stationery, office supplies and other day\-to\-day administrative requirements.
* Liaise with local vendors and service providers as required.
* Maintain records of administrative purchases, invoices and supporting documents.
* Coordinate bills and approvals with the concerned internal teams.
* Maintain proper records of company assets issued to employees.
* Coordinate requirements relating to ID cards, uniforms, PPE, devices and other employee assets wherever applicable.
* Assist with meetings, training, travel and other local arrangements when required.

**Employee Engagement \& Workplace Coordination**

* Help maintain a professional, respectful and accountable work environment.
* Remain accessible to employees while maintaining appropriate HR boundaries and confidentiality.
* Support employee engagement and internal communication initiatives.
* Coordinate training requirements and employee participation as required.
* Understand employee concerns that could potentially affect morale or retention and bring them to management's attention appropriately.
* Encourage timely communication and stronger coordination between office and field teams.

**MIS, REPORTING \& COMPLIANCE SUPPORT**

* Maintain accurate and updated HR and Administration trackers.
* Prepare periodic reports covering manpower, recruitment, attendance, leave, joining, exits and pending employee matters.
* Maintain employee and branch\-related documentation in an organised and retrievable manner.
* Coordinate with central HR, Accounts and Management teams for required information and documentation.
* Assist in maintaining applicable employment and statutory records at the branch level.
* Flag potential HR, administrative or compliance risks in a timely manner.
* Ensure pending matters are actively followed through to closure rather than merely reported.

**EXPERIENCE \& ELIGIBILITY**

* **Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience in a similar HR \& Administration position is mandatory.**
* Candidates must have practical exposure to **people management, attendance \& leave management, recruitment coordination, onboarding, employee documentation and office administration**.
* Candidates whose experience is limited only to recruitment will not be preferred.
* Experience in an engineering, elevator, service, manufacturing, construction, facilities or field\-oriented organisation will be an advantage.
* Must be comfortable interacting with field technicians, supervisors, managers, vendors and office employees.
* Strong follow\-up, coordination and problem\-solving abilities are essential.
* Ability to handle employee matters calmly, objectively and professionally.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets, email and HR/attendance systems is expected.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Knowledge of Marathi would be an advantage.
* Candidates should be comfortable commuting regularly to **Tardeo, Mumbai**.

**Freshers and candidates without relevant HR \& Administration experience will not be considered for this position.**

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATION**

Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce or a related discipline.

MBA/PGDM or another professional qualification in Human Resources would be an advantage. However, **practical experience, maturity, people\-handling ability and ownership will carry greater weight.**

**WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE?**

We are looking for someone who does not wait to be reminded about every task.

The ideal candidate notices when something is pending, follows it up, speaks to the right people and takes it through to closure. They should know the employees they support, understand what is happening on the ground and be able to distinguish between a routine matter they can resolve independently and an issue that needs management intervention.

The person should be equally comfortable **listening to an employee, enforcing a process, coordinating an interview, checking attendance, resolving an administrative issue or following up with a vendor.**

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who can genuinely take the position:

**“Mumbai HR \& Administration is my responsibility, and I will make sure it runs well.”**

**ABOUT GILCO GLOBAL**

Gilco Global operates in the elevator and vertical mobility industry, providing solutions across elevators, escalators, moving walks, modernisation, maintenance and specialised mobility applications.

Our operations bring together corporate, project, service and field teams, making strong people coordination, responsive HR support and operational discipline integral to the organisation.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Candidates meeting the above requirements are requested to send their **updated resume** to:

**hr@gilcoglobal.in**

**Email Subject:** Application – HR \& Administration Executive \| Mumbai

Please mention the following details while applying:

* Current location
* Total experience
* Relevant HR \& Administration experience
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice period / earliest possible joining date

**Please note: Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in a similar HR \& Administration position is mandatory.**

title: X-Ray Technician
description:
**Position:** X\-Ray Technician / Radiographer  
**Department:** Radiology / Diagnostic Imaging  
**Location:** Sultanpur, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Radiologist / Medical Superintendent / Hospital Administrator

1\. Job Summary

We are looking for a **qualified and skilled X\-Ray Technician/Radiographer** to operate diagnostic X\-ray equipment safely and efficiently. The selected candidate will be responsible for performing routine radiographic examinations, ensuring proper patient positioning and image quality, maintaining radiation\-safety standards, and assisting the Radiologist/Medical Team as required.

The candidate must strictly follow applicable **AERB radiation\-safety requirements, hospital protocols, infection\-control practices, and patient\-safety standards**.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Radiography \& Patient Care

* Perform routine X\-ray examinations as prescribed by the Radiologist/authorized Medical Practitioner.
* Verify patient identity, examination request and relevant clinical information before the procedure.
* Explain the procedure to patients and obtain cooperation while maintaining dignity and privacy.
* Position patients correctly to obtain diagnostically acceptable images.
* Select appropriate exposure factors according to the examination and patient condition.
* Operate X\-ray equipment safely and efficiently.
* Ensure proper image acquisition, processing and quality before completing the examination.
* Repeat images only when clinically/radiographically necessary and in accordance with radiation\-safety principles.
* Assist with emergency and portable/mobile X\-ray examinations when required.

B. Radiation Safety \& AERB Compliance

* Follow all applicable **AERB guidelines and radiation\-protection procedures**.
* Use radiation protection devices such as lead apron, thyroid shield, protective barriers and other prescribed equipment.
* Ensure that unnecessary radiation exposure to patients, staff and attendants is avoided.
* Maintain and use personal radiation monitoring/dosimetry as required.
* Follow departmental protocols for radiation protection and controlled access to the X\-ray area.
* Immediately report equipment malfunction, radiation\-safety concerns or unusual incidents to the appropriate authority.
* Support periodic quality assurance and safety checks of X\-ray equipment.
* Maintain required records related to radiography, equipment, radiation monitoring and quality control.

AERB requires medical X\-ray installations to have qualified/trained personnel, radiation protection measures and personnel monitoring for radiation workers.

C. Equipment \& Departmental Responsibilities

* Perform daily/basic operational checks of X\-ray equipment before use.
* Maintain the cleanliness and proper functioning of the X\-ray room and accessories.
* Report equipment faults promptly and coordinate with authorized service personnel.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of radiographic accessories.
* Follow preventive maintenance and quality\-control schedules.
* Maintain accurate examination registers and electronic records/PACS/RIS entries, where applicable.

D. Infection Control \& Patient Safety

* Follow hospital infection\-control policies and standard precautions.
* Clean/disinfect equipment and patient\-contact surfaces as per protocol.
* Follow appropriate precautions for infectious, immobile, pediatric and emergency patients.
* Ensure safe transfer and positioning of patients to prevent falls or injuries.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and professional conduct at all times.

3\. Educational Qualification

**Essential:**

* Diploma/Certificate in **Radiography / X\-Ray Technology / Medical Radiography** from a **recognized institution/Board/University**, as applicable.
* Candidates must meet the applicable regulatory requirements for operating medical X\-ray equipment.

AERB's current diagnostic\-radiology guidance identifies the operator qualification as a **Radiographer's/X\-ray Technologist's course from a recognized Institution/Board/University**.

**Preferred:**

* B.Sc. in Medical Radiography / Radiological Imaging Technology or equivalent.
* Additional training in radiation safety, CT, CR/DR, PACS/RIS or other diagnostic imaging systems.

4\. Experience

* **Freshers:** May be considered if appropriately qualified and trained.
* **Experienced candidates:** Preferably **1–3 years of experience** in a hospital, diagnostic centre or imaging facility.
* Experience with **CR/DR digital X\-ray systems, portable X\-ray and PACS/RIS** will be an advantage.

5\. Technical Skills

The candidate should have practical knowledge of:

* Routine radiographic procedures
* Patient positioning and radiographic techniques
* Exposure\-factor selection
* Digital X\-ray / CR / DR systems
* Radiation protection and dose optimization
* Basic equipment troubleshooting
* PACS/RIS and digital image handling
* Infection prevention and control
* Emergency/portable radiography, where applicable

6\. Professional Competencies

* Good patient\-handling and communication skills
* Attention to detail and image\-quality awareness
* Ability to work calmly in emergency situations
* Team\-oriented approach
* Professional ethics and confidentiality
* Ability to work in shifts, including weekends/emergencies, if required
* Commitment to patient safety and radiation safety

7\. Regulatory \& Safety Compliance

The technician must comply with:

* Applicable **AERB requirements for medical X\-ray installations**
* Hospital/diagnostic\-centre radiation\-safety policies
* Applicable personnel monitoring/dosimetry requirements
* Equipment quality\-assurance procedures
* Infection\-control and biomedical\-waste procedures, where applicable
* Instructions of the Radiologist, Medical Superintendent and designated Radiological Safety Officer (RSO)

For medical X\-ray facilities, AERB also provides for designation of an appropriate **Radiological Safety Officer (RSO)** and requires radiation\-protection measures and personnel monitoring.

8\. Job Location

**Sultanpur, Uttar Pradesh**

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

 **discover them by scrolling** 
 , and if it resonates and
 **vibes with them** 
 , they can
 **connect instantly.** 




  





 On the surface, it collapses fragmented workflows into one system.
 



  





 Underneath, we are building something far deeper: The Human Experience Engine, our Persona Compatibility layer. This engine matches the right person with the right fit at the right time, based on who they are, what they want, and how they connect.
 



  





 The founder's vision is to layer cognitive science into
 **human persona compatibility** 
 , leading to hyper\-personalized, real\-time human connections.
 



  





 Xuman.AI is the productization of the founder's previous bootstrapped venture: ideation, market research, pilots, MVP, and a technical foundation built to scale.
 **The product is built and live on both app stores.** 
 We are past the building phase and into distribution: getting it in front of real users and turning it into a repeatable business.
 



  





**Why this role matters:** 




 The models move every month, and the products that keep up are built by people who treat agents as the unit of work, not the chat box. This seat builds agentic systems inside a live app with real users and real money: agents that reason, call tools, act, and get checked before anything reaches a person. You ship it, you measure it, and you are the one who knows what the next model release changes.
 



  





**What you'll own:** 




 \- Agentic systems in production: agents that plan, call tools and act inside a live app, on both stores
 



 \- The orchestration layer: multi\-agent flows, context and memory, routing between models
 



 \- Guardrails and safety agents: what gets checked before an action or a piece of content reaches a user
 



 \- Voice and real\-time pipelines: speech in, reasoning, speech out, inside a latency budget
 



 \- Evals and cost: every prompt or model change proven before it ships, every conversation priced
 



  





**Must have:** 




 \- Two years or more building with LLMs, and you have shipped something agentic to real users
 



 \- Agents and tool calling in production, including what happens when a tool fails or a model is slow or wrong
 



 \- Multi\-step or multi\-agent orchestration you designed: LangGraph or equivalent, and the judgement to keep it simple
 



 \- Genuine prompt and system design thinking: you can explain why something works
 



 \- Evals you built yourself, so a change is proven rather than asserted
 



 \- Python in production, and comfort in a TypeScript service. Ours is a NestJS gateway.
 



 \- Structured outputs, streaming and function calling as daily tools, across more than one model provider
 



 \- Model cost and latency treated as engineering problems, not surprises
 



 \- You follow the field as it moves: new models, agent protocols, what changed this month and what it means for what you built
 



 \- You use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) daily to write, debug, and ship faster. Not optional; this is how we work.
 



  





**What you'll get:** 




 \- Agentic systems in real hands, with your name on them, on a product that is live today
 



 \- The frontier as the day job: every new model and protocol is yours to try the week it lands
 



 \- Real say in how the AI layer is built, from the first feature you ship
 



 \- The lead seat above you as a real next step, and pay that grows with the milestones
 



 \- The models and tools you need, with no procurement queue
 



  





 You are joining before growth, not after.
 **What you own here is real, and it grows as fast as you do.** 




  





 If this seat reads like yours, apply with confidence. Every application is reviewed personally.

title: DeFi Quant Researcher
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DeFi Quant Researcher based in India.**
 This role offers the opportunity to research and develop systematic trading strategies specifically for decentralized finance markets.
   

  

 You will investigate on\-chain mechanics and market structure to uncover measurable, repeatable sources of alpha.
   

  

 Your work will span DeFi protocols including automated market makers, lending markets, perpetuals, yield vaults, and cross\-chain venues.
   

  

 You will combine mathematical rigor, statistical research, and strong programming skills to turn raw blockchain data into actionable strategies.
   

  

 The role provides end\-to\-end ownership, from hypothesis generation and backtesting through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
   

  

 You will work closely with portfolio managers and engineers in a highly technical, research\-driven environment where ideas can move quickly into live capital.
   

  

 This opportunity is particularly suited to a self\-directed researcher with deep DeFi knowledge and a strong interest in systematic on\-chain trading.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Research and develop systematic trading strategies across decentralized finance protocols, including AMMs, lending markets, perpetuals, yield vaults, and cross\-chain trading venues.
* Identify and validate alpha signals using on\-chain data such as liquidity movements, wallet behavior, MEV activity, funding rates, and protocol\-level incentives.
* Analyze smart contract mechanics, protocol architecture, tokenomics, and market structures to identify structural and exploitable trading opportunities.
* Build rigorous backtests and simulations that accurately account for DeFi\-specific factors including gas costs, slippage, block timing, execution constraints, and data availability.
* Develop research pipelines and analytical tooling using on\-chain data sources, raw blockchain data, and relevant decentralized data platforms.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate validated research into production\-ready strategies and deploy them against live capital.
* Monitor live strategy performance, investigate deviations from expected results, and iterate rapidly based on market behavior and empirical evidence.
* Contribute to shared quantitative research infrastructure, data pipelines, experimentation frameworks, and on\-chain analytics capabilities.
* Maintain high research standards by actively testing for lookahead bias, data leakage, overfitting, survivorship bias, and other methodological weaknesses.


**Requirements**
* Strong mathematical, scientific, or quantitative background, ideally demonstrated through a degree or postgraduate education in mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, or a comparable discipline.
* Deep, hands\-on familiarity with DeFi protocols and on\-chain market structure, supported by meaningful practical experience rather than purely theoretical knowledge.
* Proven experience working with on\-chain data sources such as The Graph, Dune, blockchain node data, or comparable datasets and building research workflows around them.
* Strong Python programming skills for quantitative research, data analysis, simulation, and strategy development.
* Familiarity with Solidity, smart contract development, or smart contract auditing is a plus.
* Strong statistical rigor and a disciplined approach to validating quantitative hypotheses, particularly around data leakage, lookahead bias, overfitting, and execution assumptions.
* Ability to independently own research from idea generation through validation, implementation, and ongoing evaluation.
* For junior candidates, strong evidence of research capability through relevant projects, open\-source contributions, competitive programming, Kaggle work, or on\-chain trading experiments.
* For senior candidates, a demonstrable and attributable track record in DeFi, blockchain markets, or systematic on\-chain trading is highly valuable.
* Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving research environment.
* Willingness to work across Asia or US time zones to support live market coverage and rapid strategy iteration.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work on systematic trading strategies at the intersection of quantitative finance and decentralized markets.
* End\-to\-end ownership of research, from developing hypotheses and signals to backtesting, deployment, and live performance monitoring.
* Direct collaboration with experienced portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and engineering teams.
* Exposure to a broad range of DeFi protocols, on\-chain datasets, market structures, and emerging trading opportunities.
* Opportunity to develop strategies that can progress from research concepts to deployment with live capital.
* Access to shared research infrastructure, on\-chain data pipelines, and specialized quantitative tooling.
* Highly technical, research\-first environment that values independent thinking, rigor, and high\-agency execution.
* Rolling start and international working environment with opportunities across global markets and time zones.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer.  Full\-time
 




  





**Experience:** 


**6 Months to 1 Year Maximum** 






  





**Education:** 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, I.T, Engineering, or a related field
 




  





**About HabotConnect FZCO** 




  






 HabotConnect is a Dubai\-based, bootstrapped, 100% remote company building a digital platform that connects parents with Learning Support Assistants (LSA) for children with learning difficulties. We operate in a high\-ownership, accountability\-driven remote culture where quality, structural clarity, and architectural precision come before speed.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 Are you highly logical, detail\-oriented, and obsessed with clean mobile architecture? As our
 
**Flutter Mobile App Developer** 

 , you will bring mobile\-first experiences to life using our standardized Flutter component library, implementing strict stateless architecture rules, and maintaining absolute fidelity to our Figma designs.
 




  





**A Day in the Life:** 






  





 Your day revolves around writing modular, atomic code blocks ("Byts") in Flutter. You will translate Figma source designs into pixel\-perfect interfaces, map backend REST API endpoints directly to UI fields, enforce strict data lineage standards, and ensure fail\-closed security mechanisms across every mobile build .
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities** 




**Your daily deliverables include:** 




  





**1\. Core Development \& Architecture** 




  




* Build, scale, and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications primarily using Flutter and Dart.
* Adhere strictly to a stateless paradigm, ensuring no critical data resides in volatile memory to align with our Cloud Run backend infrastructure.
* Write modular, highly maintainable code following our internal "Byt" boundary standard.
* Implement robust fail\-closed security mechanisms where any logic error or null response in compliance checks immediately halts data movement.



  





**2\. Design System \& UX Integration** 




  




* Lead application flow development with a Mobile\-First priority before scaling to larger layout views.
* Leverage our Universal Component Library and strictly adhere to standardized Google Material Design templates.
* Translate designs from Figma (our official Source Document) into high\-fidelity code.
* Implement automated friction logging systems to capture user UI hesitations (stalls lasting $\> 5$ seconds).



  





**3\. API \& Data Governance** 




  




* Map API endpoints provided by the backend team directly to designated UI fields according to integration protocols.
* Enforce data integrity standards by ensuring no write operation occurs without a valid predecessor\_id to eliminate orphan data.
* Ensure all outbound data packets inject required Metadata Headers (trace\_id, logic\_hash) for full lineage tracking.



  





**4\. Quality \& Release Management** 




  




* Validate applications across a defined matrix of target physical devices and OS versions.
* Conduct pre\-release audits checking both Feature Status (e.g., Auth screens) and Integration Status.
* Secure the mandatory Endorsement Document (ED) prior to registering or deploying builds to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.



  





**Core Competencies** 




  





**Technical Skills \& Tools:** 




  




* **Flutter \& Dart:** 

 Cross\-platform mobile development using atomic "Byt" logic.
* **Figma:** 

 High\-fidelity Figma\-to\-code translation.
* **Google Material Design:** 

 Implementation of standardized UI component libraries.
* **REST APIs \& Cloud Run:** 

 Endpoint\-to\-field mapping, predecessor\_id write validation, and stateless integration.
* **GitHub Actions:** 

 CI/CD automation, device matrix testing, and release gatekeeping.



  





**Soft Skills:** 




  




* Meticulous attention to detail and zero tolerance for UI or logic ambiguity.
* Extreme structural discipline and system\-focused execution .
* Clear, system\-focused communication without relying on subjective guesswork.



  





**Onboarding \& Success Path** 




  






 Selected candidates must successfully complete a mandatory structured onboarding and training program. Engagement and progress during onboarding are closely monitored and form part of the probation evaluation. Failure to complete required training or demonstrate sufficient involvement may result in the offer being withdrawn or contract termination.
 




  





**What This Role Is NOT** 




  




* This is
 
**NOT** 

 a backend Python or Node.js server coding position .
* This is
 
**NOT** 

 a creative UI/UX graphic design role .
* This is
 
**NOT** 

 a role for guessing or improvising logic; precision and strict adherence to rule guidelines are mandatory .



  





**Application Process** 




  






 Interested candidates are invited to apply. As part of our evaluation process, you will be required to complete a short
 
**Hiring Project Form (HPF)** 

 simulating the analytical and technical tasks of this role.
 




  





 ●

**● Submission Link:** 
 https://forms.gle/8H93LqBKkM6R9gaYA
 



 ●

 : 02\-September\-2026
 



  





**Note:** 

 You only have one chance to submit. We are looking for quality of implementation and clarity of impact. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a virtual panel interview.
 




  





**Final Self\-Screening Checklist** 




  





**Apply ONLY if:** 




  




* You have
 
**6 months to 1 year** 

 of professional mobile development experience with Flutter \& Dart.

**18,000 INR to 21,000 INR per month** 

 .

**immediately**

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Virtual Element Studios
 
 Virtual Element Studios (VES) is a B2B engineering visualization and digital experience company working with industrial and engineering organizations across India and international markets.
 



 Our solutions include:
 


* 3D Product \& Process Animation
* Plant Walkthroughs \& Industrial Visualization
* Safety, Training \& SOP Videos
* Corporate \& Industrial Films
* AR / VR Experiences
* Interactive 3D Applications \& Virtual Showrooms
* Digital Twin \& Real\-time 3D Visualization
* 360° Virtual Tours
* Technical Marketing \& Digital Content Solutions



 Our customers primarily include industrial manufacturers, engineering companies, automation companies, EPC organizations, process industries, infrastructure companies and multinational organizations.
   




 Position
 
**Job Title:** 
 Business Development Manager
 



**Department:** 
 Business Development / Sales
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Business Head / Management
 



**Industry:** 
 Engineering Visualization, 3D Animation, AR/VR \& Digital Solutions
   




 Role Objective
 
 The Business Development Manager will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing customer relationships and converting opportunities into sustainable business for Virtual Element Studios.
 



 This is a
 **consultative B2B sales role** 
 .
 



 The candidate will be expected to understand the customer's business, products, processes and communication challenges and identify how VES solutions can support areas such as:
 


* Product marketing
* Sales presentations
* Technical communication
* Process visualization
* Customer education
* Safety \& operational training
* Exhibition experiences
* AR/VR applications
* Interactive product experiences
* Digital transformation initiatives



 The role requires a combination of
 **business development, relationship management, field sales, opportunity identification and disciplined follow\-up** 
 .
   




 Key Responsibilities1\. New Business Development
 * Identify and develop potential customers across relevant industrial sectors.
* Generate qualified business enquiries through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, exhibitions, LinkedIn, databases and market research.
* Connect with relevant decision\-makers across Marketing, Sales, Engineering, Training, Operations, Safety and Digital Transformation teams.
* Conduct introductory meetings and presentations explaining VES capabilities.
* Understand upcoming projects, requirements and business opportunities within target accounts.
* Develop a healthy and continuously growing sales pipeline.


 2\. Client Meetings \& Requirement Understanding
 * Conduct online as well as face\-to\-face customer meetings.
* Visit industrial customers, factories, exhibitions and industrial clusters regularly.
* Understand the customer's actual business requirement rather than simply pitching VES services.
* Capture information related to project objectives, intended audience, technical inputs, timelines, expected deliverables and commercial expectations.
* Coordinate internally with the appropriate technical/creative team whenever detailed solution consultation is required.



 The BDM is
 **not expected to independently decide complex technical scope** 
 . Technical feasibility, execution strategy and effort estimation should be discussed with the relevant VES team.
 


 3\. Proposal \& Opportunity Management
 * Coordinate preparation of proposals, quotations, presentations and reference material.
* Ensure proposals address the customer's actual requirement and business objective.
* Maintain structured follow\-up on submitted proposals.
* Identify objections, commercial concerns, approval dependencies and decision timelines.
* Negotiate commercials within the approved framework.
* Escalate requests involving major discounts, additional scope, unusual payment terms or delivery commitments to management.



 No additional deliverables, free revisions, unrealistic timelines or commercial commitments should be promised without internal approval.
 


 4\. Sales Conversion \& Order Closure
 
 Take ownership of opportunities from enquiry to commercial closure.
 



 This includes:
 


* Requirement qualification
* Customer meetings
* Internal coordination
* Proposal submission
* Follow\-ups
* Negotiation
* Commercial closure
* Purchase Order / Work Order follow\-up



 The objective is not only to generate meetings or enquiries but to consistently convert qualified opportunities into business.
 


 5\. Existing Account Development
 
 Business development at VES is not limited to acquiring new customers.
 



 The BDM will also be expected to:
 


* Maintain regular engagement with assigned existing customers.
* Understand upcoming projects and business plans.
* Identify additional departments and stakeholders within key accounts.
* Introduce relevant VES capabilities based on customer requirements.
* Generate repeat business from existing customers.
* Reactivate dormant accounts.
* Build long\-term professional relationships instead of approaching customers only when an order is expected.



 Special focus should be given to
 **account penetration** 
 — developing multiple contacts and opportunities within strategically important customers.
 


 6\. CRM \& Pipeline Management
 
 Maintain accurate and updated records in
 **Zoho CRM** 
 .
 



 The BDM will be responsible for maintaining:
 


* Customer and contact information
* Enquiry details
* Opportunity value
* Current sales stage
* Proposal status
* Expected closure date
* Follow\-up actions
* Customer discussions
* Lost opportunity reasons



 The CRM should reflect the
 **actual status of the opportunity** 
 , not an optimistic or outdated sales position.
 



 A clear and visible pipeline is an important part of the role.
 


 7\. Sales\-to\-Operations Handover
 
 Once an order is confirmed, the BDM must ensure a structured handover to the Operations team.
 



 The handover should clearly communicate:
 


* Final approved scope
* Proposal and commercials
* Customer inputs
* Delivery commitments
* Important discussions during the sales stage
* Special customer expectations
* Items specifically included or excluded
* Any potential project risks



 Final proposals and relevant inputs must be properly documented and uploaded as per the VES project initiation process.
 



 Sales continues to support the relationship and commercial communication after handover while project execution ownership moves to Operations.
 


 8\. Market \& Opportunity Development
 
 Continuously track developments in industries relevant to VES, including:
 


* Industrial Automation
* Robotics
* Material Handling
* Process Equipment
* Pumps, Valves \& Flow Control
* EPC \& Industrial Projects
* Energy \& Utilities
* Automotive \& Auto Components
* Electrical \& Electronics
* Industrial Manufacturing
* Infrastructure
* Packaging \& Material Processing
* Construction \& Heavy Engineering



 Identify companies, projects, expansions, exhibitions and market developments that may create opportunities for VES.
   




 Key Performance Indicators
 
 Performance will be evaluated using a combination of
 **revenue performance, pipeline development and sales discipline** 
 .
 



 Major KPIs will include:
 


* New business revenue / order booking
* Qualified enquiries generated
* Sales pipeline value
* Proposal value generated
* Proposal\-to\-order conversion
* New customer acquisition
* Repeat business from assigned accounts
* Existing account development
* Number and quality of meaningful customer meetings
* Follow\-up discipline
* CRM accuracy and hygiene
* Sales forecast accuracy



 Revenue targets and enquiry\-generation targets will be defined periodically based on territory, experience and assigned accounts.
 



 The emphasis will be on
 **quality of opportunities and conversion** 
 , rather than simply achieving a high number of calls or meetings.
   




 Candidate ProfileExperience
 
 Preferred:
 


* 3–7 years of experience in B2B Business Development / Industrial Sales / Solution Sales / Technical Sales / Digital Services Sales.
* Experience dealing with manufacturing, engineering or industrial customers will be strongly preferred.



 Candidates from the following industries can be particularly relevant:
 


* Industrial automation
* Engineering services
* Technical marketing
* Industrial software
* CAD / PLM / Digital Engineering
* AR / VR / Simulation
* 3D visualization
* Digital transformation
* Industrial media / communication services
* Marketing or technology solutions for manufacturing companies


 Skills Required
 
 The candidate should possess:
 


* Strong B2B communication skills
* Ability to interact confidently with senior customer stakeholders
* Good presentation and negotiation skills
* Ability to understand technical and industrial concepts
* Consultative selling ability
* Relationship\-building skills
* Strong follow\-up discipline

title: Robotics Simulation Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 What if the physics simulations you build could teach the next generation of robots how to walk, grasp, and navigate the real world? We're looking for Robotics Simulation Engineers in Bangalore to design, build, and optimize high\-fidelity physical simulations that bridge the gap between virtual environments and real\-world robotic systems.
   

  

 Bangalore's deep engineering talent and growing robotics ecosystem make it an ideal base for this work. You'll work at the intersection of robotics, physics, and software engineering — creating simulation pipelines that power robot learning, controls development, and hardware validation.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No corporate red tape — just meaningful, technical work on problems that matter.
   

  

* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design and implement high\-fidelity robot models (URDF/MJCF) with accurate kinematics, dynamics, and contact properties
* Build and maintain simulation environments using MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and/or Gazebo
* Develop end\-to\-end simulation pipelines for robot training, testing, and validation
* Tune physics parameters — friction, damping, inertia, actuator models — to maximize sim\-to\-real transfer
* Integrate simulations with ROS2 for perception, planning, and control workflows
* Write clean, performant code in Python and/or C\+\+ to support simulation infrastructure
* Collaborate asynchronously with robotics researchers and engineers on model accuracy and environment design
* Profile and optimize simulation performance for large\-scale or parallelized runs
* Document simulation configurations, model parameters, and pipeline architecture


**Who You Are**
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one major robotics simulator: MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or Gazebo
* Proficient in Python and/or C\+\+ in a robotics or scientific computing context
* Solid understanding of rigid\-body dynamics, contact mechanics, and control theory
* Experience creating and validating robot models (URDF, MJCF, or SDF formats)
* Familiarity with ROS2 and its integration with simulation environments
* Comfortable working with simulation pipelines — from environment setup to data collection and evaluation
* Self\-directed, detail\-oriented, and effective when working independently
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and a drive to close the sim\-to\-real gap


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with domain randomization, sim\-to\-real transfer techniques, or reinforcement learning in simulation
* Familiarity with GPU\-accelerated simulation (e.g., Isaac Gym, MuJoCo MJX)
* Background in legged locomotion, manipulation, or multi\-body systems
* Experience with CI/CD for simulation testing and automated validation
* Knowledge of sensor simulation — cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, force/torque sensors
* Contributions to open\-source robotics or simulation projects
* Graduate\-level coursework or research in robotics, controls, or computational physics


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge robotics simulation projects that directly impact how robots learn and perform
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where you're most productive
* Freelance autonomy with technically challenging, meaningful work
* Collaborate with a global community of robotics and AI professionals
* Gain exposure to state\-of\-the\-art simulation frameworks and research\-grade problems
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: MTF Risk & Business Executive
description:
### **STEPS FOR SUCCESS IN CAREER**


At Adroit, we understand and value relationships. Therefore, we offer multiple business and career opportunities to people having positive attitude.


Our ability to provide excellent financial service solutions is a result of its large pool of skilled manpower. We have a strong focus on human resource operations, which is an important part of our firm's business strategy.


At each level, Adroit employees have a pre\-defined career path and hence an opportunity for continuous growth. We believe in our people, reflected in the blend of youth and experience that we have in our team compositions.


We are looking for young dynamic minds like you who share our vision for revolutionizing the Indian stock broking industry. Therefore, if you have the ability to satisfy our requirements and can face the pressure and challenge, you are welcome to our organization.


As a growing organization, we are seeking associates in all our field of operations, ranging from Research to Back Office.


  
### **MTF Risk \& Business Executive**

**Adroit Financial Services Pvt. Ltd**

  

Adroit is one of India's leading financial market services companies, providing a bouquet of capital market services including securities, broking, advisory, depository, equity research, derivatives, commodities trading, currency futures, and IPO distribution.

 **Job Title: MTF Risk \& Business Executive**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Department: MTF Segment**

**Experience: 2–4 Years ( Freshers are not allowed )**

**Compensation – As per Industry Standards**

 **Job Summary:**


We are looking for a proactive and analytical professional to manage our Margin Trading Facility


(MTF) operations while driving business growth. The role involves monitoring risk exposure,


ensuring regulatory compliance, and working closely with the sales team to promote MTF


adoption among clients. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of equity


markets, risk management, and client engagement.

**MTF Promotion – Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement strategies to promote MTF (Margin Trading Facility) among eligible clients.
* Identify potential clients based on their trading activity and portfolio behaviour.
* Work closely with Sales, Relationship Managers, Branches, and Dealers to increase MTF adoption.
* Conduct product awareness and training sessions for internal sales teams.
* Explain MTF benefits, funding costs, margin requirements, and associated risks to clients.
* Develop campaigns and initiatives to increase MTF activation and utilization.
* Monitor MTF sales performance, client activation, utilization, and revenue.
* Identify new opportunities to increase the MTF book size and profitability.
* Ensure all MTF promotional activities comply with applicable SEBI, exchange, and internal compliance requirements.
* Focus on responsible MTF promotion while maintaining appropriate risk controls.

**MTF Risk Management – Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor client\-level and overall MTF exposure on a daily basis.
* Monitor margin utilization, margin shortfalls, and MTM losses and ensure timely action.
* Set and monitor appropriate client, security, and portfolio\-level exposure limits.
* Identify and manage concentration risk across clients, stocks, and sectors.
* Monitor the liquidity and volatility of securities funded under MTF.
* Identify high\-risk accounts and escalate them to the Risk/Compliance team.
* Ensure timely margin calls and position reduction/liquidation as per internal policy and applicable regulations.
* Monitor collateral and ensure adequate margin is maintained.
* Assess the impact of market volatility on MTF positions and overall portfolio risk.
* Review and recommend suitable securities for MTF based on risk parameters.
* Develop daily MTF risk MIS covering exposure, margin shortfalls, concentration, and high\-risk positions.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Compliance, and Technology teams to resolve risk\-related issues.
* Ensure all MTF activities remain within approved regulatory and internal risk limits.
* Strengthen risk controls and processes to minimize client default, market, liquidity, operational, and compliance risks.

**MTF Compliance – Key Responsibilities:**

* Ensure all MTF activities comply with applicable SEBI, stock exchange, and internal regulatory requirements.
* Maintain strong knowledge of MTF\-related regulatory circulars, margin requirements, eligible securities, exposure limits, and client\-level requirements.
* Ensure proper client consent, documentation, disclosures, and MTF activation procedures are completed.
* Monitor compliance with approved MTF policies, SOPs, and risk limits.
* Regularly review regulatory updates and assess their impact on MTF operations.
* Coordinate with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Legal, and Technology teams for implementation of regulatory requirements.
* Ensure accurate and timely regulatory reporting and record maintenance.
* Identify compliance gaps, investigate exceptions, and ensure timely corrective action.
* Monitor MTF transactions and client accounts for policy or regulatory breaches.
* Ensure appropriate client communication regarding margin requirements, funding costs, risks, and applicable MTF terms.
* Support internal, statutory, and regulatory audits and inspections.
* Conduct periodic reviews of MTF processes to identify and mitigate compliance risks.
* Ensure any changes in regulatory requirements are properly incorporated into systems, processes, and SOPs.

**Summary :** Drive MTF business growth by identifying eligible clients, developing promotional strategies, coordinating with sales teams, conducting product awareness initiatives, and increasing MTF activation and utilization while ensuring compliance and risk controls.


Ensure end\-to\-end MTF operations comply with applicable SEBI, stock exchange, and internal regulatory requirements, including client documentation, disclosures, margin requirements, eligible securities, exposure limits, reporting, and record maintenance. Coordinate with Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to identify and resolve compliance gaps and implement regulatory changes.

The Field Sales Executive will play a key role in converting prospective customers into successful property buyers by meeting clients, understanding their requirements, conducting site visits, presenting projects professionally, following up consistently, and supporting customers throughout the sales process until booking and closure.

Job Purpose

The primary responsibility of the **Field Sales Executive – Real Estate** is to manage qualified customer leads, conduct property site visits, explain project features and investment benefits, build strong customer relationships, handle objections, follow up effectively, and contribute towards achieving the company's sales targets.

The role requires excellent communication skills, a strong interest in sales, willingness to travel for customer meetings and site visits, and the ability to work in a target\-driven environment.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Customer Lead Management

* Preferred location
* Budget
* Plot or villa requirement
* Required land/building size
* Investment or self\-use purpose
* Preferred timeline for purchase
* Maintain regular communication with assigned customers.
* Ensure every qualified lead receives timely attention and professional service.

2\. Site Visit Management

* Coordinate with customers and schedule convenient site visit appointments.
* Confirm site visit timings and customer availability.
* Travel to project locations for customer site visits.
* Welcome and assist customers during their visit.
* Provide a complete and professional walkthrough of the project.
* Explain the layout, plot availability, road access, amenities, approvals, location advantages, connectivity, and future development potential.
* Show customers suitable plots, villas, or available units based on their requirements.
* Ensure customers have a positive and comfortable site visit experience.

3\. Property Presentation \& Sales

* Present Fortune Realty projects professionally and confidently.

* Property specifications
* Plot/villa sizes
* Pricing
* Payment options
* Layout features
* Road access and infrastructure
* Approvals and legal documentation, as authorized by the company
* Nearby developments
* Connectivity advantages
* Investment potential and future appreciation factors
* Highlight the unique selling points of each project.
* Match the right property options with the customer's requirements and budget.
* Guide customers towards making informed purchase decisions.

4\. Sales Conversion \& Closing

* Build trust and confidence with prospective customers.
* Understand customer concerns and objections.
* Handle objections professionally relating to:
* Price
* Location
* Budget
* Payment
* Family approval
* Comparison with other properties
* Timing of purchase
* Investment returns
* Provide relevant information and solutions within the company's approved sales guidelines.
* Follow up consistently with interested customers.
* Coordinate with the Sales Manager for negotiation and closure support when required.
* Assist in converting customer interest into bookings and successful sales.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales and revenue targets.

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing customers.
* Provide prompt responses to customer calls and messages.
* Maintain professionalism and transparency in all customer interactions.
* Keep customers informed about relevant project updates, offers, availability, and opportunities.
* Support customers throughout the booking and documentation process in coordination with the concerned internal teams.
* Encourage satisfied customers to provide referrals and recommendations.

6\. Follow\-Up \& Lead Conversion

* Identify leads based on their level of interest, such as:
* Hot Leads
* Warm Leads
* Future Prospects
* Prepare appropriate follow\-up strategies for different categories of customers.
* Ensure no valuable lead is missed due to delayed communication.
* Update customer interactions and next follow\-up dates regularly.
* Work closely with the Telecalling team to ensure continuous lead nurturing.

* Coordinate with the Telecalling team regarding customer requirements and appointment schedules.
* Share customer feedback and site visit outcomes with the Sales Manager.
* Coordinate with the Marketing team regarding new campaigns, offers, and project updates.
* Work with the Documentation and Accounts teams during the booking process when required.
* Attend daily, weekly, and monthly sales review meetings.
* Participate actively in product training and sales development programs.

title: Product Manager
