**About Valiance** 




 Valiance is a deeptech AI company building sovereign and mission\-critical solutions for enterprises, public sector, and government institutions. From predictive maintenance and demand planning to sovereign AI for citizen services, we design systems that thrive in high\-impact environments. Recognized with the NASSCOM AI GameChangers Award and the Aegis Graham Bell Award, and as a Google Cloud Partner, our 200\+ engineers and data scientists are shaping the future of industries and societies with responsible AI.
 



  





  





**The Rol** 




 We're hiring a Product Manager to own our Tender Intelligence solution end\-to\-end — an AI product that helps enterprises discover, analyze, and act on tender/RFP opportunities. You'll sit at the intersection of AI/dev teams, customers, and go\-to\-market, and you'll be the person who turns ambiguity into shipped product
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Write clear, detailed PRDs that AI and engineering teams can build from — including edge cases, success metrics, and acceptance criteria
* Drive customer demos and act as the technical/product face of the solution in front of prospects and clients

* Resolve ambiguity across AI, engineering, design, and sales teams, and drive decisions to closure

* Strong written communication — able to translate ambiguous requirements into precise PRDs.
* Comfortable presenting to customers and at external events.
* High ownership mindset — you drive things forward without needing to be chased.
* Tier\-1 educational background: Computer Science/Engineering \+ MBA prefered

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
🌟
 **Role Overview:** 




  





 The Technical Program Manager (TPM) drives complex, cross\-functional technical programs from planning through execution and delivery.
 



 At redBus, we recognize that the best TPMs sit at the intersection of business strategy and deep engineering execution. This role is specifically tailored for lateral hires who hold a post\-graduate degree in management (MBA) coupled with a solid foundation in software engineering.
 



 You will act as the key strategic bridge connecting Product, Engineering, QA, and Business teams. Whether you are translating business objectives into scalable products, orchestrating regional market expansions, or piloting new generative AI capabilities, you will be the collaborative anchor who brings business logic and engineering execution together.
 



  





 🚀
 **Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 💼
 **Strategic Program Delivery \& Business Translation:** 




  




* Business\-to\-Tech Translation: Translate high\-level business goals, market entry strategies, and product metrics into clear, actionable technical execution plans, milestones, and measurable engineering outcomes.
* Cross\-Domain Orchestration: Lead complex, cross\-functional technical programs, geo\-expansions (e.g., managing timelines, resource capacity, and rollout plans across international markets), and strategic engineering initiatives.
* Prioritization \& ROI Partnering: Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering Directors to evaluate trade\-offs, balance technical complexity against business impact, and optimize resource allocation.
* Stakeholder Governance \& Communication: Drive executive\-level program governance. Synthesize complex technical blockers, architectural decisions, and delivery risks into clear, business\-focused updates for leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders.



  





 ⚙️
 **Engineering Execution \& Operational Excellence:** 




  




* Architectural \& Design Empathy: Draw on your past engineering background to participate actively in architecture, API integration, and system reviews. Help identify technical risks, interface bottlenecks, and system dependencies early.
* Operational Metrics \& Analytics: Apply business analytics to engineering delivery. Track, analyze, and optimize performance metrics (such as Sprint Delivery Predictability, Defect Density, and Time\-Weighted Build Delay) to implement data\-driven process improvements.
* Sprint Readiness \& Governance: Enforce a healthy Definition of Readiness (DoR) and promote "Shift\-Left" quality practices to ensure developers and QA align early, reducing post\-release issues.



  





 🤖
 **AI Program \& Change Leadership** 




  




* AI Initiative Orchestration: Drive customer\-facing AI and GenAI programs from experimental proof\-of\-concept (PoC) through to scalable production and adoption.
* AI Success Metrics: Establish and monitor performance metrics that capture both engineering efficiency and business value (e.g., system latency, accuracy, and user adoption rates).



 ⚡ Automation \& Productivity (Internal Leverage)
 


* Agile Tooling \& Workflow Optimization: Use scripting, APIs, or low\-code frameworks to prototype lightweight dashboards, JIRA automations, and reporting workflows that save engineering hours.
* Process Redesign: Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable mechanisms that eliminate manual tracking and coordination overhead.



  





 🛠️
 **Qualifications** 




**🎓 Required Qualifications** 



* Educational Background: Post\-Graduate Degree in Management (MBA or equivalent) from a premier institution, coupled with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.
* Prior Technical Experience: Strong foundations in software engineering (SDLC, database architectures, and release workflows) with a proven track record of working as a Software Engineer, SDET, DevOps, or Test Engineer prior to your MBA.
* Strategic \& Analytical Skills: Outstanding business acumen with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, build decision\-making frameworks, and analyze delivery data to drive action.
* Communication \& Influencing: Exceptional communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills—capable of gaining technical respect from engineers while presenting clearly to business executives.
* High\-Agency Ownership: A bias for execution, a collaborative team\-first mindset, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.



 🌟 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Prior Software Delivery: 2\+ years of professional hands\-on software development or technical delivery experience prior to or during your MBA.
* Cross\-Functional Project Exposure: Experience managing or consulting on tech\-heavy projects, platform migrations, or data\-driven digital transformation initiatives.
* Technical Familiarity: Hands\-on comfort with SQL, exploring APIs, or utilizing lightweight scripting and workflow automations (JIRA APIs).



  





 🏆
 **What Success Looks Like** 




  





 A successful MBA\-lateral TPM at redBus acts as a strategic and operational anchor:
 



  




* Strategic Alignment: Minimizes the gap between "what the business wants" and "what engineering builds," resulting in highly predictable and commercially impactful releases.
* Data\-Driven Execution: Improves sprint delivery predictability to remain consistently within the 90%–100% band using analytical metrics.
* Risk \& Velocity Optimization: Proactively identifies and mitigates cross\-team dependencies and design bottlenecks before they block development.
* Process Leverage: Successfully designs and introduces automated mechanisms or workflows that significantly reduce manual tracking effort for engineering squads.



  





 At redBus, this TPM is expected to operate as a technical program leader, strategic business translator, AI enabler, and execution driver.

title: Mechanical Product Coordinator
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic, detail\-oriented
 
**Mechanical Product Coordinator** 

  to join our growing engineering team. This role is ideal for a B tech graduate or diploma holder in Mechanical Engineering with certified training in SolidWorks and CAD design tools who wants to build a strong career in mechanical design and product coordination.
 





 As a Mechanical Product Coordinator, you will work closely with senior engineers and project heads to translate design concepts into precise 3D models, track daily fabrication workflows, and learn end\-to\-end hardware development.
 



**Experience \& Eligibility** 
* Open to fresh graduates and candidates with a strong interest or demonstrated skills in mechanical design, solidworks, CAD modelling and product development .



  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* **CAD Modeling \& Drafting:** 

 Create and update 2D drafting files and 3D models for enclosures, parts, and assemblies using SolidWorks and CAD tools under senior guidance.
* **Project \& Workflow Tracking:** 

 Assist in tracking project milestones, maintaining daily task sheets, and ensuring smooth coordination between design and prototyping teams.
* **BOM \& Sourcing Support:** 

 Help prepare Bills of Materials (BOMs) and coordinate component sourcing with approved vendors and project heads.
* **Quality \& Prototype Inspection:** 

 Perform basic dimensional checks and physical verification of 3D\-printed or fabricated mechanical components against CAD designs.
* **Documentation \& Traceability:** 

 Organize technical files, assembly guides, and project documentation for clear team reference and product traceability.


**Qualifications \& Requirements** 
* **Education:** 

 Graduate Degree (B.E. / B.Tech) or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Preferred Skill :** 

 Certification or demonstrated proficiency in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or other standard CAD/design tools
* **Technical Aptitude:**
* Solid understanding of core mechanical design principles, 3D modeling, and 2D blueprint drafting.
* Familiarity with basic manufacturing concepts (e.g., sheet metal design, 3D printing, enclosure fittings).


**Performance Expectations** 


 The successful candidate will be expected to:
 



* Complete assemblies accurately and within assigned timelines.
* Minimise wiring, soldering, and mechanical assembly errors.
* Follow drawings, checklists, and engineering instructions consistently.
* Maintain proper documentation and product traceability.
* Report defects and design concerns before final assembly or dispatch.
* Maintain a safe, clean, and organised work environment.

title: Frontend Developer (React / Next.js)
description:
**Location:** 
 Noida / Bangalore (On\-site / Hybrid)
 **Experience:** 
 1 – 4 Years
 **Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹15,00,000 LPA (Based on experience and technical proficiency)
 **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About Us:** 
 We are an innovative, fast\-paced Fintech product company dedicated to building next\-generation financial solutions. Our platforms demand high performance, flawless user experiences, and rock\-solid security. We are looking for an ambitious and detail\-oriented Frontend Developer to help us build and scale user\-centric financial applications.
   

  

**The Role:** 
 As a Frontend Developer, you will take ownership of the user interface for our core web applications. You will work closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, and backend engineers to translate complex financial workflows into fast, responsive, and intuitive digital experiences using React and Next.js.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop, test, and maintain highly responsive, scalable, and secure web applications using React.js and Next.js.
* Translate Figma/UI designs into pixel\-perfect, accessible, and interactive frontend components.
* Optimize web applications for maximum speed, scalability, and SEO, ensuring seamless performance across diverse devices and browsers.
* Integrate frontend applications with robust backend RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
* Deploy, monitor, and manage frontend applications leveraging AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code, adhering to modern software engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, identify UI/UX bottlenecks, and proactively suggest technical improvements.


**Must\-Have Qualifications**
* 1 to 4 years of proven hands\-on experience in frontend development.
* Strong proficiency in React.js and Next.js, with a deep understanding of core principles (Server\-Side Rendering, Static Site Generation, React Hooks, Redux/Context API).
* Solid command of foundational web technologies: HTML5, CSS3, ES6\+ JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Practical experience deploying and managing frontend applications on AWS (e.g., S3, CloudFront, Amplify, EC2\).
* Experience consuming REST APIs and integrating third\-party services.
* Familiarity with modern frontend build pipelines, version control (Git), and CI/CD workflows.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Prior experience working in the Fintech domain or building secure, high\-traffic consumer applications.
* Understanding of Web WebSockets for real\-time data streaming (e.g., live financial dashboards).
* Experience with modern styling libraries (Tailwind CSS, Material\-UI, or Styled Components).
* Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, or React Testing Library).


**Why Join Us?**
* Opportunity to build high\-impact financial products from the ground up.
* Competitive compensation package (Up to ₹15 LPA).
* Collaborative, fast\-moving, and tech\-driven engineering culture.

They are a product\-focused developer building both native and cross\-platform features, improving their skills across Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript with guidance from senior engineers. Working within a global hospitality platform, they help deliver reliable user experiences at scale while leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, code quality, and development workflows.

title: Software Engineer II - Semiconductor Equipment
description:
Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high\-precision machine tools and surface processing systems, with a heritage spanning over 200 years. The company specialises in industrial lapping, polishing, fine grinding, and advanced abrasive technologies, serving more than 20 industries worldwide.
   

  

 With over 600 employees, 40,000\+ m² of production space, and revenues exceeding €250 million, Lapmaster Wolters is a trusted partner to global manufacturers. The company is now strategically expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging which is one of the industry’s fastest\-growing segments driven by demand for heterogeneous integration, chiplet architectures, and next\-generation compute platforms.
   

  

 Job Title: Software Engineer II
   

  

 Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Department: Software Engineering – Semiconductor Equipment
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Software Engineer I, you will be an integral part of our semiconductor equipment engineering team, responsible for designing, developing, and integrating software that drives high\-precision machine performance. You will work at the intersection of software and hardware, developing control interfaces, operator GUIs, and automated systems that meet the exacting standards of the semiconductor industry. This is an exciting opportunity to grow your career within a company that is actively shaping the future of advanced packaging technology.
   

  

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES but not limited to:
   

  

 Design, develop, test, and integrate software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
   

  

 Develop C\#/C\+\+ DLL interfaces enabling external customers to programmatically control equipment.
   

  

 Build intuitive operator interfaces for semiconductor equipment using C\# and C\+\+.
   

  

 Implement hardware control modules using serial communication interfaces and TCP/IP protocols.
   

  

 Develop and maintain automated system controls for semiconductor equipment operations.
   

  

 Conduct thorough system testing, debugging, and performance optimisation.
   

  

 Provide post\-deployment software support and debugging assistance to customers and field teams.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 Strong proficiency in Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
   

  

 Solid knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
   

  

 Hands\-on expertise in C\# and C\+\+ programming languages.
   

  

 Familiarity with PLC programming concepts and industrial automation.
   

  

 Excellent debugging and root\-cause analysis skills.
   

  

 Sound understanding of multithreading and concurrent programming concepts.
   

  

 Experience in GUI development using C\# .NET frameworks (WinForms and WPF).
   

  

 Strong software/hardware interface experience, particularly in embedded or industrial contexts.
   

  

 Good working knowledge of version control systems such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
   

  

 Good Knowledge about SEMI software standards like SECS/GEM, GEM300, cybersecurity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
   

  

 3\-6 years of professional experience in C\# / .NET software development.
   

  

 Prior exposure to complex system development in regulated or high\-precision domains such as semiconductor, healthcare, or aerospace is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, debug, and optimise complex software systems.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Competitive compensation package aligned with industry benchmarks.
   

  

 A dynamic, collaborative, and innovation\-driven work environment.
   

  

 Exposure to cutting\-edge semiconductor equipment and advanced packaging technologies.
   

  

 Opportunities for professional growth within a globally recognised engineering organisation.
   

  

 A culture that values precision, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
   

  

 Lapmaster Wolters is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business requirements.
   

  

 Ready to engineer the future of semiconductor technology?
   

  

 Apply today and discover why Lapmaster Wolters is a great place to build your career

 As an Intern (Bachelor's) \- HR here at Honeywell, you will gain hands\-on experience in various HR functions, including recruitment, employee relations, and HR administration. This internship will provide you with the opportunity to learn from experienced HR professionals and contribute to meaningful projects that support our business objectives.
   

  

 In this role, you will impact the organization by supporting HR initiatives, assisting with employee engagement activities, and helping to streamline HR processes. You will also have the chance to develop your skills in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment, preparing you for a successful career in HR.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support talent acquisition efforts: Posting job openings and scheduling interviews
* Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding processes: Ensuring a smooth transition for new hires and departing employees
* Contribute to employee relations activities: Including conflict resolution and performance improvement plans
* Assist with the development and implementation of HR policies and proceduresSupport employee development initiatives: Including training programs and performance evaluations


**Qualifications**
 YOU MUST HAVE
   

  

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong interest in HR and a desire to learn and grow in the field.


 WE VALUE
   

  

* Previous internship or work experience in HR or a related field.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
HR Intern
   

  

 Internship \| HR \& People Operations \| Unpaid \| Ownership Role
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated HR Intern who wants hands\-on experience in building and managing HR functions from the ground up.
   

  

 This is an ownership\-driven role where you will work directly with the Founder and play an active role in setting up HR processes, employee systems, policies, talent acquisition practices, and workplace culture.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to understand how HR functions are built in an early\-stage organisation and take ownership of projects rather than simply assisting with routine administrative tasks.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Employee Onboarding \& HR Operations
   

  

 \- Manage day\-to\-day employee onboarding activities.
   

 \- Prepare and coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, salary revision/hike letters, experience letters, and other HR documentation.
   

 \- Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
   

 \- Help establish structured HR processes and systems.
   

  

 2\. HR Policies \& Compliance
   

  

 \- Work closely with the Company Secretary (CS) team in setting up organisational policies and HR\-related compliance processes.
   

 \- Assist in developing and documenting HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.
   

 \- Help establish basic HR frameworks suitable for a growing organisation.
   

  

 3\. Talent Acquisition
   

  

 \- Coordinate the end\-to\-end recruitment process.
   

 \- Screen applications and shortlist suitable candidates.
   

 \- Conduct the initial screening/interview round for selected candidates.
   

 \- Coordinate interviews with the Founder and relevant teams.
   

 \- Maintain candidate pipelines and recruitment records.
   

  

 4\. Talent \& People Management
   

  

 \- Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.
   

 \- Help establish systems for employee performance, feedback, development, and growth.
   

 \- Assist in identifying employee needs and improving the overall employee experience.
   

  

 5\. Employee Engagement \& Culture
   

  

 \- Develop and execute employee engagement and cultural activities.
   

 \- Introduce initiatives that encourage collaboration, recognition, learning, and team bonding.
   

 \- Contribute to building a positive and mission\-driven organisational culture.
   

  

 6\. Founder’s Office / HR Projects
   

  

 \- Work directly with the Founder on building the HR function from the ground up.
   

 \- Identify gaps in existing HR processes and propose practical solutions.
   

 \- Take ownership of HR projects and implement systems rather than only providing administrative support.
   

 \- Get exposure to decision\-making, organisational structuring, and people strategy.
   

  

 Who Can Apply?
   

  

 We welcome applications from:
   

  

 \- B.Com / BBM / BBA / MBA / PGDM candidates
   

 \- Students or graduates with an HR specialisation
   

 \- Candidates from other academic backgrounds who are genuinely interested in building a career in Human Resources
   

 \- Freshers and candidates looking for practical HR experience are welcome to apply.
   

  

 What You Will Gain
   

  

 \- Hands\-on experience across HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Employee Engagement and People Management
   

 \- Exposure to HR policies and organisational compliance
   

 \- Experience working directly with a Founder
   

 \- Opportunity to build HR systems and processes from the ground up
   

 \- Practical experience conducting candidate screening interviews
   

 \- Exposure to the intersection of HR, compliance, organisational strategy and people management
   

 \- Significant ownership and decision\-making exposure
   

  

 Important
   

  

 This is an unpaid internship opportunity with an early\-stage, non\-funded organisation.
   

  

 The role is best suited for someone who is looking for hands\-on ownership, meaningful experience, and the opportunity to build HR systems from the ground up, rather than a conventional internship with limited responsibilities.
   

  

 If you are proactive, comfortable taking ownership, and genuinely interested in building a career in HR, we would love to hear from you.

**Human Resources \- Trainee** 




 As a Human Resources \- Trainee, you will be responsible for supporting various HR functions, including Talent Acquisition, Payroll \& HR Operations, and HR Analytics \& Reporting. This role is designed to provide hands\-on experience across key HR domains, enabling you to develop a comprehensive understanding of human resource management while contributing to business and people objectives. You will work closely with HR teams and stakeholders to ensure efficient hiring, employee lifecycle management, data accuracy, process compliance, and workforce analytics.
 



  





**Your job:** 



* Support and coordinate end\-to\-end HR processes across Talent Acquisition, Payroll, HR Operations, and HR Analytics functions
* Assist in sourcing, screening, scheduling interviews, and maintaining recruitment pipelines to support hiring requirements
* Coordinate onboarding activities, employee documentation, and HR records management to ensure a smooth employee lifecycle experience
* Support payroll processing activities by validating employee data, attendance, leave records, and other payroll inputs
* Maintain employee information in HR systems and ensure data accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality

**Your qualification:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; knowledge of HRMS platforms and reporting tools is an added advantage
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills with a keen attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
* Self\-driven, adaptable, and eager to learn, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment

title: Enterprise Talent (Apprentice)
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 We are currently seeking fresh Graduates to join the Talent Acquisition team as Apprentice for duration of 12 months.
   

  

 This role forms part of the Talent Acquisition team and will have responsibility for driving excellence in the Sourcing function. The role will work closely with the HR and business leaders across the organisation and be an advocate/champion for Talent Acquisition.
   

  

**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Delivery of Sourcing ‘assignments’ which could include supporting Executive Search, talent mapping/pooling, succession planning or open roles
* Proactively sourcing, screening and talent pooling for candidates through various channels including internal databases, LinkedIn and other external job boards and open web searching
* Develop and execute against Sourcing plans for specific assignments
* Contribute to the ongoing evolvement of HSBC’s proactive Sourcing capability and effectiveness
* Draft offer letters, manage onboarding activities and support the recruiters with the operational aspects of hiring
* Initiate and monitor the progress of pre employment vetting process by coordinating with the relevant stakeholders
* Staying connected with and tracking market trends, competitor analysis and regional changes that are relevant to our business stakeholders
* Designing and implementing bespoke recruitment campaigns for key recruitment drives
* Working in partnership with Resourcing Specialists and working closely with hiring managers from the outset – from market research, job briefs through to interviews and offer management
* Ensure that the Employer Value Proposition for your assignments is defined and will have impact
* Ensure the metrics set against deliverables is met
* Provide input to the Talent Acquisition Leadership Team on key components of the function
* Ensure HSBC fully leverages its HR tools, resources and tactics to engage talent


**Qualifications \- External**
* Graduation / Post\-Graduation (Bachelor’s degree holder of an University Grants Commission (UGC) recognised University and must possess mark sheets and provisional / Degree certificate of passing)
* Only Fresh Graduates within 0\-5 years of completing their Bachelor’s degree can apply
* Candidate should not have done any Govt. regulated Apprenticeship in past
* Basic knowledge of full cycle recruiting and Sourcing
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and facilitation skills
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and critical thinking
* Professional and strong presentation skills to senior level stakeholders
* Culturally diverse and aware and able to work with people of different backgrounds and languages


 Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.
   

  

**Additional Information**
* The tenure of the Apprentice will be 1 (one) year as defined under Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 amended from time to time.
* All Apprentices engaged by the Bank will also be featured in National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal as an ‘Apprentice’. By virtue of them being covered under the provisions of the Act, a candidate profile will be created for each apprentice in the NATS portal, which will be available to them for viewing.
* On completion of the one\-year Apprenticeship tenure, a Certificate of Proficiency will be issued to the apprentice by the Govt. of India, as applicable under the Act and the enrolment under the Apprenticeship Act will cease.
* All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will stand as mentioned in the offer letter issued by the Bank at the time of joining.


 You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Associate - Onboarding
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $4\.3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Job Title: Junior Associate or HR Associate, Employee Onboarding – HR Shared Services
   

  

 Shift Timings: 5:00 PM – 02:00 AM IST Mon \- Fri. Willingness to work from office and stretch when business requires.
   

  

**Role Brief**
 As an Onboarding Associate, you will be playing a very crucial role in ensuring the smooth and efficient Onboarding of the candidates. You will be responsible for coordinating with various partner teams, recruiters, stakeholders \& Candidates to ensure efficient, compliant, timely onboarding of candidates and focus on providing exceptional candidate experience. The role requires excellent communication skills with the ability to make quick decisions and should take complete ownership in getting the candidates prepped for the journey with Clean Harbors primarily supporting US \& Canada regions.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This is an Onboarding Associate role, where you will primarily be supporting the Driver \& Non\-Driver Candidates in US \& Canada.
   

  

 Coordinate with the Recruitment team on New Drivers to be Onboarded o Gather and process/follow up on all necessary paperwork’s, backgrounds, medicals for the Driver candidates
   

  

 Work closely with the candidates to ensure they have a smooth onboarding process right from their first day \& partner along for their first week tasks o Coordinate with the Hiring Managers to ensure onboardings are complete in a timely manner \& work on any issues to be resolved very closely
   

  

 Distribute login credentials, manuals, guidelines as required.
   

  

 Ensure new hires have technical assistance to properly set up their hardware and software.
   

  

 Assign and assist the New Hires on the mandatory training and policies that may need to be completed upon onboarding.
   

  

 Address any additional queries that the New Hires may have till they are handed over to the Hiring Managers
   

  

 Monitoring onboarding systems to ensure that all necessary onboarding tasks are completed in a timely manner
   

  

 Achieve high level of business partner satisfaction in the onboarding routines.
   

  

 Ensure that the Candidates are on track with the day\-today work assigned in the first week and work closely for any support until resolved.
   

  

 To collaborate and multitask on calls/emails/chat with candidates and Hiring Managers on any queries or escalations arsing as part of Onboarding.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Skill/Expectations:
   

  

 Have an excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong proficiency in English.
   

  

 Have Good logical thinking which we can correlate to problem solving ability.
   

  

 Are high on Ownership and trust, ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
   

  

 Have Basic knowledge of US labor legislation and Onboarding tasks handled.
   

  

 Have the flair to connect with people whom you collaborate (can correlate to college projects collaborations).
   

  

 Have ability to work cross\-functionally in a high\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

 Have ability to follow through on tasks until completed and adhere to deadlines with high attention to detail.
   

  

 Have Exceptional customer relationship\-building and multi\-tasking skills.
   

  

 Are Self\-managed with little supervision. o Are Highly self\-motivated and highly organized with strong attention to detail.

 Origin Medical Research Lab is the research arm of Origin Medical. Here, we strive to bring together the best and brightest minds at the intersection of AI and healthcare to fulfill Origin Medical’s mission. 
 



  





 By combining the knowledge of healthcare and AI, it is on a journey to build state\-of\-the\-art solutions aimed at supporting a broad spectrum of healthcare providers in rural and urban communities, allowing them to practice at the top of their licenses. With AI in the imaging workflow, clinicians can more confidently deliver timely interventions, enhance pregnancy outcomes, identify high\-risk pregnancies to reduce maternal mortality, and significantly lower infant mortality rates.
 



  





 Origin Medical, headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA, is driven by a mission to advance maternal health equity by improving access to quality prenatal care with artificial intelligence.
 



  





**About the People \& Culture Lead  role** 





 As a People \& Culture lead you will be working to head, manage and scale our People function as we continue to grow. Reporting directly to leadership, you will drive both strategic and operational HR initiatives, including talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, and organizational development.
 




  






 You will build scalable HR processes, policies, and systems while fostering a high\-performance, people\-first culture. As a trusted partner to managers and leadership, you will help shape the employee experience, support business growth, and ensure OMRL continues to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent.
 




  





**W** 
**hat will you do?** 




**People Strategy:** 



* Develop and execute an effective people strategy aligned with OMRL's business objectives, growth trajectory, and across the employee lifecycle.
* Partner with leadership on workforce planning, organizational design, HR initiatives, and headcount forecasting.
* Build scalable HR policies, frameworks, and processes that grow with the organization.



**Talent Acquisition:** 



* Lead high\-quality, diverse, end\-to\-end recruitment.
* Establish and grow campus hiring and early\-career talent pipelines.
* Manage hiring pipeline across all levels of the organization, including senior and executive hiring, across research, engineering, clinical, and business functions.
* Track hiring metrics and recruitment analytics to continuously improve outcomes.



**People Operations:** 



* Identify, implement, and own process optimization across HR operations, policies, and documentation \- to help manage the employee lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and internal governance standards.
* Manage and optimize the HRIS platform (Zoho People) as the system of record, attendance, and leave management for people data.



**Learning \& Development:** 



* Conduct training needs analyses to identify skill and capability gaps.
* Design learning programs and development initiatives that build technical, functional, and leadership capability.
* Support employees and managers in identifying career pathways and delivering effective performance coaching.
* Cultivate a culture of continuous learning and intellectual curiosity.



**Performance Management** 

 : 
 



* Manage the performance review cycle, from goal\-setting to the end of review: ensuring consistency, fairness, and clarity.
* Build feedback systems that support ongoing, two\-way performance conversations.
* Support succession planning for critical roles across the organization.
* Foster a high\-performance culture grounded in accountability and growth.



**Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* Conduct compensation benchmarking to ensure OMRL remains competitive in the market.
* Develop performance\-linked reward and recognition programs that motivate and retain top talent.
* Administer and evaluate employee benefits programs and wellness initiatives for enhancement.
* Lead annual salary review processes in partnership with leadership.



**Employee Engagement \& Culture:** 



* Design and lead employee engagement initiatives that strengthen connection, inclusion, and belonging to OMRL's mission.
* Organize culture\- and team\-building initiatives that strengthen cross\-functional relationships.
* Run recognition programs that celebrate impact and effort.
* Own internal communications that keep employees informed, aligned, and engaged.

title: People & Culture Director
description:
SmartBear delivers application integrity for modern tech stacks, ensuring continuous, measurable assurance that software just works as intended with governance to operate at AI speed and scale. SmartBear offers deep test automation, API lifecycle management, and observability capabilities. With integrations across the SDLC, it sets a new quality standard for application delivery teams.
   

  

 SmartBear is trusted by developers, testers, and software engineers across 32,000 organizations, including 75% of the largest financial institutions and industry leaders such as Adobe, JetBlue, and Microsoft. SmartBear’s open source tools are downloaded more than 100 million times a month and have earned over 30,000 GitHub stars from the developer community. With its best\-loved brands, including Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology\-driven world a better place. Learn more at
 
 www.smartbear.com
 
 , or follow us on
 
 LinkedIn
 
 ,
 
 X
 
 , and
 
 Reddit
 
 . 
   

  

 At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI\-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**People \& Culture Director** 




 This is a pivotal role for SmartBear's India operations, combining hands\-on HRBP partnership with company\-wide accountability for statutory compliance. As HRBP to your assigned function, you'll partner with senior business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with business priorities, coach leaders on talent, performance, and organizational effectiveness, and drive strategic people initiatives that build high\-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams. You'll also serve as India's statutory compliance expert, owning alignment with Indian labor law across all India\-based SmartBear employees including those outside your HRBP client group, regardless of function or reporting line, in partnership with our Director of Global People Operations. 
 



**About the Role:** 



* Partner with business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with organizational goals and translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
* Coach and advise managers on performance management, employee development, organizational design, compensation, and employee relations.
* Analyze employee engagement survey results and develop action plans with leaders.
* Develop and implement talent retention strategies that enhance employee experience.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, influencing leaders through data, business insight, and People \& Culture expertise.
* Collaborate across the People \& Culture organization to deliver consistent, scalable, and impactful people programs.
* Partner with global People \& Culture teams to adapt enterprise\-wide programs to local legal and cultural context.
* The successful candidate will work from our Ahmedabad, India office in hybrid model.



**India Statutory Compliance (all India employees):** 



* Own compliance with Indian labor law — including the Industrial Relations Code, Shops \& Establishments Act, and related regulations — for every India\-based employee, regardless of which function or HRBP they are otherwise supported by, serving as SmartBear's go\-to expert on India employment regulation.
* Partner with the Director of Global People Operations, Legal, and other HRBPs to maintain visibility into employment actions (hiring, compensation changes, terminations) across functions, so compliance risk is caught even outside your direct client group.
* Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for India regulatory questions raised by other HRBPs or business leaders.



**We are looking for you if you have:** 



* 8\+ years of experience in a senior People Partner or HR Business Partner role, ideally within a high\-growth technology environment.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to develop and implement strategic People \& Culture initiatives.
* Strong expertise in performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience analyzing employee engagement data and translating insights into measurable action plans.
* Excellent communication, coaching, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* A passion for building inclusive, high\-performing teams and creating exceptional employee experiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements is required, given this role's company\-wide compliance ownership.
* Experience working as part of a global, distributed People \& Culture team is a plus.
* A background in people operations — including HR systems, processes, and policy administration — is a plus.



**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:** 
  
 


* You can grow your career at every level.
* We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.
* We love celebrating our SmartBears; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.
* We are guided by a People and Culture organization \- an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically – the whole person.
* We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.



**Did you know?** 



* Our main goal at SmartBear is to make our technology\-driven world a better place.
* SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.
* SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway Ireland, Bath, UK, Wroclaw, Poland and Bangalore, India.
* We’ve won major industry (product and company) awards including B2B Innovators Award, Content Marketing Association, IntellyX Digital Innovator and BuiltIn Best Places to Work.



*SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.*

 Octave, delivers market\-leading enterprise software that helps industrial customers design, build, operate, and safeguard mission\-critical assets.  We are seeking a Director of HR Business Partnership who will serve as a key member of Octave’s global HR leadership team. This transformational leader will shape and execute the people strategy for one of our most critical regions, partnering across geographies and functions to build the organizational capability required to scale a global SaaS business.
   

  

 Beyond expertise, we are looking for a leader who is hands on and leads from the front, is approachable, fair, trustworthy, and builds strong, enduring relationships with stakeholders anchored on leading practice execution. The ideal candidate understands the dynamics of a SaaS and industrial\-tech environment and thrives in a high\-growth, matrixed global organization.

description:
**About Birla Pivot**
 In a short span of 2\.5 years since inception, Birla Pivot has evolved into a comprehensive B2B e\-commerce platform offering integrated procurement and financial solutions that help businesses become efficient and grow. We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000\+SKUs from 300\+ brands across Building Material, Chemicals \& Metals. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. With a robust network of suppliers and transporters, we have delivered to 4,000\+ pin codes across 375 cities. Our customer base now spans top\-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem. The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under 2%, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital\-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.
   

  

 Business Partnering \&Stakeholder Management
   

  

* You serve as the strategic HR partner for Sales, Retail, Category and other Revenue teams across West \& South, aligning regional people strategy with business objectives for a workforce of 100\+employees.
* You proactively identify organizational gaps across locations, conduct structured business reviews with regional leadership, and drive people interventions with measurable outcomes.


 Talent Acquisition, EB \& Onboarding \- COE
   

  

* You lead COE talent acquisition at Birla Pivot to improve efficiency in TA, partnering with business leaders to build quality talent pipelines and drive faster, more effective hiring outcomes.
* You drive employer branding initiatives that position Birla Pivot as an employer of choice, strengthening visibility and attracting quality talent.
* You design and own the onboarding journey for new hires as COE, ensuring structured induction, faster time\-to\-productivity, and seamless integration into the Birla Pivot way of working.


 Driving Performance Management\& Career Development
   

  

* You drive the full performance review cycle for your cohort — from goal\-setting and mid\-year check\-ins to final appraisals — ensuring calibration, fairness, and actionable feedback.
* You identify high\-potential employees, build individual development plans, and coach regional managers on performance conversations, improvement plans, and recognition frameworks.


 Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
   

  

* You own hiring for new and replacement roles across your business units — sourcing, screening, and closing quality talent on time.
* You partner with leaders on workforce planning — forecasting headcount, mapping critical roles, and building talent pipelines ahead of demand.
* You will be responsible for campus programs and hiring and developing young talent for your cohort.


 HR Operations \& Compliance
   

  

* You ensure smooth execution of all HR processes — confirmations, transfers, separations, and policy adherence across South locations, managing grievance redressal and disciplinary matters with empathy and legal compliance.
* You maintain accurate people data for the 100\+ employee regional workforce and leverage HR analytics to surface insights that support business decisions.


 Learning \& Change Management
   

  

* You identify skill gaps across South teams in partnership with business leaders and co\-create targeted L\&D interventions, including manager assimilation programs and leadership pipeline development.
* You support change management efforts during periods of regional expansion, restructuring, or strategic pivots across South.

description:
**Job Summary**
 Use analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes. Responsible for analyzing performance, identifying problems, and developing recommendations to improve the organization's Supply Chain.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Participate in six sigma and supply chain improvement projects Use existing business systems to provide analytics and reporting that are capable and repeatable.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Optimizes work processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
   

  

 Materials Planning System Utilization \- Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long\-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day\-to\-day operations.
   

  

 Plan for Every Part (PFEP) \- Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
   

  

 Analysis and Troubleshooting \- Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.
   

  

 Inventory Management and Optimization \- Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end\-to\-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.
   

  

 Material Planning \- Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.
   

  

 Materials KPI Management \- Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end\-customer impact; strategically balances trade\-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Business Analyst \- UPI
   

  

 Department: Information Technology
   

  

 Location: Navi Mumbai – Airoli
   

  

 Job Summary \- The UPI/IMPS Business Analyst will be responsible for end‑to‑end analysis, design, and delivery support for retail payments solutions (UPI, IMPS) across banking channels and switches. The role involves working closely with business, NPCI, operations, technology, and external vendors to translate regulatory and scheme changes into robust, scalable payment application features.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Gather, analyse, and document business requirements for UPI/IMPS and related payment products across mobile, internet, branch, and API channels.
* Review user stories, and use cases capturing end‑to‑end flows: payer/payee journey, switching, NPCI messages, reconciliation, chargeback, and dispute processes.
* Map and optimize current vs. target processes (AS‑IS/TO‑BE), including exception handling, timeouts, and reversals for UPI/IMPS transactions.
* Work with solution and enterprise architects to align designs with core banking, CBS, reconciliation, and Risk and other interfaces.
* Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for UPI and IMPS, covering PSP/TPAP models, handle/VPA, collect/pay, mandate flows, and NPCI procedural circulars.
* Interpret NPCI specs, circulars, and regulatory guidelines, and convert them into clear business and system impacts (new message fields, limits, risk rules, compliance timelines).
* Understand and explain ISO 8583/ISO 20022 message structures for UPI/IMPS, including field usage and mapping to internal data models.
* Work with product owners, operations, risk, compliance, and technology teams to prioritise backlog and define MVP scope for UPI/IMPS initiatives.
* Liaise with NPCI, Payment switches, gateways, and third‑party vendors for clarifications, change requests, RFP/RFI evaluations, and solution walkthroughs.
* Conduct requirement workshops, demos, and walkthroughs for internal stakeholders, senior management, and steering committees.
* Define functional acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and edge cases for UPI/IMPS flows (success, failure, timeouts, recon transactions, refunds, retries).
* Support SIT/UAT by clarifying business rules, validating defects, and sign‑off on fixes; ensure regression coverage for core payment flows and downstream systems (recon, GL, reporting).
* Validate performance and resilience requirements (TPS, timeouts, switch failover, duplicate detection, idempotency).
* Create user guides, SOPs, and training materials for operations, contact centre, and branch/business users.
* Support cutover planning, production validation, and hyper‑care post go‑live, including monitoring key KPIs (success rates, declines, dispute volumes).
* Contribute to continuous improvement by analysing incident trends, customer feedback, and scheme changes, and proposing product/process enhancements.
* Hands‑on experience with payment switch / gateway / CBS integration for real‑time payments.
* Proven track record of at least 2–3 end‑to‑end implementations or major change releases in UPI/IMPS (e.g., UPI 2\.0 features, AutoPay, mandate, TPAP onboarding etc., )
* Exposure to agile delivery, working as BA or proxy product owner for payments features.
* Strong understanding of UPI \& IMPS transaction flows: payer/payee journeys, PSP/TPAP roles, NPCI switch behaviour, timeouts, declines, and chargebacks.
* Working knowledge of message formats and APIs:
* ISO 8583, ISO 20022 concepts, REST/JSON APIs, and NPCI message specifications.
* Required DB Querying for data analysis, reconciliation checks, and defect triage.
* Understanding \& hands\-on experience on Linux commandts, Weblogic deployment.
* Use of Postman tools, Oracle Sql developer etc.
* Understanding \& hands\-on experience on Deployments vai tools.
* Understanding on NPCI UPI/IMPS CZ tool with certification testing.


 Education Qualification: Graduation: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) / Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) Post\-Graduation: Master of Science (M.Sc) /Master of Technology (M.Tech) / Master of Computer Applications (MCA)

* Build, maintain, and improve ingestion pipelines, notebooks, and data assets on Azure and Databricks using Delta Lake and PySpark, supporting reliable data delivery across the platform.
* Develop and optimize SQL and Python solutions that improve pipeline performance, data quality, and platform stability.
* Partner with architects, leads, product owners, and engineering peers to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver practical data solutions.
* Provide specialist platform support to the operations team by diagnosing pipeline and platform issues, sharing deep technical knowledge, and guiding effective resolutions.
* Contribute to Power BI reporting and analytics enablement, turning curated platform data into useful insights for stakeholders.
* Use CI/CD practices in Azure DevOps to test, deploy, and maintain platform changes safely and efficiently.
* Help evaluate and apply new platform capabilities in partnership with internal architects and external specialists, turning emerging features into reliable engineering patterns for the team.
* Apply AI\-assisted tools daily for research, design, coding, testing, and documentation, using them to move faster while maintaining engineering quality.

* You are confident and effective working across the EDP platform stack and team ways of working.
* You are a trusted specialist partner to the operations team, helping them resolve platform and pipeline challenges with clear technical guidance.
* You are delivering ingestion pipelines, notebooks, and analytics\-ready outputs that meet team and stakeholder needs.
* You are contributing to platform optimization and evolution, including practical use of newer platform capabilities and patterns shaped with architects and external partners.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-have**
* Strong fundamentals in SQL, coding, and problem\-solving, with the ability to break down technical challenges and learn new tools quickly.
* Hands\-on experience building or supporting data pipelines or data platform components in cloud or distributed data environments.
* Comfort working with cloud data engineering tools, including experience with or willingness to work deeply in Azure, Databricks, Delta Lake, and PySpark.
* Experience with collaborative software development — version control, code review, and working effectively in cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Clear communication skills and a proactive mindset, with confidence collaborating across time zones and using AI\-assisted development tools as part of your daily workflow.

title: Data Scientist, Fraud Risk Mitigation
description:
**Role Summary** 




 Data Scientist supporting fraud strategy development, fraud analytics, and operational monitoring across a consumer lending portfolio. Working under the fraud strategy lead and alongside senior team members, you will analyze fraud trends, monitor portfolio and decisioning performance, and help translate findings into policy and rule recommendations for the decision engine.
 



 This is an individual\-contributor role for someone with strong analytical fundamentals and hands\-on SQL and Python skills who wants to build depth in fraud risk. Day\-to\-day work is weighted toward analysis, recurring reporting, monitoring, and cross\-functional execution with fraud operations, product, credit/risk, and data engineering — including scorecard and model performance monitoring.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Analyze fraud trends and emerging patterns across application, behavioral, device, and third party data, and summarize findings with clear supporting evidence.
 



 • Monitor fraud performance metrics and operational outcomes — loss rates, capture rates, false positive rates, approval impact, vintage trends, and segment\-level KPIs — and flag issues for review.
 



 • Support policy, rule, and threshold recommendations for the decision engine, sizing expected impact and recommending changes with guidance from the fraud strategy lead and senior team members.
 



 • Prepare recurring fraud reports and deep dives — loss attribution, typology trends, and decisioning outcomes — with commentary on drivers of change.
 



 • Track fraud scorecard and model performance (PSI, score drift, KS, decay) and monitor reason code and segment\-level behavior, escalating signs of degradation.
 



 • Evaluate third\-party fraud and identity signals (identity verification, device intelligence, consortium data, bank/transaction data) and contribute benchmarking analysis to onboarding, retirement, and reweighting decisions.
 




 •
 
 Support test\-and\-learn analyses — champion/challenger tests, policy backtests, and holdouts — including data preparation, measurement, and result summaries.
 



 • Partner with fraud operations on case and queue feedback, translating investigator findings into analytical follow\-ups, rule ideas, and reporting improvements.
 



 • Work with product, data engineering, and decisioning platform teams to implement and monitor fraud rules and data signals, validating logic and post\-deployment results.
 



 • Run data quality checks on fraud reporting and analysis datasets, documenting assumptions, exclusions, and known limitations.
 



 • Document analyses, methodology, and recommendations so that findings are reproducible and easy for partners to review.
 




 •
 
 Contribute ideas and observations to the broader fraud strategy agenda and follow shared analytical, code review, and reporting standards.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • 1–3 years of experience in fraud analytics, risk analytics, data science, credit risk, fintech or financial services analytics, or a closely related quantitative field.
 



 • Strong hands\-on SQL and Python skills used for real analysis, segmentation, and reporting.
 



 • Experience working with large structured/tabular datasets, including cleaning, joining, and quality validation.
 



 • Experience building or maintaining dashboards and recurring reporting for business partners
 



 • Understanding of fraud typologies in consumer lending — identity, synthetic, first\-party, and third\-party fraud — or clear curiosity and willingness to learn them.
 



 • Working familiarity with how scores, rules, and thresholds drive decisions, with the ability to interpret outputs and monitor performance.
 



 • Ability to work effectively with guidance — taking direction on scope and method, asking good questions, and delivering carefully checked work.
 



 • Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain analyses, results, and caveats to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related), or equivalent practical experience.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Consumer lending, fintech, or financial services experience, particularly subprime or near\-prime personal loans.
 



 • Experience partnering with fraud operations or investigations teams on case and queue outcomes.
 



 • Exposure to third\-party fraud and identity data providers and to benchmarking their signals.
 



 • Familiarity with decision engines or rules platforms and how fraud rules are configured, deployed, and monitored.
 



 • Experience with experimentation and measurement (champion/challenger, A/B tests, backtests, holdouts).
 



 • Exposure to scorecard or model performance monitoring (PSI, KS, calibration, reason\-code analysis).
 



 • Exposure to identity, synthetic, first\-party, or third\-party fraud patterns in application and account data.
 



 • Familiarity with US consumer lending regulations and risk management practices.

title: Software Engineer - AI Accelerated Development
description:
**About Signant Health** 




  





 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



  





 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




  





 Signant Health is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Accelerated Development to build AI\-powered, agentic features into our clinical trial platforms. Working across the .NET stack, you will take AI capabilities from backend LLM integration through to a usable front\-end — designing agents and agentic workflows, not just prompting a model. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who works with agentic tooling every day and wants to ship production AI in a regulated, high\-impact environment. We weigh the depth of your AI and agentic build experience more heavily than years of general experience: a developer with one to three years of substantive, hands\-on agentic work is exactly the profile we are targeting.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function** 




  




* 1\-5 Years of experience in AI, .NET and Fullstack.
* Design and build AI agents and agentic workflows — tool\-use/function calling, multi\-step task orchestration, and agent loops — that power Signant Health's clinical trial platforms.
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI) into .NET application code, handling authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Deliver AI features end\-to\-end, taking them from backend integration through to a usable, production\-ready front\-end.
* Build custom agents and tools with the Claude Agent SDK, wiring and steering agent loops.
* Author custom skills and slash commands for Claude Code to codify team\-specific workflows.
* Implement RAG pipelines and integrate vector stores (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone) to ground agent outputs in trusted data.
* Instrument agents for evaluation and observability so their outputs can be verified, measured, and audited.
* Apply AI\-specific risk controls appropriate to a regulated clinical environment, addressing hallucination, determinism, and auditability of agent decisions.
* Use Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) daily as a primary development tool, reviewing and steering AI\-generated diffs.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




  





**Essential:** 



* Full\-stack .NET development — C\#/ASP.NET Core on the backend paired with a modern front\-end framework.
* Hands\-on agentic development experience — building AI agents or agentic workflows (tool\-use/function calling, multi\-step task orchestration, agent loops); not just prompting an LLM, but building systems around one.
* Practical LLM API integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI), including authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Proven full\-stack delivery of AI features — able to take an agentic/AI feature from backend integration through to a usable front\-end, not just a notebook prototype.
* Daily, hands\-on use of Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) as a primary development tool — comfortable working through multi\-step agentic sessions and reviewing and steering AI\-generated diffs, rather than occasional autocomplete\-style use.
* Prompt engineering — designing and iterating on system prompts as production software contracts, not one\-off experiments.
* Python proficiency as the preferred language for AI/agent tooling; comfort with async patterns a plus.
* Evaluation and observability literacy — able to reason about whether an agent's output is correct and instrument it to prove so.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Claude Agent SDK experience — building custom agents, defining tools, and wiring agent loops.
* Working knowledge of agent primitives: hooks (deterministic pre/post\-tool\-call controls), skills (progressive\-disclosure, load\-on\-demand instructions), subagents/multi\-agent delegation, and session/state management.
* Experience authoring custom skills or slash commands for Claude Code to codify team\-specific workflows.
* Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting agents to internal tools and data sources.
* Working knowledge of RAG patterns and vector store integration (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone).
* Awareness of AI\-specific risk areas relevant to a regulated environment (OWASP LLM Top 10, hallucination/determinism concerns, and auditability of agent decisions).



  





**Why Signant Health?** 




 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world.  SKEYEBOTS \| Bangalore, India \| Full\-Time
 



  





**About SKEYEBOTS** 




 SKEYEBOTS builds AI\-driven autonomous systems for unmanned platforms operating across aerial, ground, and maritime environments — systems where reliability is mission\-critical, and failure is not an option. We are a well\-funded, rapidly scaling deep\-tech organisation building some of the most demanding autonomous technology being developed in India today.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is a multi\-domain role for an engineer who wants to learn fast, contribute across the stack, and grow into a specialist. You will work across software development, hardware integration, field operations, and system testing — getting hands\-on exposure to computer vision, perception, motion planning, embedded systems, and autonomous platform deployment in a single role.
 



 If you are sharp, eager, and want your work to matter from day one, this is where you start.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 



* Software feature development across computer vision, perception pipelines, and motion planning modules
* Sensor fusion across camera, LiDAR, IMU, and GNSS for perception and state estimation
* Localization and mapping support using SLAM or visual\-inertial odometry stacks
* Obstacle detection and avoidance feeding into the planning layer
* Sensor and camera calibration to keep perception accurate in the field
* Data collection, annotation, and model training pipelines for real\-world autonomous systems
* Integration testing and end\-to\-end system validation on physical autonomous platforms
* Drone field operations — including pre\-flight checks, mission execution, and post\-flight analysis (DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate sponsored if not already held)
* Ground control station operation and mission planning using QGroundControl or equivalent
* GUI development and tooling using Qt/QML (training provided if needed)
* Hardware\-software integration support alongside the hardware engineering team
* Simulation\-based testing in Gazebo or equivalent SITL environments



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Required** 



* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related discipline where both software and hardware are covered
* 0–2 years of professional or project\-level experience in robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software
* Working knowledge of Python; basic familiarity with C\+\+ is a plus
* Understanding of fundamental robotics and computer vision concepts
* Basic ROS or ROS2 exposure — coursework, personal projects, or internships count
* Linux and Git proficiency
* Hands\-on project work demonstrating real hardware or software build experience — not just theory



  





**Preferred** 



* Exposure to computer vision libraries: OpenCV, PyTorch, or TensorFlow
* Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 nodes, topics, and basic navigation stacks
* Qt/QML experience for GUI or HMI development
* DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (we will sponsor this if not held)
* Experience with simulation environments: Gazebo, AirSim, or equivalent
* Basic understanding of flight controllers: PX4, ArduPilot, or MAVLink
* Hands\-on experience with embedded platforms: Arduino, Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson, or similar



  





**What You'll Get** 



* Direct exposure to a full autonomous systems stack — hardware, firmware, CV, planning, and integration — in a single role
* Mentorship from experienced engineers and industry experts across India and internationally
* Field experience operating and testing real autonomous platforms
* A fast track to specialisation in your strongest area as the team grows
* The opportunity to contribute to autonomous systems operating in environments where the stakes are real



  





**Location** 




 Bangalore, Karnataka — full\-time, onsite. Travel to Kochi and field test sites as required.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your CV and a brief note — a robotics, embedded, or software project you have built, what you were trying to solve, and what you learned when it did not work — to
 **LinkedIn Easy Apply** 
 .
 



 We review applications on a rolling basis. Strong profiles hear from us within a week.
 



  





*SKEYEBOTS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates solely on capability, curiosity, and drive.*
