 Cuculus is the key to providing utilities to all, while protecting the world’s precious resources. Jointly with our international partner network, we provide cutting\-edge software and technology solutions to address utility challenges now and in the future. Cuculus will never tire of creating innovative technology and services that enable utilities and organisations to successfully transition to a new era of providing and managing electricity, water, and gas. The work we do is important for individuals, cities, and entire nations. Our work is serious, but we have fun with it, too.

**Who are we looking for?**
 We are looking for Associate SW Development Engineer for our Broadband Devices Team, where we're pioneering the future of multigigabit connectivity. This role involves developing software features, collaborating with hardware teams, troubleshooting and debugging network devices and products, and resolving system\-level issues.
   

  

**Location**
 Hybrid role – working at 3\-4 days a week from our office in Bangalore.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Responsible for debugging and resolving complex cross\-layer system issues reported by QA and customers, performing root cause analysis, and implementing long\-term corrective and preventive solutions.


**What You Will Need To Succeed**
* BE in Electronics and communication or Computer science with 85% or 8\.5 CGPA
* No current backlogs, no repeat year or gap in studies
* Excellent at C\+\+/C programming coding
* Knowledge in Layer 2/3 networking protocols
* Linux Knowledge – Advantage.
* Script tools/languages (Perl, Python, Bash, etc.) \- advantage
* High level of interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate effectively with different groups.
* Fluent English (writing and speaking)


**Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion at Harmonic**
 At Harmonic, we believe that building and nurturing a global team with diverse backgrounds and voices is critical to our success. Together, we achieve excellence through creativity and innovation, build relationships based on integrity and mutual respect, and deliver the highest quality in every aspect of our business for the benefit of our employees, business partners and shareholders.
   

  

 \#AK\-1
   

  

**About Us**
 Harmonic (NASDAQ: HLIT), the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, is transforming multi\-gigabit connectivity. The company’s industry\-leading cOS™ virtualized broadband platform, suite of solutions for fiber and DOCSIS, and a growing portfolio of AI\-powered network intelligence solutions, enable broadband service providers to simplify operations, deliver exceptional subscriber experiences and expand revenue streams. With thousands of vCMTS servers and hundreds of thousands of RPDs deployed globally, Harmonic powers next\-generation broadband services with five\-nines reliability. Anchored with a customer\-first approach and driven by a legacy of innovation, Harmonic supports broadband service providers at every stage of their network evolution.  Join the broadband revolution at Harmonic, where we're pioneering the future of multigigabit connectivity! As the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, we're transforming the way people live, work, and connect. Our groundbreaking technologies, including Unified DOCSIS 4\.0, Remote OLT, and AI\-Ops solutions, are empowering operators to deliver lightning\-fast internet services to homes and businesses across the globe. With our industry\-first virtualized broadband solution and cOS platform, we're simplifying operations, reducing costs, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. We're proud to power next\-gen broadband services for leading operators across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia.
   

  

 At Harmonic, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's shaping the future of connectivity. You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects, collaborate with top talent, and be part of a company that's making a real impact.
   

  

 Join our mission to empower a more connected world and discover a career that's fast, innovative, and full of possibilities!

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You should have hands\-on expertise in Embedded C\+\+, COM, MFC, Qt, C\#, and test frameworks such as GTest/GMock. Experience with WPF will be an added advantage.
   

  

 In this role, you will help drive the enhancement, modernization, and quality of software systems used in advanced scientific instruments. You will contribute to software development, system integration, and engineering best practices, while also supporting collaboration and continuous improvement across the team.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Develop, enhance, and maintain Microscope Control Software and related Windows\-based components using Embedded C\+\+, COM, MFC, and C\# as core technologies, with WPF and Qt exposure where applicable.
+ Develop software layers that interface with supplier\-provided hardware APIs.
+ Implement and maintain hardware abstraction layers (HAL).
+ Integrate SCU, PLC, and IO\-Link based devices into microscope control platforms.
+ Develop device communication and control modules.

* Drive integration across native and managed components, including interoperability between legacy COM/MFC\-based systems and newer software components.
* Establish and improve engineering quality practices using unit, integration, and system\-level testing frameworks such as GTest/GMock.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and performance issues across application, framework, and platform layers; drive root\-cause analysis and preventive fixes.
* Support the introduction of advanced testing approaches such as BDD and model\-based testing where appropriate, while recognizing that specialized knowledge in MBT (Axini), Dezyne, and ASD may be learned on the job.
* Contribute to release readiness, technical risk management, and long\-term platform roadmap planning.
* Promote best practices in documentation, code reviews, quality engineering, and cross\-team collaboration.


**Required Skills**
* 4–6 years of software engineering experience with mandatory hands\-on expertise in Embedded C\+\+, COM, and C\#.
* Required experience in Windows application development using MFC, Qt, with WPF considered good\-to\-have skill.
* Good understanding of software engineering principles, object\-oriented design, design patterns, and development methodologies, with experience in multi\-module application development and integration of legacy and modern software components.
* Hands\-on experience with unit and component test frameworks such as GTest/GMock.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across control software, desktop applications, system integrations, and performance\-sensitive environments.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum and SAFe, with experience operating effectively in sprint\-based and cross\-team planning environments.
* Experience operating in structured product\-development environments with strong quality and delivery expectations.


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to Behavior Driven Development (BDD) and an understanding of how it can improve functional collaboration and test coverage.
* Awareness or prior exposure to Model Based Testing (MBT) tools such as Axini.
* Familiarity with Dezyne, ASD, or similar model\-based engineering approaches.
* Experience with development and maintenance of microscope control software or other complex instrument\-control software is highly desirable.
* Exposure to regulated, safety\-conscious, or high\-reliability product environments.
* Experience with automated build, test, and continuous integration workflows for desktop or systems software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Prior experience in scientific, industrial, or instrument\-control software environments is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of BDD, MBT (Axini), Dezyne, or ASD is advantageous but not mandatory; candidates with strong core engineering foundations should be willing to learn these areas on the job.

description:
**Job Description**
**About TaskUs:** 
 TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next\-generation customer experience to fast\-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud\-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest\-growing sectors, including social media, e\-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride\-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
   

  

 The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty\-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
   

  

 It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

**What We Offer:** 
 At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well\-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
   

  

 We are building a different breed of BPO , driven by constant innovation and a commitment to excellence in autonomous last\-mile logistics . If you are looking to be part of a dynamic, forward\-thinking culture that embraces technical challenges and masters operational consistency, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 As a Teammate, you will be directly responsible for remotely operating autonomous delivery robots for a worldwide delivery service. This is a critical role that combines technical operation, safety assurance, and world\-class customer service. You will be a key part of the team dedicated to ensuring timely, safe, and efficient last\-mile service for our customers.
   

  

 In this role, your success will be measured by performance metrics focusing on operational accuracy, efficiency, safety compliance , and providing exceptional service in every remote interaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Remote Robot Operation: Safely and efficiently pilot autonomous delivery robots to complete last\-mile customer deliveries, adhering strictly to all traffic laws and operational regulations.
* Safety Assurance: Maintain the highest level of situational awareness and immediately intervene to ensure robot safety and public well\-being during all phases of operation.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve basic, real\-time technical and navigational issues that arise during remote operation.
* Customer Interaction: Provide immediate, high\-quality remote support to customers during the delivery process (e.g., confirming drop\-offs, addressing immediate concerns).
* Communication \& Collaboration: Maintain clear, prompt, and effective communication with Mission Control and team members to ensure smooth handover and operational continuity.
* Process Improvement: Proactively identify and report operational bottlenecks, contributing valuable feedback to improve internal processes and robot performance protocols.
* Documentation: Accurately record operational data, customer interactions, and delivery outcomes.


**Essential Requirements**
* A minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent .
* Exceptional attention to detail and a high degree of visual processing accuracy.
* Demonstrated knowledge of basic troubleshooting techniques and comfort with complex software interfaces.
* Proficiency in using digital maps/navigation tools (e.g., Google Maps ) for rapid location and route assessment.
* Ability to thrive and maintain focus in a fast\-paced, high\-stakes operational environment .
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make swift, sound decisions under pressure.


**Desirable Skills (The "Ideal Pilot"):**
* Tech\-Savviness: Quick learner with new technologies and strong fundamental computer skills.
* Vigilance \& Focus: Proven ability to remain alert, responsive, and highly focused in front of a screen for several hours at a time during shifts.
* Visual\-Motor Coordination: Good reaction time and motor skills required for precise robot control and the ability to rapidly process large amounts of visual information (Vigilance/Scanning).
* Reliability: Impeccable attendance record and strong sense of responsibility for your assigned workload and schedule.
* Communication: Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
* Scheduling Flexibility: Availability to work in nights and rotational shifts.
* Visual Acuity: Ability to distinguish different colors, which is essential for interacting with Operations and tools.


 If you're energetic, deeply detail\-oriented , have great focus, and are excited to help build the future of autonomous last\-mile delivery , you'll thrive in this pioneering role.
   

  

****How We Partner To Protect You:****
 TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.
   

  

****DEI:****
 In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
   

  

 We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
 **https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**
 TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

title: System Integration Engineer_SEM (Semiconductor)
description:
**Who We Are**
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Location:
   

  

 Bangalore,IND
   

  

 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
   

  

 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
   

  

 As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are responsible for developing and maintaining methods, operating sequences, and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, subassemblies, and final assemblies. You'll work closely with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and new products, and you'll use engineering principles to estimate and reduce manufacturing costs, improve product quality, determine time standards, and make recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Your expertise in lean principles, automation, and continuous improvement will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and achieving higher levels of productivity and cost\-effectiveness. You'll develop and use test procedures, evaluate test results, and assess work methods, procedures, and policies to identify root cause issues and solutions that ensure operational success.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly talented integration engineer to join our team and integrate complex multi\-disciplinary systems modules (Scanning Electron Microscopes).
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 As part of our team, you will work together with great people, hands\-on with one of the most complex multi\-disciplinary systems in the market, putting into practice many of the fields from your studies.
   

  

**Our Group:**
 The team is responsible for system Scanning Electron Microscopes integration for Applied Materials \- Metrology and Inspection tools before shipment to the customer.
   

  

 In addition, we lead R\&D prototypes and new products in the organization, with large exposure to the most advanced technologies such as precise mechanics, electronics, motion and optics.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
 The system integration engineer gets a fully assembled Scanning Electron Microscopes. His job is to calibrate and test a multi\-disciplinary system, in clean room environment, from start to end until shipment to the customer includes complicated troubleshooting, investigation and engineering solutions proposal.
   

  

 Since we are talking about a Scanning Electron Microscopes with Very high complexity multi\-disciplinary system involving several modules and disciplines, such as E\-Beam (Electron\-beam Microscopy), high\-end optics, lasers, precise mechanics, RF, motion and control etc., the essence of our work requires high system understanding, deep engineering knowledge and high accountability level.
   

  

 Role and responsibilities: \-
   

  

* Responsible for technical support to meet the system’s specifications \& team KPIs: on time delivery, Operational aspects of the tool’s integration process, Lab Tool fleet performance
* Performs highly complex operational and functional tests, calibrations, verification of sub\-assemblies and/or systems
* Troubleshoots modules and fully integrates systems. Performs in\-house customer acceptance tests.
* Travels to Applied materials \- PDC Israel site to install and support tools.
* Follow and complete documentation procedures and forms of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Pursue and develop procedural, safety and process improvements. Identify problems and resolve problems as an individual or as a team.
* Working 5 days/week from Bangalore Office (Saturday \& Sunday a must).


**What should you have?**
* Bachelor's degree B. Tech Electrical Engineer
* 2\-4 years of relevant technical experience: System integration experience or other high complex technical background \- Advantage
* 10 \- 30% travelling
* Team player, Highly Creative and Proactive
* High level of independent work with constant drive for improvement


 This is a physically demanding position that often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.
   

  

**Functional Knowledge**
* Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities


**Business Expertise**
* Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work


**Leadership**
* No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members


**Problem Solving**
* Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents


**Impact**
* Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies


**Interpersonal Skills**
 Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
 Full time
   

  

**Employee Type:**
 Assignee / Regular
   

  

**Travel:**
 Yes, 25% of the Time
   

  

**Relocation Eligible:**
 Yes
   

  

 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Rep I
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice


**Team Overview**

The Tenant \& Employment (T\&E) Operations team supports TransUnion's employment and tenant screening business by delivering accurate, compliant, and timely screening services that help customers make informed housing and employment decisions. The team is responsible for identity verification, consumer disclosures, dispute resolution, criminal record verification, and other critical back\-office operations that ensure data integrity and regulatory compliance. This team reports to the T\&E Operations Manager/Team Lead within the Consumer Interactive business unit.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in\-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  

  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The T\&E Back Office Operations Representative plays a role in supporting employment and tenant screening operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and service level commitments.


* Review and validate identity verification documents to support accurate consumer verification and screening decisions.
* Process consumer/ Customer requests in accordance with Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) requirements and established operational procedures.
* Investigate, research, and resolve consumer disputes while maintaining regulatory compliance and quality standards.
* Complete recommendation transactions and screening\-related workflows accurately and within defined service level agreements (SLAs).
* Respond to customer and consumer inquiries through email while providing timely, professional, and accurate resolutions.
* Conduct outbound calls to U.S. courts, government agencies, and public record sources to verify criminal case information and obtain case disposition details.
* Review criminal background screening results, eviction records, and housing\-related records to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
* Document research findings and verification outcomes accurately within designated systems and tools.
* Maintain productivity, quality, and compliance performance metrics while adhering to operational procedures and business policies.
Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex cases and improve operational efficiency and customer experience.  
* 

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

**Required Knowledge and Experience**

* Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately review and verify documents.
* Good typing skills and proficiency in data entry with a high level of accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Confidence in handling outbound calls and interacting professionally with customers, employers, courts, and other external contacts.
* Basic understanding of U.S. employment and tenant screening processes, or a strong willingness to learn.
* Strong analytical and research skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism.
* Freshers and candidates with less than 1 year of experience candidates preferred

**Required Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word, for documentation, reporting, and communication.
* Experience working with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, case management tools, or workflow management platforms.
* Ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and productivity.
Ability to conduct online research and utilize public record databases effectively.  
* 

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.  



Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting\-edge technology.  



  

TransUnion Job Title

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Viral Pitch** 




 At Viral Pitch, we are building a comprehensive influencer marketing platform that brings together data\-driven research, technology, and creativity to deliver high\-impact influencer campaigns for brands. As an AI\-powered hybrid platform, we combine advanced tools and innovative strategies with strong relationships across the influencer ecosystem. Our approach balances automation with personalized creative input to create measurable value for both brands and creators.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an enthusiastic and driven Associate Product Manager to join our Product team. You will contribute to the evolution of our influencer marketing platform by supporting product development, improving user experience, and helping turn customer and business needs into impactful product solutions. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to translate ideas and requirements into well\-defined, user\-focused product features and improvements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Assist in managing the end\-to\-end product lifecycle, from planning and discovery through execution and release.
 



 • Gather, understand, document, and prioritize product and user requirements from multiple stakeholders.
 



 • Support the definition and maintenance of product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and feature priorities. • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to deliver seamless product updates.
 



 • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify emerging trends, customer needs, and opportunities in the influencer marketing space.
 



 • Translate business and user requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature documentation.
 



 • Work with design and engineering teams to clarify requirements, track progress, resolve dependencies, and support timely delivery.
 



 • Participate in product testing, feedback cycles, launches, and post\-release reviews to ensure quality and adoption.
 



 • Monitor user feedback and product performance to identify areas for improvement and recommend data\-informed solutions.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • 6 months to 2 years of experience in Product Management, Associate Product Management, Business Analysis, or a closely related role.
 



 • Strong understanding of product development fundamentals, user\-centric thinking, and prioritization.
 



 • Ability to gather requirements, structure problems, and communicate product needs clearly to cross\-functional teams.
 



 • Strong analytical, research, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication with strong stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 • Comfort working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment with multiple priorities.
 



 • A proactive, curious mindset with a genuine interest in technology, digital products, and emerging trends.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Exposure to B2B SaaS, marketplaces, creator economy, influencer marketing, or digital platforms.
 



 • Familiarity with product analytics, user research, wireframing/prototyping, or tools such as Jira, Figma, or similar platforms.
 



 • Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum product development practices.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, data, creativity, and influencer marketing. You will have hands\-on exposure to the product lifecycle and collaborate with multiple business functions while contributing to a platform used to create value for brands and creators.

 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. * Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple lines of execution with attention to detail and quality.
* Certifications in the financial domain such as CA or CFA will be an added advantage.
* Experience of working in the front, middle, and/or back\-office space will be an added advantage.
* Fund accounting and journal entries knowledge will be an added advantage.
* Experience working closely with engineers.
* Outstanding academic background and passion to work in a high\-tech software development environment.
* A high level of personal maturity and a collaborative attitude.
* A healthy combination of resourcefulness, domain expertise, creativity, and execution prowess.

title: Deputy Manager - Product
description:
**About Us**
**Who we are:**
 Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. For more than 100 years, Samsonite has leveraged its rich heritage to create unparalleled products that fulfill the travel lifestyle needs of conscious movers everywhere. With a portfolio of brands including Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann, and Lipault Paris, our products are sold in over 100 countries in North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America through our company\-operated retail store, websites and a variety of retail partners.
   

  

**Job Description**
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

 01 Product \& Launch Ownership
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end launch strategy and execution readiness across all channels \- deciding sequencing, prioritisation, and trade\-offs, not just tracking a checklist.
   

  

 Sign off on product codification and system readiness ahead of every launch, resolving cross\-functional gaps directly with planning and supply chain leads.
   

  

 Own system pricing strategy and governance \- setting the process, ensuring accuracy across systems and channels, and correcting discrepancies at source.
   

  

 Lead dispatch planning conversations with sales and supply teams, negotiating trade\-offs between availability, cost, and speed to shelf.
   

  

 Own the launch calendar and the internal launch toolkit process, briefing branch and sales leadership directly ahead of every go\-live.
   

  

 02 Business \& Inventory Strategy
   

  

 Own demand planning inputs and inventory strategy, setting the view the Brand Head takes into leadership reviews.
   

  

 Proactively identify inventory risks and opportunities and recommend action \- not just flag them, but bring a point of view on what to do.
   

  

 Own the performance reporting cadence for the Brand Head, translating channel and sell\-through data into a clear narrative and recommendation.
   

  

 03 Ecommerce \& Digital Presence
   

  

 Own ecommerce and D2C brand presence strategy across Amazon, Flipkart, and brand.com \- content quality, assortment, and conversion, not just listing accuracy.
   

  

 Set the competitive benchmarking framework for pricing, assortment, and content, and bring recommendations to the Brand Head rather than raw findings.
   

  

 Be the escalation point with the ecommerce team when launches, content, or imagery are at risk of missing timelines.
   

  

 04 Brand \& Retail Execution
   

  

 Support the VM Head in driving in\-store visibility and display standards \- planogram compliance, seasonal changeovers, and store experience \- bringing category and brand context to their execution plan.
   

  

 Partner with the Marcom Head to plan and deliver BTL assets: POSMs, window displays, standees, catalogues, and retail collateral, contributing category inputs and holding vendors accountable to spec on the ground.
   

  

 Support day\-to\-day vendor and production coordination, including commercial inputs, working alongside the VM and Marcom teams rather than independently.
   

  

 Run the store audit process and share findings with the VM Head to inform corrective action plans.
   

  

 05 Analytics \& Business Insights
   

  

 Own and maintain the Excel\-based tracker architecture for business performance, inventory health, launch readiness, and brand spend.
   

  

 Lead analysis of product and launch performance, bringing a clear point of view on what worked, what did not, and why \- to the Brand Head, unprompted.
   

  

 Own MIS reporting quality and cadence for the Brand Head.
   

  

 Co\-build QBR and leadership presentation narratives with the Brand Head, not just the supporting data.
   

  

 06 Cross\-functional Leadership
   

  

 Drive alignment across sales, marketing, planning, and ecommerce teams on launches and key brand initiatives, resolving conflicts without escalation where possible.
   

  

 Own communication of product launches and campaign activity to branch teams across India.
   

  

 Identify process gaps across workflows and lead the fix \- designing and implementing the improved process, not just flagging it.
   

  

 Own day\-to\-day and commercial management of vendor and agency relationships, including PO governance and invoice resolution.
   

  

 STAKEHOLDER ECOSYSTEM
   

  

 Internal
   

  

 Brand Head – Samsonite India (reporting line)
   

  

* VM Head
* Marcom Head
* Sales \& branch teams
* Supply chain, planning \& inventory teams
* Finance \& commercial teams
* Ecommerce \& D2C teams
* Nasik Factory
* Singapore HQ – Product Team


 We are looking for an MBA or equivalent who has moved past pure execution and is ready to own outcomes. Someone who treats a deadline as a commitment, a brand standard as non\-negotiable, and understands both the commercial side of the business and the brand values that sit behind it.
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

 5\-7 years of experience in consumer brands \- FMCG, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer durables.
   

  

 A proven track record of having owned \- not just supported \- a launch cycle, BTL production cycle, or category P\&L input end to end.
   

  

 Strong command of data and commercial tracking: PSI, inventory management, pricing, and ecommerce metrics should be second nature, not a learning curve.
   

  

 Ecommerce platform experience (Amazon, Flipkart, D2C) from a brand or category management perspective, with the judgement to set strategy, not just execute it.
   

  

 Advanced Excel skills for business tracking, analysis, and modelling.
   

  

 A genuine understanding of premium brands \- how premium is built, protected, and perceived \- not just a background in mass or value categories.
   

  

 An eye for last\-mile detail: someone who notices the misaligned POSM, the wrong pack shot, the off\-brand pricing tag before it reaches a store or a customer.
   

  

**About The Team**
**Why you'll love working here:**
* Our employees matter. As a people\-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based.
* Vibrant culture. We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long\-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day.
* Socially responsible. We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models.


**What We Value**
 At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily.
   

  

 Samsonite is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

title: Project Manager at Site
description:
Company Description JV Ventures, founded in 2015, focuses on nurturing innovative concepts and transforming them into scalable, high\-impact enterprises. With 20 ventures, 320\+ team members, and $550M\+ assets under management, the organization operates across education, life sciences, healthcare, and experience\-focused habitat platforms. Its PowerEd, PoweRx, PowerCare and PowerPod platforms provide integrated infrastructure, services, and ecosystem\-building solutions. JV Ventures is supported by specialized enablers in middle\-office, coworking, and land services, creating a robust environment for sustainable growth and execution\-focused ventures.
 



  





 Role purpose
 



 The Associate – Projects \& Design will support the end\-to\-end delivery of build\-out projects across JV Ventures' GRIDs in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai and Visakhapatnam — from design coordination and technical detailing through PMC oversight, site execution, quality checks and handover. This is a hands\-on, learning\-oriented role for an early\-career professional from a building engineering, architecture or construction management background who wants to build deep, on\-ground delivery experience on large\-scale research and manufacturing infrastructure.
 



 The Associate will work closely with the Projects \& Build\-outs team, design consultants, contractors and vendors, and will be expected to grow quickly into independently owning defined workstreams and smaller build\-out projects of JV Ventures.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



 1\. Design \& technical support
 


* Assist in developing and reviewing technical drawings, specifications and BOQs for warm\-shell\-to\-lab conversions, manufacturing facility build\-outs and GCC fit\-outs.
* Support design coordination between clients/residents, architects and MEP consultants, and JV Ventures' internal design and delivery teams.
* Help translate resident/client requirements into workable design and build\-out plans aligned with JV Ventures' Grade\-A specifications.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date project documentation, drawings and technical files across active build\-outs.



  





 2\. Project execution \& site coordination
 


* Support planning and tracking of project timelines, resources and deliverables across assigned build\-out projects.
* Coordinate with site teams, vendors and contractors to keep build\-outs on schedule and support the target of reducing time\-to\-operations.
* Monitor on\-site progress, flag risks or delays early, and support timely resolution of technical or execution issues.
* Assist with site visits, inspections and progress reporting, including travel across campuses and project sites as required.



  





 3\. Quality, compliance \& handover
 


* Support quality checks during construction and fit\-out to ensure adherence to specifications, life\-safety systems and campus standards (power, HVAC, discharge treatment).
* Support regulatory and compliance\-driven execution, including inputs toward GMP/GLP qualification readiness where applicable.
* Help prepare handover documentation, including as\-built drawings, quality records and completion reports.
* Escalate quality or compliance concerns to senior project team members in a timely manner.



  





 4\. Procurement \& commercial support
 


* Support vendor\-neutral procurement coordination, including vendor follow\-ups, material tracking and basic cost/billing documentation.
* Assist in maintaining project cost trackers and supporting inputs for budgeting and billing cycles.



  





 5\. Stakeholder coordination
 


* Coordinate with internal teams (design, PMC, operations) and external stakeholders (residents, consultants, contractors) to keep build\-outs moving smoothly.
* Maintain clear, professional communication and follow\-up across all project stakeholders.



  





 Candidate profile
 



 Education
 


* Master's degree in Architecture, Building Engineering, Civil Engineering or Construction/Project Management from a reputed institute such as SPA (School of Planning and Architecture), CEPT University, NIT Calicut, or an equivalent institution.



  





 Experience
 


* 1–4 years of relevant experience in building engineering, design coordination, project execution or site management, across institutional, laboratory, healthcare, manufacturing or fit\-out projects.
* Exposure to technical drawings, BOQs, specifications and basic project scheduling.
* Familiarity with civil, architectural and basic MEP coordination is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or other relevant design/drafting tools; good working knowledge of MS Excel and documentation.



  





 Attributes
 


* Strong attention to detail and ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Good communication and stakeholder\-coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel to project and client sites as required.
* Telugu speaking is required, given the candidate\-facing and on\-site stakeholder coordination nature of the role; working proficiency in English is also essential.
* This is an immediate requirement; preference will be given to candidates who are immediate joiners or can join within 30 days.
* A builder's mindset — comfortable working hands\-on in a growing, fast\-paced function.
* Ability to learn quickly and take on greater independent ownership over time.



  





 Role requisites
 


* Position will be based full\-time in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Chennai, based on project assignment, with travel across campuses and project sites as required.
* An opportunity to build hands\-on project delivery experience on a fast\-growing life sciences infrastructure platform, at a pivotal juncture in JV Ventures' expansion across its GRID locations, working closely with the Projects \& Build\-outs team and senior leadership.
* Compensation will be aligned to experience and qualification, to be discussed during the process.
* This description sets the core mandate and may evolve with business priorities.

 Proven experience leading complex, multidisciplinary technical projects.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities

title: Project Engineer HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Für zugehörige Kundenausstattungs\-, Einrichtungs\- oder Infrastrukturprojekte: verantwortlich für Projektabwicklung, Ergebnisverantwortung und Kundenzufriedenheit durch Verwaltung der projektbezogenen Aktivitäten und Ressourcen. Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Nicht schlüsselfertige Projekte oder Projekte nur für Produkte/Geräte. Verantwortlich für die Beaufsichtigung des Projekts und die direkte oder indirekte Leitung und/oder Verwaltung der Projektressourcen für kleine und mittlere Projekte (Größe in Bezug auf das GE\-Unternehmen), die nur Geräte, Produktsuiten oder nicht schlüsselfertige Projekte umfassen können.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support\-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.
* Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior\-Team zu führen.Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova.Erklärt anderen technische Informationen.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Project Manager I - TPM
description:
**Role Description**
 Job Description \- TPM We are seeking an experienced Data Technical Project Manager (TPM) to lead the delivery of enterprise data initiatives within the banking domain. The role requires strong data platform knowledge, project delivery expertise, and a solid understanding of banking regulations and risk controls. You will work closely with data engineering, architecture, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality, compliant data solutions. Experience Requirement Minimum 7 years experience in a similar position within a dynamic, fast\-paced enterprise technology environment. 12\+ years of experience leading enterprise\-scale technology transformations, with focus on cloud, data analytics, and platform stability. Project Delivery \& Governance Manage end\-to\-end delivery of assigned projects or workstreams, ensuring alignment between business stakeholders and technology teams. Define and control project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Track and communicate dependencies, risks, issues, and impacts to maintain delivery momentum. Execute project governance, including roles, responsibilities, decision\-making processes, and escalation paths. Provide regular project status updates, ensuring clear and transparent communication. Facilitate project meetings such as status reviews, design discussions, and issue\-resolution sessions. Stakeholder \& Team Management Serve as a bridge between technical and business teams, aligning stakeholders from infrastructure, operations, and engineering. Collaborate with stakeholders to define success criteria and measurable delivery outcomes. Work closely with engineering and architecture teams to gather system requirements and translate business needs into technical deliverables. Technical Expertise \& Cloud Programs Orchestrate end\-to\-end cloud migration programs for mission\-critical systems, ensuring zero downtime and security compliance. Lead enterprise\-scale tech transformations, including cloud\-native programs (GCP, Azure), AI\-based automation, and Big Data engineering. Drive tools engineering and automation strategies for platform stability. Data Management \& Analytics Act as a data steward for enterprise datasets, ensuring governance and integrity across global teams. Support data model and integration design activities for enterprise data platforms. Monitor data workflows and pipelines to ensure performance, reliability, and timely delivery. Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards. Expertise Knowledge of various database management systems (RDBMS, NoSQL) and data warehousing concepts and tools (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift), Python. Expert in analysing data to drive insights, define requirements, and support strategic decisions. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement Assist in evaluating and adopting new data tools, platforms, and technologies. Coordinate troubleshooting efforts and support performance and reliability improvements. Maintain accurate documentation of project artifacts, data architecture, and technical processes.
   

  

**Skills**
 Cloud Data Warehousing, Stakeholder Management, Project Management, Process Documentation, Application Migration, Data Engineering, Risk Management

description:

 Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting\-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.
   

  

**What We Offer**

 Bangalore,IND

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Responsibilities**
 We are seeking a Scrum Master to support our dynamic and self\-organized team.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have experience in agile environments and a strong ability to facilitate collaboration, continuous improvement, and efficient delivery within Scrum teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Scrum Master for one or more agile teams and ensure Scrum principles and practices are applied effectively.
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies such as Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Support the team in removing impediments and fostering a productive working environment.
* Coach the team and stakeholders in agile ways of working and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and other stakeholders to support efficient delivery.
* Promote transparency, communication, and self\-organization within the team.


 Desired Candidate Profile
   

  

* Experience working as a Scrum Master in agile software development environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum principles, agile methodologies, and team facilitation.
* Ability to identify and remove blockers and support the team in improving delivery processes.
* Strong communication, moderation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and self\-organized teams.
* Confident communication skills in English, both spoken and written.
* Scrum certification is a plus.
* Experience in working with distributed or international teams is a plus.

title: Project Scrum Master
description:
Facilitate core Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective) to help the team deliver committed outcomes each sprint.
   

  

 Coach the team on Agile/Scrum fundamentals and reinforce agreed working agreements, Definition of Ready, and Definition of Done.
   

  

 Partner with the Product Owner to support healthy backlog refinement, clear acceptance criteria, and a shared understanding of priorities.
   

  

 Remove or escalate impediments in a timely manner and help the team navigate blockers, risks, and dependencies with guidance from more senior Scrum Masters or leaders.
   

  

 Use Jira/Azure Boards (or similar tools) to maintain accurate boards, sprint metrics, and team transparency (e.g., sprint progress, throughput/velocity trends, and impediment logs).
   

  

 Promote collaboration across engineering, product, and partner functions to improve flow, quality, and predictability of delivery.
   

  

 Support continuous improvement by helping the team identify, prioritize, and track actions from retrospectives.
   

  

 Participate in PI planning and other SAFe ceremonies (as applicable) and help ensure team commitments and dependencies are communicated and managed.
   

  

**Skills And Qualifications**
 Core Scrum and Agile Expertise
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
   

  

 2\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master (or in a similar Agile delivery role) supporting technology delivery teams
   

  

 Scrum and/or SAFe certification (e.g., Scrum.org, SAFe) required
   

  

 Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and basic Lean/flow concepts; ability to apply practices pragmatically for the team
   

  

 Working proficiency with Jira and/or Azure Boards (or similar) to manage backlogs, boards, sprint metrics, and reporting
   

  

 Familiarity with Confluence (or similar) for documenting team working agreements, decisions, and process artifacts
   

  

 Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Understanding of how team delivery supports product goals and customer value
   

  

 Experience working with delivery teams and business partners across different time zones
   

  

 Ability to help the team translate priorities and acceptance criteria into actionable sprint work
   

  

 Customer mindset helps the team stay focused on outcomes, quality, and feedback loops

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile Delivery \& Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Contribute to Quarterly / PI objectives and Scrum Master OKRs for MCP teams.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master in complex technology delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM).
* SAFe or large‑scale Agile exposure.
* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).
* Hands‑on experience with Jira / Agile tooling.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict‑resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Staff Specialist - Release Train Engineer
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
 We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.
   

  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience.
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence.
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment.


**About The Role**
 The Brand Experience team develops innovative consumer experiences that enhance lives through products, services, and technologies. This role collaborates with the Brand Technical Lead and Product Manager to translate feature requirements and roadmaps into both code\-based and non\-code\-based technical solutions.
   

  

 The Staff Specialist \- Release Train Engineer is the servant leader and chief facilitator of an Agile Release Train (ART) within the Car Audio organization. This role ensures alignment, synchronization, and flow across multiple cross\-functional teams delivering premium brand experiences to OEM customers. The RTE is responsible for enabling consistent, high\-quality, and predictable delivery of features across software, hardware, and acoustics teams while embedding compliance, innovation, and Lean\-Agile principles into execution.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 ART Facilitation \& Execution
   

  

* Serve as the chief Scrum Master for the ART, ensuring consistent cadence, alignment, and flow of 5 to 15 teams (50 to 125 people)
* Facilitate key ART ceremonies: PI Planning, ART Syncs (Scrum of Scrums \& PO Sync), System Demos, Inspect \& Adapt workshops.
* Work closely with Product Management, System Architects, and Brand Owners to define and track PI Objectives.
* Drive dependency management and risk visibility across brand and platform teams.
* Partner with the System Team to maintain integration readiness, continuous testing, and system demo preparation.


 Lean\-Agile Leadership
   

  

* Coach teams and stakeholders in Lean\-Agile practices and SAFe principles.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, flow optimization, and transparency.
* Identify bottlenecks in delivery flow and lead resolution through collaboration, not command.
* Guide ART metrics: predictability, velocity, flow efficiency, PI objective achievement, and defect trends.


 Cross\-Brand and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Coordinate across multiple ARTs (e.g., JBL, B\&W, h/k) to align shared teams and dependencies.
* Collaborate with Cross\-Brand Team Leaders and the System Architect to synchronize technical and validation deliverables.
* Ensure shared assets such as DSP frameworks, HIL/VIL platforms, and compliance pipelines are integrated across brand initiatives.
* Integrate ASPICE, ISO 26262, and cybersecurity compliance activities into ART backlogs via enabler stories.
* Support PI and Program\-level reporting for OEM milestones and management reviews.


 Communication \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Serve as the primary communication hub between ART teams and stakeholders.
* Provide transparency through clear, data\-driven reporting and visual management (Program Boards, PI Metrics).
* Align ART priorities with business goals set by Brand Owners and Portfolio Management.


 Authorities
   

  

* Define Sprint and Release cadence and synchronization


 Accountabilities
   

  

* PI Planning event orchestration
* Concept freeze and approval (technical sections).
* Cross\-brand alignment and minimal integration delays.
* Compliance activities integrated into ART cadence without delaying delivery.
* Positive feedback from Product Management, Brand Owners, and OEM stakeholders.


 Success Measures (KPIs)
   

  

* ART predictability, with PI objectives consistently met.
* Dependency resolution
* I\&A improvement actions
* Flow metrics
* Improved cross\-brand alignment and fewer integration delays.
* Compliance activities integrated into ART cadence without delaying delivery.
* Positive feedback from Product Management, Brand Owners, and OEM stakeholders.


**What You Need To Be Successful**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field.
* 10\+ years in complex product development (automotive or consumer electronics preferred).
* 5\+ years in Agile leadership roles (Scrum Master, RTE, or Program Manager).
* SAFe certification required (SAFe RTE, SPC, or SAFe Agilist preferred).
* Proven experience with multi\-domain development (hardware, software, acoustics, and compliance).
* Familiarity with IBM Engineering Lifecycle Management (DOORS, EWM, ETM) or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262, and automotive OEM milestone processes.
* Expert in facilitation, alignment, and stakeholder management across distributed teams.
* Ability to visualize and manage dependencies in complex environments.
* Excellent understanding of Lean flow metrics and performance tracking.
* Skilled at driving continuous improvement and cultural transformation.
* Strong communication and executive reporting skills.
* ART predictability ≥ 80% and PI objectives consistently met.
* Improved cross\-brand alignment and fewer integration delays.
* Compliance activities integrated into ART cadence without delaying delivery.
* Positive feedback from Product Management, Brand Owners, and OEM stakeholders.


**Bonus Points if You Have**
* Advanced degree in Management or Engineering Management.
* Strong recommendations from automotive industry colleagues.
* Automotive Business \& Engineering Landscape Knowledge.
* Interest in acoustics and sound reproduction.
* Flexible in a challenging work environment.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent presentation/communication skills.


**What Makes You Eligible**
* Be willing to travel to one or more PI Planning events, 1 week per quarter, domestic and international travel.


**What We Offer**
* HARMAN FlexConnect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in\-office days per week.
* Access to employee discounts on world class HARMAN/Samsung products (BRAND, Harman Kardon, AKG etc.)
* Inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages career development opportunities.
* On\-site opportunities to focus on personal well\-being and development such as, onsite café, fitness center, weekly massage, fitness classes, and other onsite events promoted by our employee resource groups.
* Professional development opportunities through HARMAN University’s business and leadership academies.
* Internal talent management leadership acceleration programs.

**You Belong Here**
 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
   

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
   

  

 Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands.
