title: Engineer II
description:
Engineer II (SX)
   

  

 The Company
   

  

 Kantata takes professional services automation to a new level, giving people\-powered businesses the clarity, control, and confidence they need to elevate organizational performance throughout the project lifecycle. The Kantata Cloud for Professional Services™ is helping over 2,000 firms in more than 100 countries focus on and optimize their most important asset: their people.
   

  

 Kantata is well\-capitalized, hiring, and growing our loyal and diversified customer base at breakneck speed. Most importantly, we have a clear vision of where we’re going and how to get there. (Hint: It involves you.) Did we mention that Kantata is also an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a team that loves what they do. A talented team, great perks, and an amazing culture \= an employee\-rated Best Place to Work!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Salesforce Developer at Kantata, you’ll be responsible for the ongoing design, build, and maintenance of the application components that make up the Kantata SX solution. You’ll be part of a highly\-agile team to support the market with new feature development, maintaining current builds, and working collaboratively with peers to solve interesting challenges in the market.
   

  

 Kantata is a SaaS product built using Salesforce technology and delivered on the Force.com platform. Kantata's SX and OX products are the leaders in the Professional Services management space. Kantata SX is uniquely positioned to serve enterprise customers who are using Salesforce at a foundational level within their operations stack.
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 This unique, hands\-on role involves working closely with the Kantata Product Management team to scope, plan, design, and develop new Kantata PSA features as part of a sprint\-based delivery model. You’ll be influential on the team by owning, shaping, and developing functionality to satisfy the enhancements raised by our customers and features from our product backlog. Working cross\-functionally, you’ll also investigate and resolve issues escalated from our client support team; identifying root cause and engineering fixes and changes, when needed.
   

  

 Goals and Responsibilities
   

  

 Owning aspects of our product solution, you’ll work on ensuring we can meet our ongoing commitment to customers to build and release innovative and engaging new features and enhancements. You’ll be supported by a mature and experienced development team and empowered to make large impacts in the hands\-on development of our application. Ownership through each build is established with a full\-stack focus and you’ll work exclusively with the Force.com platform and other Salesforce technologies, such as Visualforce, Lightning components, Apex and custom objects along with Javascript, HTML, and CSS. Our next addition to the team will be key to supporting the development of the overall solution architecture, with a focus on performance and process improvement. Success will stem from:
   

  

* Working with product managers to analyze requirements, understand and develop user stories, and designing features and functionality that solve the needs of our customers
* Taking responsibility for the end\-to\-end design and delivery of key functional areas in our app, becoming a subject matter expert
* Contributing to Kantata’s patterns and practices within the Salesforce platform to deliver and maintain unique product features
* Delivering optimized features that can scale to the needs of our enterprise clients using efficient UI, Apex, and SOQL design
* Delivering rapid prototyping that quickly envisions and credibly proposes solutions to complex challenges


 Your Profile
   

  

 You’re a strong engineer with a background in Salesforce development and performance optimization. Solving problems is your motivator and you influence by example. You’ve got experience in designing and implementing across all layers of web\-based SaaS solutions and enjoy a truly\-agile full\-stack environment. Defining and contributing to engineering best practices within a dynamic organization, where you’re heard and trusted, interests you and establishes a setting for you to thrive. Our newest developer will bring with them:
   

  

* Intermediate\-level experience in software development on the force.com platform
* Experience and comfortability within agile development approaches such as estimating, TDD, and working within sprint cycles
* Clear communication through technical design conversation, documentation, and presentations
* Confidence in facing unique or unprecedented development challenges and navigating problems without predefined solutions


 Our Philosophy
   

  

 We know every company can be successful with the right technology and when people are at the core. We believe that we’re better together \- that working hand\-in\-hand brings the best thoughts to the table and creates an environment of learning and growth. Here, you’ll enjoy:
   

  

* An intentionally engaging and collaborative culture \- ditch the silo!
* Strong work\-life balance that’s a true focus of the company
* The chance to learn from some of the best people in the business
* A vibrant, collaborative and devoted team, who still makes time for fun


 At Kantata, we strive to create an inclusive workplace that upholds the dignity of all people. We value, respect and celebrate everyone’s unique strengths from all different walks of life. As we continue to cultivate diversity within the company, our product (and people!) innovation continues to flourish.
   

  

 Kantata is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Product Designer
description:
**You'll Define How a Country Interacts With Its Land.**
 We've solved the hard back\-end — document mapping and real\-time access across 20\+ state databases. What we're hiring for is how it should feel. Fast. Clear. Like this is how land should always have worked.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* End\-to\-end design across mobile and web. Government\-heavy data turned into something that lands in seconds.
* The full spread of India. Non\-English speakers, first\-time smartphone users, and power users, who live in the product all day. The same screen has to work for all of them.
* Our design system. Tokens, components, states, motion. Work inside it, extend it where it's thin, keep it honest.
* The brand. Landing pages, ads, social, brand assets. India's first land\-tech brand is still being written.
* Real surface area. Small team, no layers. You present your own work to the people who decide.


**What We're Screening For**
 We don't expect all four. Two genuinely strong, real curiosity in the other two. A designer who's mildly good at everything has no edge, we'd rather have the edge.
   

  

* Design thinking \- can you get from fog to a screen you can defend? You start from the user's situation, not from a Dribbble reference. You explore more than one direction before committing, and you can show the ones you killed. You can say why this layout and not that one, in words a non\-designer follows. Your final screen looks inevitable, getting there wasn't.
* Product thinking \- You can name the job. You can finish this sentence about anything you design: "I am on this screen to \_\_\_." You understand the business without letting it drive, "it converts better" is not an argument here, it's the thing we check against. You think past the happy path: back, abandon, interrupt, resume, repeat use, the support ticket it creates. And you know what every choice costs you somewhere else.
* Systems thinking \- can you absorb variance instead of passing it on? This is the capability we weigh most heavily, and the one most portfolios fake. Can you hold altitude and detail simultaneously? The thing we're hiring for is not losing one while you're inside the other. Zoom out far enough to see the whole flow, the business, the org, the market, the ecosystem. Then zoom all the way into a 4px alignment, a tap target on a cracked screen, the exact word on a button. You notice when a new pattern is an old pattern in a new coat, and you consolidate instead of adding. Can you think in second order?
* Brand and craft \- do you have a voice, and can you hold it? Brand is not a phase that happens after the wireframes. It is a constraint you carry into the wireframe. You know removing something is usually the stronger move. You know the difference between brand and decoration. Brand is the accumulated feeling of a thousand small decisions being consistent. It is not a gradient. You can carry one identity across an ad, an app screen and an email without it fraying.


**How We Work**
* We ship weekly. Your work hits real hands fast, and fails there fast.
* Our standard is written down. No claim ships without its proof on the same surface. No fear, no pressure, no countdown timers. People are making the largest purchase of their lives, we don't get to be clever about it.
* We don't average. Every surface declares the one thing it's exceptional at. Balanced work is failed work.
* Feedback is direct and it's about the work. We'll teach you land records. We can't teach you judgment.
* In\-office, Hyderabad.


**Must\-haves**
 You've shipped something real and can say what it taught you. Fluency in Figma. Clear written English, you'll write product copy from week one. Obsessed with how people feel using a product, not just how it looks. And AI\-native, not AI\-dependent, AI should raise your ceiling, not set your floor.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Show us what you've built, portfolio plus the questions below.
   

  

* Tell us about one project where the design was wrong the first time and you fixed it. What was wrong, and how you knew. (A short paragraph.)
* One thing you'd change about Landeed today, flow, brand or visual, your choice and why. (Use the product first. The "why" matters more than the "what".)

description:
**Job Description**

 Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. title: UI/UX Designer & Frontend Developer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are hiring a full\-time UI/UX Designer \& Frontend Developer to own the design system and help deliver production\-quality interfaces across two B2B SaaS products built on a shared modern engineering stack.
 



**This is an end\-to\-end role:** 




**User Flow → Wireframe → Figma → Design System → Reusable Components → Production Frontend** 




 This is not a design\-only role or a generic frontend\-development role. You will design in Figma, govern a centrally managed Bootstrap theme and design\-token system, and build or work directly with developers on reusable production components. Your role is to keep the designed experience and the shipped experience aligned.
 



 You will be the quality bridge between design and production. Engineers should involve you before introducing custom styling, so shared interface decisions remain consistent, scalable, and maintainable.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**Design\-System Ownership** 




 ·     Own and evolve a centrally governed Bootstrap theme and design\-token system across both products.
 



 ·     Define and maintain visual foundations including colours, typography, spacing, radius, buttons, forms, tables, cards, and responsive patterns.
 



 ·     Maintain Figma as the canonical design reference and keep it aligned with production.
 



 ·     Build and maintain reusable Figma component libraries, variants, and responsive layouts.
 



 ·     Extend a shared design system across products with distinct visual identities.
 



 ·     Support configurable and white\-label theming when required.
 



 ·     Establish clear standards for shared components versus product\-specific treatments.
 



 ·     Review changes affecting shared themes, components, and styling.
 



 ·     Prevent hardcoded visual values and unnecessary local overrides from accumulating in the product.
 



 ·     Document design\-system standards and component usage so developers can implement interfaces consistently.
 



  
 



**The objective is simple:** 
 global design changes should be made once at the appropriate theme or token level and propagate consistently throughout the application.
 



  





**Product Design** 




 ·     Translate product requirements, business goals, and user needs into clear user flows and intuitive interfaces.
 



 ·     Create user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity mock\-ups, and interactive prototypes in Figma and FigJam.
 



 ·     Design at the component level, not only at the screen level.
 



 ·     Design complex B2B application workflows, including:
 



 ·     Multi\-step onboarding
 



 ·     Dashboards
 



 ·     Data tables
 



 ·     Forms
 



 ·     Search and filtering
 



 ·     Approval queues
 



 ·     Role\-based interfaces
 



 ·     Status management
 



 ·     Administrative screens
 



 ·     Define relevant UI states, including loading, empty, error, success, validation, and permission\-gated states.
 



 ·     Deliver responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile designs, applying sound judgment to workflows that require full mobile support.
 



 ·     Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, colour, layout, iconography, and interaction\-design principles.
 



 ·     Ensure designs follow accessibility and inclusive\-design principles.
 



 ·     Work directly with engineers to resolve implementation constraints without compromising design\-system consistency.
 



  





**Frontend Implementation** 




 ·     Build and modify production UI using React.
 



 ·     Implement responsive interfaces using Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, and responsive\-design frameworks.
 



 ·     Convert approved Figma designs into reusable frontend components.
 



 ·     Implement or pair with frontend developers on important shared components.
 



 ·     Build reusable components rather than page\-specific implementations.
 



 ·     Make shared visual changes at the theme or token level, avoiding one\-off local CSS overrides where a shared solution is appropriate.
 



 ·     Integrate frontend components with application data and account for real interface states, not only static mock\-ups.
 



 ·     Debug responsive, browser, and layout issues.
 



 ·     Validate implementation against approved Figma designs before release and identify discrepancies.
 



 ·     Participate in design reviews, delivery planning, implementation reviews, and cross\-functional product discussions.
 



  





 Required Qualifications
 



 ·     4–7 years of professional experience spanning UI/product design and frontend implementation.
 



 ·     A strong portfolio demonstrating web\-application or product design and shipped production UI.
 



 ·     Advanced proficiency in Figma and FigJam, including:
 



 ·     Component libraries
 



 ·     Auto Layout
 



 ·     Variants
 



 ·     Design tokens
 



 ·     Prototyping
 



 ·     Developer handoff
 



 ·     Experience building and maintaining a governed design system used by multiple developers.
 



 ·     Strong understanding of how CSS and component drift occurs, and how to prevent it structurally.
 



 ·     Strong Bootstrap knowledge, including theme architecture and reusable component patterns.
 



 ·     Production experience with React.
 



 ·     Ability to open a production codebase, build or modify a component, and review another developer’s implementation.
 



 ·     Strong HTML, CSS, and responsive\-layout skills.
 



 ·     Experience designing complex B2B interfaces such as dashboards, data tables, multi\-step forms, and status\-driven workflows.
 



 ·     Experience working directly with software engineers throughout implementation.
 



 ·     Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
 



**Portfolio is required.** 
 Applications without relevant web\-application UI, design\-system, or component\-library examples will not be reviewed.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 ·     Experience using Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe XD, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
 



 ·     Working knowledge of Angular or Vue.js.
 



 ·     Experience interpreting user behaviour and product performance through Google Analytics.
 



 ·     Experience with multi\-product or white\-label theming based on a shared design system.
 



 ·     Accessibility awareness, including focus states and semantic markup.
 



 ·     Performance\-conscious frontend practices.
 



 ·     Experience with data\-intensive B2B or SaaS applications.
 



 ·     Experience using AI\-assisted design and development tools while independently reviewing and validating the output.
 



  





**Core Tools and Technologies** 




 ·     Adobe Creative Cloud
 



 ·     Adobe XD
 



 ·     Photoshop
 



 ·     Illustrator
 



 ·     Figma
 



 ·     FigJam
 



 ·     Bootstrap
 



 ·     HTML
 



 ·     CSS
 



 ·     Responsive design frameworks
 



 ·     Jira
 



 ·     React
 



 ·     Angular
 



 ·     Vue.js
 



 ·     Google Analytics
 



  





**Not Required** 




 This role works closely with specialized frontend and backend engineers. You are not expected to own:
 



 ·     Backend development
 



 ·     Database architecture
 



 ·     Infrastructure
 



 ·     Full application\-state architecture
 



 ·     Application\-programming\-interface architecture
 



 ·     Domain\-specific backend business logic
 



 Your responsibility is the intersection of product\-interface design, design\-system governance, and production frontend implementation.
 



  





**This Role Is Not for You If** 




 Your normal approach is custom CSS per page, uncontrolled local component overrides, or handing off static Figma mock\-ups without staying involved through implementation.
 



 We need one governed visual system, not a new styling approach for every feature.
 



 If you prefer to work exclusively in Figma and do not want to open the React codebase—or prefer frontend coding without responsibility for design\-system consistency—this role is unlikely to be the right fit.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 ·     Figma and the production applications remain aligned.
 



 ·     Developers reuse approved components rather than recreating them.
 



 ·     Global design changes propagate through governed themes and design tokens.
 



 ·     New workflows move efficiently from requirements to production.
 



 ·     UI consistency improves as the applications grow.
 



 ·     Responsive behaviour is considered during design rather than added afterward.
 



 ·     Developers receive implementation\-ready designs.
 



 ·     The person designing the experience remains involved until that experience is successfully implemented.

title: UI/UX Designer - AI Apps
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UI/UX Designer \- AI Apps based in India.**
 This role offers the opportunity to shape intuitive digital experiences for next\-generation AI\-powered products.
   

  

 You will design user journeys that make sophisticated AI capabilities accessible, understandable, and engaging.
   

  

 The position spans UX research, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and design systems.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with product managers, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 Your work will influence how users interact with AI assistants, copilots, conversational interfaces, recommendations, and intelligent workflows.
   

  

 You will also help establish scalable design patterns that support usability, accessibility, and visual consistency.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced product designer who is excited about the intersection of human\-centered design and artificial intelligence.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Design intuitive, modern, and user\-centered experiences for AI\-powered web and mobile applications.
* Conduct user research, interviews, usability testing, and competitive analysis to understand user needs, behaviors, and expectations.
* Develop user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Design conversational and AI\-driven experiences, including chat interfaces, AI assistants, copilots, recommendations, and intelligent workflows.
* Create effective interaction patterns for AI features such as prompting, generated responses, feedback, regeneration, editing, citations, confidence indicators, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Translate complex AI and machine learning capabilities into simple, accessible, and understandable user experiences.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately.
* Build and maintain design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and design guidelines.
* Conduct usability testing and continuously iterate designs using user feedback, behavioral insights, and product analytics.
* Ensure experiences meet responsive design, mobile\-first, accessibility, usability, and visual consistency standards.
* Provide developers with detailed design specifications, assets, interaction requirements, and implementation guidance.
* Monitor emerging trends in AI UX, generative AI interfaces, conversational design, and human\-AI interaction to inform future product experiences.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years of professional experience in UI/UX, Product Design, or a closely related digital design discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing AI\-powered applications, chatbots, copilots, generative AI products, or conversational interfaces.
* Hands\-on proficiency with Figma and modern UI/UX design tools.
* Strong understanding of UX research, user\-centered design, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design.
* Proven experience creating wireframes, prototypes, user flows, journey maps, and high\-fidelity interface designs.
* Practical understanding of LLM and generative AI user experiences, including prompt\-based interactions and AI\-generated content.
* Strong knowledge of responsive web design and mobile\-first design principles.
* Experience creating or working with design systems, component libraries, reusable UI patterns, and design guidelines.
* Good understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG principles.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts and translate them into clear, intuitive experiences.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with product managers, engineers, AI/ML specialists, and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a user\-centered mindset.
* Ability to balance user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints when making design decisions.


**Benefits**
* Full\-time opportunity with a remote working arrangement.
* Opportunity to design products at the intersection of UX and artificial intelligence.
* Exposure to emerging technologies including generative AI, LLM\-powered applications, conversational interfaces, and AI assistants.
* Collaborative environment working alongside product, engineering, AI/ML, and business teams.
* Opportunity to influence product strategy and shape how users interact with next\-generation AI experiences.
* Professional growth through exposure to evolving AI design patterns, research methods, and modern product development practices.
* Opportunity to build and contribute to scalable design systems and reusable product experiences.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 DevRev’s Knowledge team is hiring a technical writer who has strong technical proficiency and strives for simplicity. You’ll join a small team that has built our external documentation set from scratch and ships on a rapid product cadence. This role reports to the Head of Knowledge Ops.The Technical Writer is responsible for ensuring that documentation for our product is useful, findable, clear, correct, comprehensive, and consistent \- and that it directly contributes to customer self\-service and product adoption.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Write, review, publish, and maintain product documentation on the support portal, covering features across our AI product (Computer), platform capabilities (access control, customization, connectors), and integrations (Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, etc.).
* Ensure documentation is available at launch and then deepen, expand, and improve it over time based on customer needs, support patterns, and product evolution. Sustaining documentation is as much of the job as creating it.
* Partner with product managers who own the content for their areas. Your job is to help them get documentation ready: structuring, drafting, editing, publishing, and driving the review process to completion on schedule.
* Identify and address knowledge base gaps by analyzing support ticket themes, deflection data, and customer feedback \- not waiting for requests to arrive.
* Maintain and improve the documentation infrastructure: contribute to article health metrics, flag platform issues that affect KB quality (e.g., metadata hygiene, article visibility settings), and propose operational improvements.
* Hold subject\-matter experts accountable for technical reviews. Documentation at DevRev is a cross\-functional commitment: product managers own accuracy, and you drive the process that ensures it.
* Identify and implement opportunities to use AI and automation to scale documentation production, including AI\-assisted drafting, content audits, and workflow automation.


**What You'll Bring**
* 3 \- 6 years writing and maintaining software product documentation, preferably for SaaS or platform products.
* Strong command of documentation best practices: information architecture, essentialism, clear and direct prose.
* Experience sustaining a documentation set over time \- not just writing first drafts, but iterating, expanding, consolidating, and retiring content as products evolve.
* Comfortable with knowledge base platforms, markdown, and version\-controlled content workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to learn complex technical domains quickly \- AI, APIs, integrations, access control, and similar concepts will be your daily vocabulary.
* Effective async communicator across time zones.
* Interest in using AI tools to augment documentation workflows for drafting, translation, content audits, or summarization.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Previous startup experience, demonstrating adaptability and proactivity in fast\-paced environments.
* Familiarity with AI products, developer tools, or platform products with complex permission models.
* Experience using analytics (article views, search queries, deflection rates) to prioritize documentation work and measure impact.


*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

title: Technical Publication Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Develop, write, and revise technical documents including user manuals, system operation guides, and installation instructions.
   

  

 Collaborating with design and development, teams gather technical information and ensure documentation accuracy.
   

  

 Translate complex electromechanical concepts into clear, user\-friendly content for diverse audiences.
   

  

 Ensure all documentation complies with relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Create and integrate visual content such as diagrams, flowcharts, and schematics to enhance understanding.
   

  

 Maintain and manage documentation schedules, ensuring timely delivery of content across multiple projects.
   

  

 Conduct in\-depth research to understand product functionality, usage, and maintenance procedures.
   

  

 Review and edit documentation created by peers to ensure consistency, clarity, and technical accuracy.
   

  

 Support the development of training materials and e\-learning modules.
   

  

 Participate in peer reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of documentation processes.
   

  

 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.
   

  

**Work Experience**
**Skills Required:**
 3–5 years of experience in technical writing, preferably in mechanical, automation, or electromechanical industries.
   

  

 Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems, including sensors, actuators, and embedded components.
   

  

 Proficiency with content management systems and documentation tools (e.g., MS office, Adobe).
   

  

 Familiarity with regulatory and compliance standards relevant to technical documentation (e.g., ISO, CE, etc.).
   

  

 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a keen eye for detail.
   

  

 Ability to simplify and structure complex technical information for various user levels.
   

  

 Strong organizational and time management skills; capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously.
   

  

 Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other documentation software.
   

  

 Self\-motivated and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.
   

  

 Strong analytical and research skills to understand and document technical systems effectively.
   

  

 Proficiency in French will be added advantage.
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech (any discipline)

title: Proposal Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Proposal Analyst**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India
   

  

**About Ceres India**
 Ceres India (Ceres Environmental India Pvt. Ltd.) serves as the Global Capabilities Center for Ceres Global, embodying strategic value, innovation, and operational excellence. With a highly skilled and diverse team, Ceres India drives efficiency and delivers exceptional support services across global operations.
   

  

**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People**
 At Ceres, you’re more than an employee you’re part of a mission\-driven team restoring hope and rebuilding lives. Every role, whether in leadership, field operations, or support functions, plays a critical part in helping communities recover when it matters most.
   

  

 We value initiative, collaboration, diversity, and accountability. Our culture is built on resilience, teamwork, and empowerment, offering competitive compensation, global exposure, and opportunities to lead with impact.
   

  

 If you act with compassion, urgency, and ownership you’ll thrive at Ceres.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented
 **Proposal Analyst** 
 to support Ceres’
 **U.S. operations** 
 by developing high\-quality, client\-facing documents. This role focuses on preparing
 **proposals, Statements of Qualifications (SOQs), and RFP/RFQ responses** 
 that are clear, compelling, and fully compliant with client requirements.
   

  

 The Proposal Writer will collaborate closely with proposal managers, subject matter experts (SMEs), technical teams, and business development leaders to produce well\-structured content aligned with Ceres’ service standards, brand guidelines, and submission deadlines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Proposal Editing**
* Develop, write, and edit proposals, SOQs, and RFP/RFQ responses that clearly articulate Ceres’ capabilities, experience, and value proposition.
* Translate technical and operational inputs from SMEs and project teams into concise, client\-focused narratives.


**Compliance, Quality \& Branding**
* Ensure all proposal content is compliant with solicitation requirements and aligned with corporate branding guidelines.
* Proofread and edit documents to ensure grammatical accuracy, clarity, consistency, and quality.


**Collaboration \& Reviews**
* Participate in proposal review cycles and incorporate feedback from proposal managers and key stakeholders.
* Coordinate closely with cross\-functional teams to meet tight and competing deadlines.


**Content Management \& Support**
* Maintain and update a centralized repository of templates, resumes, project descriptions, and case studies for reuse.
* Support formatting and visual presentation using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Adobe tools.
* Manage document version control and coordinate final submissions.
* Assist with presentations, capability statements, and marketing collateral as required.


**Experience**
**Required Qualifications**
* 1\-2 years of experience in proposal writing, Data entry, content development, or technical writing.
* Prior experience in engineering, construction, disaster recovery, environmental services, or infrastructure is preferred.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Business, or a related field.


**Skills**
* Strong ability to draft persuasive, well\-structured, and compliant proposal content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; familiarity with Adobe tools is an advantage.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to handle multiple proposals simultaneously under tight deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting U.S. government proposals, RFPs, RFQs, and compliance\-driven documentation.
* Familiarity with APMP (Association of Proposal Management Professionals) best practices.
* Exposure to content management systems or proposal automation tools.
* Prior experience working in a Global Capability Centre (GCC) or cross\-functional, global team environment.


**What To Expect**
 As a Proposal Analsyt at Ceres, you’ll work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and deadline\-driven environment, directly contributing to securing high\-value contracts in the U.S. market.
   

  

 You’ll gain hands\-on exposure to proposal management, government contracting, and technical documentation while collaborating with proposal managers, SMEs, and cross\-functional teams across India and the U.S.
   

  

 This role offers a strong growth path into
 **Proposal Specialist or Proposal Manager** 
 positions as you build expertise in content strategy, proposal development, and client communications.
   

  

**Why Join Ceres?**
 At Ceres, you won’t just have a job — you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact by helping communities recover through mission\-driven work.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A collaborative, mission\-driven work culture
* Hands\-on exposure to U.S. proposal and business development processes
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development

title: Consultant – Applications, Infrastructure and Security Modernization
description:
**About Gartner Consulting:**
 Gartner Consulting partners with the world’s leading organizations to help them solve their most critical business challenges and drive growth through actionable market insights, advanced analytics, and strategic recommendations. Our teams work globally with clients, delivering industry\-leading solutions in a collaborative, diverse, and innovative environment.
   

  

**What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?**
* Work with top\-tier consulting professionals on high\-impact projects for Fortune 500 clients.
* Access to cutting\-edge research, data, and technology.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, career advancement, and professional growth.
* A culture that values collaboration, innovation, and diversity.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and recognition for your contributions.


**About this role:**
 You would be supporting the global consulting delivery team of Gartner Consulting advising IT and business leaders on application strategy, develop comparative insights, create new capabilities, and market opportunities for some of our large customers across North America, EMEA and Japan regions. Your role would be to support consulting engagement for our clients as part of extended global team by demonstrating strong analytical mindset, business acumen, great learning attitude, problem solving and consultative skill and quality of execution.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Support application strategy engagements by working on development of application modernization roadmaps, application rationalization and ensuring alignment with software delivery best practices.
* Articulate findings and implications on client software solutions and infrastructure and provide fact\-based recommendations for improvements.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of leading application design and architectural principles and best practices, hands on experience in large scale IT landscape.
* Make high impact client presentations with compelling story board, hypothesis and visualization to deliver actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate with internal and client leaders to contribute to creation of reusable solutions, proposals and Points of Views (POVs).
* Contribute to project management, quality assurance, and best practices within the team.


**What you’ll need:**
* 3\-5 years of total work experience in application strategy, technology modernization, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or related roles (consulting firm experience preferred).
* Strong foundational knowledge across architecture domains, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, API strategy, ERP ecosystems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), and data architecture.
* Knowledge of leading\-edge and emerging technologies that drive modern architecture such as cloud\-native platforms, microservices, continuous availability, integration platforms, DevSecOps, and mesh application and service architecture.
* Experience with application/software development lifecycle (requirements, development, testing, deployment), including agile (preferred), hybrid, and waterfall methodologies.
* Knowledge of assessment and implementation of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, etc.).
* Fluency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong PowerPoint skills for data storytelling and client presentations.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, global consulting environment.


**Who you are:**
* Passionate about exploring software delivery verticals like development, infrastructure and cybersecurity
* Analytical, detail\-oriented, and results\-driven with a strong problem\-solving mindset.
* Self\-starter with a passion for learning, technology, and consulting.
* Collaborative team player with strong intercultural communication skills.
* Flexible, adaptable, and resilient in managing ambiguity and shifting priorities.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a commitment to high\-quality work.
* Motivated to grow within consulting and contribute to Gartner’s and clients’ success.


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

 Cloud FinOps \& Financial Governance

* Coordinate with Cloud, Network, Security, Platform, Workplace, and Data Center teams.
* Track project milestones, risks, dependencies, and escalations.
* Facilitate governance reviews and leadership reporting.
* Drive execution discipline across infrastructure initiatives.



 Agentic AI Development \& Automation

* Create AI agents for:



 o Budget monitoring

 o Cost optimization recommendations
 



 o PR/PO tracking
 



 o Executive reporting
 



 o Risk identification
 



 o Compliance monitoring
 



 o Infrastructure health insights
 


* Build copilots and workflow agents leveraging enterprise AI platforms.
* Integrate AI solutions with ITSM, monitoring, cloud, and financial systems.

 Enterprise AI \& Infrastructure Innovation
 


* Support larger AI transformation initiatives within the Infrastructure organization.
* Identify use cases where AI can improve productivity, governance, decision\-making, and service delivery.
* Collaborate with Cloud, Data, Security, and AI teams to develop scalable enterprise AI solutions.

 Cloud \& FinOps

 AI \& Automation

 Governance \& Strategy
 


* PMO Management
* Business Case Development
* Executive Reporting

* Risk \& Dependency Management

* 6\+ years of experience

* Experienced in building AI agents independently using low\-code and code\-based platforms

title: Implementation Analyst (IT Analyst)
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You And This Role**
 As an Implementation Analyst (IT Analyst), you will support end\-to\-end implementations and deployments across software, infrastructure, digital transformation, and mergers, acquisitions, and divestiture projects. You will help deliver projects on time, within budget, and with smooth organizational adoption. As part of an implementation team, you will apply general Information Systems knowledge, typically gained through formal education, to design, develop, and support implementation activities, including infrastructure provisioning, configuration, data migration, testing, cutover, and hypercare to meet business needs and requirements.
   

  

 You will apply established procedures and practices to analyze and resolve issues. You will be accountable for assigned contributions without direct supervisory responsibilities. Your work primarily affects your own responsibilities and may also influence broader team outcomes. You will also be expected to follow established processes to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
   

  

 This role requires conceptual knowledge of relevant theories, practices, and procedures, along with general business knowledge gained through education or prior experience in your discipline and functional area. You should be able to exchange basic information clearly and ask questions to confirm understanding.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Gathers and analyzes business requirements for assigned functional and technical areas.
* Works closely with business process teams, technical teams and other stakeholders to design and build objects which meet requirements.
* Documents detailed designs of solutions.
* Good understanding \& practical exposure to System Configuration, Data Analysis \& Migration and Quality Assurance \& Testing.
* Assists with defect management \& issue resolution.
* Designing training materials and conducting workshops to educate end\-users on product features, ensuring smooth adoption.
* Helps ensure that functional and technical designs meet business requirements, conform to Dow architecture standards, and optimize productivity and long\-term product/system vision.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in IT discipline preferred or a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience
* Excellent communication skills to explain complex concepts and build consensus.


**Your** 
**Skill** 
**s**
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving: Ability to analyze error trends, perform root\-cause analysis, and recommend effective long\-term fixes.
* Communication: Exceptional capability to translate highly technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and business users.
* Technical Proficiency: Good understanding of IT Infrastructure, operating systems, networking, integrations, application development etc..
* Project Management: Ability to coordinate software implementations, upgrades, and testing phases with minimal supervision.


**Additional** 
**notes**
* No relocation support is provided on the role.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.
+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one\-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
   

  

**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer\-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science\-based products and solutions in high\-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
   

  

 A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non\-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
   

  

 As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: Junior Full Stack Engineer (Hands-On Coder) - WFH
description:
Junior Full Stack SaaS Engineer
 
  




 About the Role
 
  





 We are looking for a highly motivated Junior Full Stack SaaS Engineer to architect, build, and scale modern SaaS platforms from the ground up.
 



 This role is for someone who has hands\-on experience building complete SaaS products—not just isolated frontend or backend features. The ideal candidate understands how to design and ship scalable, production\-grade applications across the full stack, including:
 



  




* frontend systems,
* backend APIs,
* databases,
* authentication,
* billing,
* infrastructure,
* deployment pipelines,
* and multi\-tenant SaaS architecture.



  





 You will work closely with product, design, AI, and infrastructure teams to build reliable and scalable software products used in production environments.
 



  




 Responsibilities
 
  




 Full Stack Product Development
 * Design and develop end\-to\-end SaaS applications from scratch
* Build responsive and scalable frontend applications
* Develop secure backend APIs and microservices
* Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, and user management systems
* Build billing, subscription, and usage\-based systems
* Develop dashboards, admin panels, and workflow management systems


 Backend \& API Engineering
 * Design scalable backend architecture and APIs
* Build high\-performance REST and/or GraphQL services
* Implement asynchronous systems, queues, caching, and background jobs
* Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability
* Integrate third\-party APIs and services


 Database Engineering
 * Design and manage scalable database systems
* Work extensively with:
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* MySQL
* SQL\-based systems
* Design schemas, indexing strategies, query optimization, and data models
* Build systems for high availability, backups, migrations, and scaling


 Infrastructure \& Deployment
 * Deploy and manage applications across cloud environments
* Work with:
* Docker
* CI/CD pipelines
* cloud infrastructure
* containerized deployments
* Build scalable production environments with monitoring and observability
* Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams on deployment strategies


 Engineering \& Product Ownership
 * Write clean, maintainable, and production\-grade code
* Participate in architecture and technical design discussions
* Write technical documentation and implementation plans
* Review code and maintain engineering best practices
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ship features quickly and reliably



  




 Requirements
 
  




 Must\-Have
 * Strong hands\-on experience building SaaS platforms or full\-stack applications
* Strong full stack engineering experience across frontend and backend systems
* Strong experience with databases including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, and SQL systems
* Experience with scalable multi\-tenant SaaS architectures
* Strong understanding of APIs, authentication systems, and application security
* Experience deploying and maintaining production systems in cloud environments
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Python backend engineering skills


 Preferred
 * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js
* Experience with Node.js, Python, or Go backend systems
* Familiarity with AI integrations and API\-based AI products
* Experience with Redis, queues, caching systems, and event\-driven architectures
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and distributed systems
* Startup or high\-growth product experience



  




 What We’re Looking For
 * Someone who has built real SaaS products used by customers
* Strong product and systems\-thinking mindset
* Ability to move quickly while maintaining engineering quality
* Ownership mentality with strong execution skills
* Someone comfortable working across the full stack without heavy supervision
* Must be a coder, not just a user or project manager



  




 Compensation
 
 Competitive salary depending on experience and current verifiable (paychecks) compensation.
 



 To apply, please include:
 


* Relevant SaaS products or platforms built
* GitHub, portfolio, or technical project links
* Technologies and frameworks worked with
* Brief description of systems you have architected or scaled



  




 Company Description
 
 Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, USA, Qubrid is a global provider of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Center and IoT products, solutions, and services. As pioneers in the realm of advanced computing technologies, we pride ourselves on being at the forefront of innovation, empowering businesses with the transformative capabilities of GPUs, Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Computing, IoT and more. We specialize in offering a wide array of hardware and software solutions for industries such as healthcare, manufacturing, finance, government, education and more.

 **iOS Developer**

 We are looking for an enthusiastic
 **iOS Developer**

+ Good logical and problem\-solving abilities.
+ Strong willingness to learn and work on production applications.

* 
+ Knowledge of iOS app lifecycle and UIKit.
+ Familiarity with MVVM or other basic architectural patterns.
+ Experience publishing or testing applications using TestFlight/App Store is an added advantage.


**Eligibility**
* 
+ Freshers to 1\.5 years of relevant experience in iOS development.
+ Candidates should have strong practical knowledge of Swift and SwiftUI.
+ Candidates who have completed iOS development projects, internships, or relevant certifications are encouraged to apply.


**What We Offer**
* 
+ Opportunity to work on real\-world mobile applications.
+ Exposure to modern iOS development technologies.
+ Learning and mentorship from experienced developers.
+ Opportunity to enhance technical and problem\-solving skills.
+ Collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment.
+ Career growth opportunities based on performance and potential.


**Key Competencies**
* 
+ Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
+ Good attention to detail.
+ Ability to learn new technologies quickly.
+ Good communication and teamwork skills.
+ Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
+ Passion for mobile application development.

description:
**Role Overview**
 The Full Stack Developer is a highly skilled engineer responsible for designing and delivering end\-to\-end digital solutions across frontend and backend platforms, with a specialisation in Zoho CRM customisation and integration. Working within a modern, client\-facing environment, this role combines deep technical execution with collaborative delivery — contributing to engineering standards, mentoring peers, and driving quality across the full software development lifecycle. The Full Stack Developer works closely with Engineering Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to business needs. The role has a strong focus on Node.js\-based backend development, Zoho CRM platform expertise, and the progressive adoption of AI\-enabled development practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Zoho CRM Development \& Customisation**
* Design, implement, and maintain custom Zoho CRM modules, workflows, blueprints, and automation rules aligned to business processes.
* Build and manage custom functions using Deluge scripting within the Zoho ecosystem.
* Integrate Zoho CRM with third\-party systems and internal applications using Zoho APIs and REST\-based integrations.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to translate CRM requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions on the Zoho platform.
* Maintain awareness of Zoho platform updates and new features, applying them where appropriate to improve delivered solutions.


**Backend Development**
* Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript, following clean architecture and SOLID principles.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and webhook\-based integrations across internal and external services.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and implement caching strategies where appropriate.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent, ensuring automated testing and reliable deployments.


**Frontend Development**
* Build responsive and scalable frontend applications using React or Next.js with TypeScript.
* Ensure strong alignment of API contracts between frontend and backend teams, collaborating closely with UX and product stakeholders.
* Implement state management, component architecture, and performance optimisation best practices across frontend codebases.
* Maintain accessibility standards and promote a consistent, high\-quality user experience across platforms.


**AI \& Engineering Innovation (Preferred)**
* Actively participate in the adoption of AI\-enabled development tools and workflows across the SDLC, including code generation, spec\-driven development, and automated testing.
* Apply AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate development, improve code quality, and enhance documentation.
* Stay current with emerging AI development practices and contribute to internal knowledge sharing and upskilling initiatives.


**Engineering Excellence \& Quality**
* Write clean, well\-tested code aligned to agreed engineering standards and coding guidelines.
* Promote clean architecture, SOLID principles, testability, and a strong culture of peer review and continuous improvement.
* Identify and proactively address technical debt, advocating for quality and long\-term maintainability within the team.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical knowledge sharing sessions.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Zoho CRM: Strong hands\-on experience with Zoho CRM customisation, workflows, Deluge scripting, and API integrations; Zoho CRM Certification is mandatory/preferred
* Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, RESTful API design, Webhook integrations
* Frontend: React / Next.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
* DevOps: Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, CI/CD pipeline management


**GOOD TO HAVE**
* Experience with other Zoho suite products (Zoho Creator, Zoho Books, Zoho Analytics, Zoho Flow).
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor for productivity and code quality improvements.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure for deployment and infrastructure management.
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks and observability platforms (AppInsights, ELK).
* Prior experience working in a GCC or international client\-facing delivery model.

**What Will You Do?**
 Design, develop and maintain native Android and iOS applications with a focus on quality, performance and usability.
   

  

* Build scalable mobile architecture and reusable components using Kotlin and Swift, following clean, testable, modular coding practices.
* Integrate mobile applications with backend APIs and cloud services for authentication, notifications, analytics and data synchronization.
* Create and maintain intuitive, accessible mobile UI/UX across Android and iOS, aligned with product requirements and design standards.
* Manage state, local data handling and performance optimization to deliver stable and responsive app behavior across devices and network conditions.
* Integrate third\-party SDKs and platform services such as maps, location, crash reporting, analytics and device capabilities as needed.
* Implement and maintain reliable asynchronous workflows on mobile, including queued operations, retries and resilient API error handling.
* Write and maintain unit/instrumentation/UI tests for Android and iOS features and ensure release quality through CI\-integrated validation.


**What Do You Need?**
 To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or information systems, or equivalent practical experience and 5\-8 years of professional mobile app development experience.


**Android Skills**
* Expert proficiency in Kotlin for native Android development, with strong knowledge of the Android SDK, app lifecycle and modern APIs.
* Strong experience with Android architecture and state management patterns (MVVM/Clean Architecture), using ViewModel, LiveData/Flow and dependency injection with Hilt or Dagger.
* Solid understanding of Android performance optimization, memory management, threading/coroutines and app startup/runtime profiling.
* Proficiency building adaptive Android UI using XML and Jetpack Compose (where applicable), with strong accessibility and usability practices.
* Strong understanding of Android networking patterns using Retrofit/OkHttp/Gson, push notifications and background services.


**IOS Skills**
* Expert proficiency in Swift for native iOS development, with strong understanding of UIKit and SwiftUI in production codebases.
* Strong experience with iOS app architecture (MVC/MVVM), feature modularization and maintainable, testable code organization.
* Solid understanding of asynchronous programming in Swift (async/await, concurrency, threading) and app lifecycle behavior.
* Experience with iOS dependency management and ecosystem tooling (CocoaPods/SPM), including third\-party SDK integration.
* Familiarity with iOS release workflows, provisioning/signing basics and environment\-based build/scheme management (Debug/QA/Stage/Release).


**General Mobile Skills**
* Experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines and build tooling (Gradle/Xcode pipelines) such as Azure Pipelines, App Center, GitHub Actions or equivalent.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience building and maintaining schedule\-based field\-service workflows, including job lifecycle actions (start/pause/complete), notes and media capture.
* Experience with real\-time and near real\-time mobile workflows including push notifications, background sync and resilient network handling.
* Experience implementing map/location\-based features (Google Maps/Places or equivalent), GPS tracking concepts and route/navigation interactions.
* Experience collaborating with product/design/QA to deliver consistent UX across Android and iOS while maintaining release documentation and standards.
* CRM or accounting platform API integration experience, such as Salesforce or QuickBooks.
* Event\-driven architecture or observability tooling experience, such as AWS X\-Ray or Kinesis.
* Static analysis tooling experience, such as SonarQube or equivalent.
* Ability to contribute effectively across both Kotlin/Android and Swift/iOS codebases in a shared product domain.
* AI\-integrated development tools, such as Copilot CLI or Claude Code.

description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. * You will design and build applications for the Android platform.

* You'll interface with software test to ensure a high\-quality product.
* You will develop automated unit and integration tests.
* You'll participate in design, code, and test reviews.
* You will propose and implement enhancements to the apps to improve sustainability.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

* You bring expert\-level Kotlin skills, with strong Coroutines and asynchronous programming experience.
* You have a strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms.
* You have a deep understanding of Android architecture and design patterns (MVVM / MVI / MVP).
* You have experience with REST API integration using Retrofit.
* You have a proven track record building and maintaining large\-scale, multi\-module Android applications.
